title: Affinity Generator Mods
summary: Affinity Generator Mods are a type of generator mods, which grant Affinity Bonuses.

sections.title: Overview
items: Affinity Generator Mods are a type of generator mods, which grant Affinity Bonuses.

Affinity Bonuses are character boosts, via stat increases or additional abilities, which will become active when the character meets some set of requirements. The first Affinity Bonuses will come from wearing Elite Gear. That gear has this tooltip to let you know it works with Affinity Generator Mods: "Wearing this and other pieces of Elite gear will activate your currently installed Affinity Generator Mods that require Elite gear."

sections.title: Generator
items: Affinity Generator Mods are a new fifth type of generator mods. These mods can only be installed into the new bottom row of the Generator, labeled Affinity. The mods have four categories that correlate to how many pieces of Elite gear your character is wearing. The Generator has one socket for mods that work with two pieces (Type A), one socket for mods that work with four pieces (Type B), one socket for mods that work with six pieces (Type C), and one socket for mods that work with eight pieces (Type D). This allows a character to have four different Affinity Bonuses active at once.
The sockets on the Generator follow the normal rules of the Generator in that they require the cells to be active in order for them to function.
1 Cell active = Type A bonus socket active
2 Cells active = Type B bonus socket active
3 Cells active = Types C & D bonus socket active

sections.title: Affinity Generator Mods
items: The bonuses are better depending on how many pieces of gear are required to activate it. The two piece Elite gear Type A Affinity Generator Mods grant half an equipment mod's amount of a stat for the given tier. The four piece Elite gear Type B Affinity Mods grant the full amount of an equipment mod's stat for the given tier. For instance a tier VII Might equipment mod grants +130 Might. So a two piece Elite gear Type A Affinity Generator Mod v7 would grant +65 Might and a four piece v7 Elite gear Type B Affinity Generator Mod would grant +130 Might. The six and eight piece Type C & D mods will be available at a later date.
The mods correspond to a specific column in the Generator and will only work in that column
This is different from how other Generator mods work
The 2 piece Elite gear Type A and 4 piece Elite gear Type B mod items have a version number and use an icon that matches that like 'v7'
Installation also contributes 8 prestige toward weekly Base walk-in
The mods can be purchased from a new vendor in the Tech wings of the HQs and have a POI marker on the map. They are also available from the Amenity R&D Vendor.

sections.title: Character Inventory UI
items: In order for you to know which Affinity Generator Mods are currently installed and/or active, the top right empty slot in the Inventory UI is labeled Affinity Bonus and used to show a tooltip. The tooltip will gray out any installed but inactive mod descriptions and will be gray plus show "None" if the Generator does not have a mod in that slot. If all the cells in your generator are depleted a message is shown at the top of the tooltip that says, "Your Generator is unpowered. Add power to the Generator in your Base to activate your Affinity Mods."

title: Dominance
summary: Dominance increases the potency of certain defensive and healing abilities.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dominance increases the potency of certain defensive and healing abilities.
At high levels, Dominance must be higher than enemy Willpower to be effective.
Dominance is an important stat for Tanks and Controllers.
The recommended Dominance for an Alert, Raid or Operation is needed to affect opponents in that content when using power based control effects.
Dominance is combined with Restoration to determine the potency of healing and shield abilities.
Healing = Base Healing Multiplier * (30% Restoration + 25% Dominance).Shield = Base Shield Multiplier * (112.5% Restoration + 150% Dominance)

Dominance increases the maximum possible duration of stuns, roots, levitations and encasements deployed from super powers at a rate of +1 second for every 500 Dominance (2 milliseconds per 1 point of Dominance). [1]

Dominance can be increased using Artifacts, Augments, Generator Mods and spending Stat Points in Dominance. It can also temporarily be increased through the use of consumables such as Bulldozer Soders or Compound Omega.
Atomic Molecular Charges heal equal to 40% Dominance in Tank Role.
Earth gains Defense equal to 65% of Dominance in Tank Role.
Rage gains Health equal to a percentage of Dominance in Tank Role.

title: Generator
summary: The Generator is the power core of a player's base and feeds the base's mainframe with energy.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Generator is the power core of a player's base and feeds the base's mainframe with energy.
It provides access to the player's armory builds and generator mods as well as having three increasing power levels to generate and maintain dispenser items.
Generators will adapt visually to the theme of the base.

sections.title: Armory Builds
items: The Armory Builds tab is used to assign existing armories to hotkeys which can be accessed in the field.
On the right side a listing of all existing armories can be found and on the left side those can be assigned a hotkey.
Four armories can be activated at the same time.
New armories can be purchased from the marketplace from this interface as well.

sections.title: Power Level
items: The power levels of the generator are represented by three different power cells which must be kept charged by the player. One charge lasts approximately 30 days. Cells can be recharged once lower than 50% charged.
If the cells run out of power, the player's dispenser items will stop working.
The power level maintenance can also be accessed through the base's mainframe.
Before game update 47 there were four power levels.

sections.title: Mods
items: Generator mods come in five different categories and can be used to add destinations to the teleporter as well as to further enhance the player's combat statistics and role abilities.

General generator mods are tradeable, all stats and role enhancing generator mods are not. Once a mod is placed, it cannot be removed from the generator anymore, but can be overwritten with another mod of the same color anytime.

sections.title: Trivia
items: When the Home Turf DLC pack was released, generators were without any functionality. The power cells could and still can be managed through the mainframe. Generators went first functional with game update 33 when armories were introduced. Game update 38 added the generator mods, Affinity Generator Mods were introduced with Episode 16.

Following game update 47 the fourth power level Antimatter Cell was removed due to the fact that the formerly three mainframe boost levels were merged into one leaving only three power levels overall.

title: Mainframe
summary: The Mainframe is a Lair or Hideout's central computer system that provides the player with access to features like Backup, Sidekicks, Orbital Strikes, Supply Drops and Equipment Mods which can be used in combat.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Mainframe is a Lair or Hideout's central computer system that provides the player with access to features like Backup, Sidekicks, Orbital Strikes, Supply Drops and Equipment Mods which can be used in combat.

The power and strength of these items can be increased via upgrades in the Mainframe while the duration that the player has access to these amenities is altered depending on the power available in the Generator located in their lair/hideout. Players can also use a Proto Mainframe Bot consumable to summon a robot to access the mainframe anywhere (except for PvP arenas) for a short period.
Mainframes will adapt visually to the theme of the base.

sections.title: Mainframe Upgrades
items: Purchasing Mainframe Upgrades determine which items your Dispenser contains and how effective those items are. Mainframe Upgrades are purchased using Marks of Triumph. There are five types of items available from the Dispenser : Orbital Strike (an immediate-damage offensive item), Supply Drop (a useable item that produces different local effects), Sidekicks (an item that summons a single accomplice to assist in battle), Back Up (an item that summons multiple henchmen with a shorter duration period for use in larger fights), and Tactical Mods (which are special modifications that can be added to Weapons and Back, Neck, Foot, Hands, and Chest equipment).

All of the Dispenser Items (with the exception of the Tactical Mods) are equipable in the Trinket Slot and used in the same manner. Tactical Mods are applied to their respective Item slots in the same manner that other Mods are used. Each level of Dispenser Item purchased requires that you have one Active Cell in your Generator: so to purchase the Supply Drop II, you need to have a minimum of two Active Cells. You can have as many Dispenser Items as you would like per Generator Level : if you have two Active Cells, you can buy Supply Drop I and II, Orbital Strike I and II, Sidekicks I and II, etc.
The first and second Mainframe Upgrade in each category are permanent. The boost is temporary and expires after approximately 60 days, after which you can purchase the bonus in that category again.

sections.title: Power Level
items: The power levels of the Mainframe are represented by three different power cells which must be kept charged by the player. One charge lasts approximately 30 days.
If the cells run out of power, the player's dispenser items will stop working.
The power level maintenance can also be accessed through the base's Generator.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Mainframe is based on the concept of the Batcave Mainframe.

title: Power
summary: Power is required to use abilities in a Loadout and is drained as abilities are performed.

sections.title: Overview
items: Power is required to use abilities in a Loadout and is drained as abilities are performed.
A percentage of max Power regenerates every second.
Power regeneration is increased out of combat.
Power builds when performing weapon attacks with either a Weapons Expert or a HybridFocus.
Power does NOT build when performing weapon attacks with a SuperpoweredFocus but +10% Power and +25% Power Regeneration is granted instead.
Power can be restored by specific active powers, breakouts and consumables.
Breakouts require Innate Skills in a Movement tree to restore power after a breakout.
Power is restored when defeating opponents in Challenges, Duos and open world content.
The main role of a Controller is to restore the party's power.
Stat Points spent in Might also increase the Power pool.
The Power pool can be increased using Artifacts, Augments and Generator Mods. It can also temporarily be increased through the use of consumables such as Energy Soders or Compound Omega.

Most powers have a base power cost of 100, 200, 300, or 400, except Supercharge powers. Power costs are increased base on your equipped stats. For example, The Death of Superman content buffs you to 230 Combat Rating if you are beneath it, and your power costs would be exactly 16x the base amount. The gear given by the CR 210 Advance would lead to power costs 12.49x the base amount. Augments do not increase power costs.

items: Teleportation is the ability to travel from one point to another without traversing the physical space between them.

Players also have the ability to teleport to their HQ, Base or Rally location using the Warp feature in the Map menu. Some Consumables allow for instant travel to specific locations.
General Generator Mods can be placed in a Lair Generator allowing instance travel using a Teleporter Amenity.

title: Backup and Henchmen
summary: Backup and Henchmen are NPCs that can be summoned by the Player Character via trinket to support them in combat. Lair System access is necessary to use these Uplink Device type trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. Some trinkets are awarded from Events or Story Arcs content.

sections.title: Overview
items: Backup and Henchmen are NPCs that can be summoned by the Player Character via trinket to support them in combat. Lair System access is necessary to use these Uplink Device type trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. Some trinkets are awarded from Events or Story Arcs content.
Henchmen and Backup act in a similar manner to pets, staying with the player character for some time before disappearing. They can summoned again when their cooldown ends.

sections.title: Normal and Elite
items: Normal Back-Up and Henchmen are of epic rarity while elite ones are of artifact rarity. Elite Back-Up or Henchmen deal substantially more damage and have additional effects beyond damage; they also do not require anything unlocked in the mainframe to function, and are unaffected by its upgrades (e.g. it does not give them the ability to fly if they do not fly by default), although Back-Up/Henchmen I in the mainframe is required to re-obtain their trinkets in the dispenser.

Normal Back-Up or Henchmen are summoned for 50 seconds and the cooldown is 180 seconds. Elite Back-Up or Henchmen are summoned for 90 seconds and the cooldown is 240 seconds. The cooldown starts at the moment they are summoned. The cooldown is shared between all versions of the trinkets - including both normal and elite; the cooldown applied is the same for both and it depends on which one was used (e.g. if elite was used, the cooldown is 240 seconds for both types of trinkets).

sections.title: Appearance and Upgrades
items: Henchmen and Backup can be upgraded via the Mainframe, with each upgrade allowing the NPC to be more effective in supporting the player in combat.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Base Amenity: Sparring Target takes on the appearance of the Henchmen/Backup associated with the lair it is positioned within.

Prior to game update 47 there were 5 possible levels for your Backup/Henchmen. Levels 1 and 2 are unchanged, but previously level 3 only summoned a 3rd reinforcement. Level 4 added the ability for the reinforcements to fly and level 5 was the same as level 3, today.

Originally there had been a clear distinction between Backup for heroes and Henchmen for villains. With the advent of loot drops and vendor items of this kind, now most are in the Henchmen category only.

title: Costumes
summary: Any superhero or supervillain of course needs a costume.

sections.title: Overview
items: Any superhero or supervillain of course needs a costume.
Costumes in the game can be armor or simple style items. A costume set all of the same style is called a costume style set.

Players have a certain amount of control over their appearance. Any style previously collected by a player can be selected as the active player style, regardless of the armor the player currently has equipped.

images.label: Complete costume set displayed at a vendor

sections.title: Armor
items: Armor pieces typically include a durability level and increase the player character's statictics. They have an item level which originally also affected the combat rating of the character wearing it. Certain pieces of equipment may require a player to have various skills or proficiencies or ability levels. Armor pieces have styles which represent their visual appearance. There is different armor for PvE and PvP since those game modes require different statistics to be boosted.

Armor can be acquired as loot dropping from defeated enemies (PvE only) or by buying it from vendors (PvE and PvP). Once collected they appear as item in the inventory and can be equipped, often also be salvaged or sold if not needed anymore.
To collect the visual style of an armor piece it needs to be equipped at least once.

sections.title: Styles
items: DC Universe Online also features styles items, which merely represent a visual appearance and will not change the statistics in any way.

Style items usually drop in The Vault or come as a reward for finishing collections, investigations and briefings. During seasonal events they sometimes also drop from defeated enemies. Once used the style items will disappear from the inventory and then their style will be accessible as equipable styles via the style menu.

sections.title: Costume Pieces
items: Some equipment classes like rings, necklaces and trinkets do not have a visual representation on the player character and thus count as items only.

title: Donation Box
summary: Donation Boxes are consoles found in League Halls, the Hall of Doom and in the Watchtower that allow League members to exchange items for Prestige.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Donation Box in the Watchtower.
Donation Boxes are consoles found in League Halls, the Hall of Doom and in the Watchtower that allow League members to exchange items for Prestige.
Their UI is split into three tabs: Tribute, Donate, and Decorations.

This tab allows you to directly convert an item into Prestige, destroying the item in the process. This allows you to both get value from undesired items, as well as convert currencies to Prestige by purchasing items with that currency, then Dematerializing them.

The Prestige value of an item is generally based on its value to vendors, whether buying or selling. The more difficult it is to obtain a currency, the greater the Prestige value of items purchased with that currency. For instance, items purchased with cash are generally worth far less Prestige than items purchased with Marks of Fury. The Prestige value of an item can be found in its tooltip.

This tab allows base items to be donated to the League Hall's decoration inventory. Doing so generates Prestige equivalent to 10x the amount of Prestige the decoration could earn per week if placed in a personal base.
This tab shows the list of base items in the League Hall's decoration inventory
Sale value of an item is multiplied by the number to get the Prestige value.
Anything that would be worth less than 1 is worth no Prestige.

sections.title: Affinity Generator Mods
items: Affinity Generator Mods can be bought from a special vendor in the Tech Wings of the Watchtower and the Hall of Doom or Captain Atom on the Main Observation Deck of the House of Legends. They provide an additional boost or buff if the player is wearing two (A), four (B), six (C) or eight (D) pieces of elite gear ( episode 16 or better).

sections.title: Trivia
items: Pool Generator Mods were initially named Health & Power Generator Mods.
In all other areas of the game, Dominance is blue and associated with Fortified Exobits. In a generator, it is yellow and listed with Support Generator Mods.
The rarity of the mods increases with the last number in their name.

Originally v*.2 generator mods were vendor items only. Later this was not handled strictly anymore. There are v*.2 generator mods that merely drop as loot and several tiers that are available at vendors and drop as loot as well.
The stats revamp introduced with game update 73 changed the stats of all generator mods.

With the introduction of Augments all generator mods formerly acquirable through the process of Research and Development - that is from Amazon Fury Part III onward to the Deluge episode - became loot drops and all related feats are now auto-granted.

title: Iconic Battle Suits
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
This page has been heavily outdated by the introduction of new tiers and scaling gear in game update 116.
Not to be confused with Iconic Equipment.

Iconic Battle Suits are full Armour Style sets awarded to players by iconic heroes and villains in exchange for select tokens and currency. Primarily available from either the JLA Watchtower or the Hall of Doom, unless otherwise stated, Iconic Battle Suits are some of the statistically strongest armour sets available for players, who are able to purchase via obtaining and exchanging Marks earned in specific PvE and PvP content. Certain Iconic Battle Suits require specific DLC Episodes. As of Game Update 94, a majority of sets that are priced in Source Marks can be found at the vendor Mechanical Supply Officer located in the middle of Headquarters and in every Safe House, which no longer require the Episodes they were previously introduced in, however the feat associated with completing the set will not be rewarded unless you have the required Episode or Membership. All Tier 1 to Tier 4 PvE, Tier 0 to Tier 4 PvP and Retired PvP Iconic Battle Suit Style only versions are available from Promethium Lockbox.

title: LexCorp
summary: Originally organized as an aerospace engineering firm, LexCorp has since become one of the world's largest and most diversified multi-national corporations.

sections.title: Overview
items: Originally organized as an aerospace engineering firm, LexCorp has since become one of the world's largest and most diversified multi-national corporations.

Under the management of its founder, president and CEO, Lex Luthor, LexCorp grew and prospered, absorbing scores of smaller businesses in Metropolis until economists once estimated that Luthor employed 2/3rds of Metropolis' eleven million inhabitants.

Through LexCorp, Lex Luthor uses the corporation's limitless resources to finance, support or even create his various plans to feed and further his ambitions whether it is to further a community service project to swing the public's opinion in his favor or to build a new weapon to crush his Kryptonian nemesis; Superman.

sections.title: Villains
items: As a supporting Faction member, Villains can gain trust with LexCorp through completing certain missions or collecting Bounties and gain access to rare and powerful items and equipment from LexCorp Vendors.
Villains can obtain the LexCorp Logo as an Emblem if they have full Trusted renown with the faction.

sections.title: Trivia
items: While only trusting a scant few people in the world, and regarding fewer of any personal value, one of LexCorp's employees that Luthor seems to trust thoroughly is his Amazonian bodyguard and assistant, Mercy Graves. Although he ultimately considers her, too, to be disposable.

During the time of U.N. funded Justice League International, Maxwell Lord's ex-wife, Claire Montgomery, created the corporate sponsored team, The Conglomerate, as competition for the Justice League team. Companies that provided sponsorship to the team included American Steel, Dante Foods, Dupree Chemical, Ferris Aircraft, LexCorp, Ovel Oil, Pax Entertainment, Stagg Enterprises and S.T.A.R. Labs. The team has since dissolved.
LexCorp's first breakaway patent was the "Lex Wing", a military airplane that Lex claimed made him an aeronautical revolutionary on the scale of John Glenn, or Neil Armstrong.

title: Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund
summary: Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund ia an 8-player Tier 2 Raid included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund ia an 8-player Tier 2 Raid included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

Travel to your New God allies’ homeworld and recover an artifact that has been located somewhere deep in the Necropolis on the planet. Hordes of Dreggs stand in your way, and in order to defeat them you will need to wield the awesome power of the Old Gods. Can you master their ancient weapons and recover the artifact before the enemy?
The Raid is located under Tier 2 of the 8 Player Tab.

sections.title: Heroes
items: Darkseid's forces are searching for a powerful relic in the Necropolis on Apokolips. You must recover this ancient item before his army!

sections.title: Villains

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This is a very easy and fast raid, excellent for grinding Source Marks. The only mild annoyance is making sure no one gets lost in the maze-like tunnels or stuck outside boss fights. Despite the interconnected map, usually only one path at a time is unlocked.

After defeating the first boss, a pickup icon shows on a relic, which must be interacted with to proceed. There are 2 relics after defeating the second boss. Interact with the three spots in the final room to fight the final boss.

This is not the same as the optional Urgrund weapons (which has orange "weapon-switch" icons while on the floor). The Urgrund weapons (there is one each of Shield, Brawling, Martial Arts, Rifle, Dual Pistol, but only a random 2 would show up in 1 raid), when interacted with, replaces your weapon. It grants full access to Weapon Mastery, including Cross-Weapon Combos, even if you haven't unlocked the weapon skills yourself. They have unique special effects in combat, and if not picked up, can revive KO'ed Dreggs once, but are not crucial to the raid to have. You can interact with the weapon rack at the beginning of the raid to remove them. They are also dropped to the ground if you are KO'ed or leave the raid.

title: Precision
summary: Precision is combined with Weapon DPS to determine the damage of weapon attacks.

sections.title: Overview
items: Precision is combined with Weapon DPS to determine the damage of weapon attacks.
Weapon Damage = Base Weapon Damage Multiplier * (50% Weapon DPS + 100% Precision)
Precision is a primary stat for Damagers.

Precision can be increased using Artifacts, Augments, Generator Mods and spending Stat Points in Precision. It can also temporarily be increased through the use of consumables such as Flex Soders or Compound Omega.
The Relentless Precision Tactical Mod can temporarily increase Precision.

title: Prefab Mods
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

Prefab Mods are Equipment Mods that can be bought with marks of valor, instead of being crafted with exobytes through research and development. Plans for Prefab Mods do not exist and thus do not have to be researched.
Prefab Mods open up higher level options of mods for free and premium players, as previously they were gated by their cash caps ($1500 and $2000 respectively).
In contrast to Synthetic Mods Prefab Mods are available as mixed-stat mods in tier VI and above.

title: Prestige
summary: Prestige is a league-wide currency earned by League members through a wide variety of activities, including:

sections.title: Overview
items: Prestige is a league-wide currency earned by League members through a wide variety of activities, including:
Defeating final bosses in level 30+ PvE instances
Placing decorations and amenities in your personal base
Donating items to the League in your League Hall
None of the above activities actually require that you do them with other League members.
All Prestige gains are contributed individually.

For example, if four members of the same League get together and run through the same alert which is worth 300 Prestige, each member would individually earn 300 Prestige, meaning the League gets 1200 total Prestige. The same result could be obtained if each of those same four League members completed the same alert across four different groups of people that aren't in their same League.

The Prestige earned from PvE instances is based on the number of people intended to complete it. For example, 8-man instances reward over three times as much Prestige as solo instances. We also dynamically reduce the Prestige rewards if you are completing an instance of a lower tier than what your gear allows.

Each of the base-related sources of Prestige (decorations, amenities, power cells, Mainframe, and Generator Mods) are earned upon entering your base for the first time each week (reset at the same time as weekly loot lockouts). The Prestige for decorations and amenities can be earned once for each of your bases within the same reset period.
For example, let's say you have two bases.

You enter your first base on Monday and get Prestige for how many decorations & amenities you have placed in that base, your power cell level, the Mainframe traits you have, and the Generator Mods you have installed.
You then enter your second base and get Prestige only for how many decorations & amenities you have placed in that base.
On Tuesday, you enter both your first and second base again, but get no Prestige from either because the reset hasn't happened yet.

On Thursday, you enter your second base once more after the reset early in the morning. This time you once again get Prestige for how many decorations & amenities you have placed in that base, your power cell level, the Mainframe traits you have, and the Generator Mods you have installed.
You then enter your first base and get Prestige only for how many decorations & amenities you have placed in that base.
Unlocking individual Statuaries (a feature of League Halls)
Everything that Prestige can be spent on (other than League Hall creation) must be purchased within a League Hall.
There is a weekly maximum for how much Prestige a League can earn (reset at the same time as weekly loot lockouts).
As the League approaches the weekly maximum, Prestige earnings suffer diminishing returns.

The weekly maximum is set such that in general, you must sacrifice the purchase of some Proficiencies if you want to spend your Prestige elsewhere. However, if you are hitting the maximum every week, you can maintain all 13 Proficiencies and still end up with a bit of Prestige to spend elsewhere.
There is a total maximum for how much Prestige a League can store.
Only League members with the "Can Spend Prestige" permission may spend Prestige.
Weekly Soft Cap (where diminishing returns kick in) - 62,500
Base Walk In Values Per Thing
Sale value is multiplied by that number to get the Prestige value.
Anything that would be worth less than 1 is worth no Prestige.
No Prestige is earned from sub-level 30 PvE instances.
Prestige is earned from the same loot tables that award other normal loot from the final bosses, so if you're locked out, you will not gain Prestige.
The minimum combat ratings that determined when and how Prestige was reduced in PvE instances weren't quite what we intended.
There is no penalty to Prestige earned from PvE instances with final bosses of a higher CR than you.

When you defeat a boss that rewards Prestige, your CR is compared to the boss's CR to determine if there should be a reduction in actual Prestige earned. The system consults the following table to place you and the NPC within bands of combat ratings:
This chart corresponds with the final CR for each tier and will generally be the CR of the bosses in each of those tiers.
Basically if you are higher than the CR for the Tier, but lower than the next one, that is your Tier. This is for both your CR and any boss.
For example. If you are CR 83, you are considered Tier 3. This is because you are greater than or equal to 80 but less than 89.
Another example is if you are CR 105, you are Tier 5. This is because you are greater than 94, but less than 106.
The percentage of Prestige you earn in content below your current Tier is based on the the number of Tiers higher you are than the Boss.
If you are three or more Tiers higher than the boss, you get one point of prestige.

title: Re-Spec Device
summary: The Re-Spec Device can be used by players to reset the skills of their superheroes or villains.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Re-Spec Device can be used by players to reset the skills of their superheroes or villains.

The player is given back every skill point accumulated by their character so far (except the initial skill point permanently attributed to their first weapon type); so that he or she may redistribute them.
The Re-Spec Device cannot be used to select a different type of power set as many assume it does.
Aquacultural Area in the JLA Watchtower,
called the R.A.D. kiosk (Recalibrating Attributes Device)
The Pit in the Hall of Doom,
called the B.A.D. kiosk (Biological Adjustment Device)
Training Room in the House of Legends,

It costs a flat fee of $500 to re-spec your points. However, the fee increases with $150 each time you use it. The price lowers back towards $500 for every 24 hours you didn't use the device. For example, if you use it three times in a day, the prices would be $500, $650 and $800; after not using it a day, the price would be $650.
Since the release of Home Turf player bases can get a respec station as base amenity. Their appearance differs for the various base themes.

title: Statuaries
summary: Statuaries are a unique feature of League Halls that allow Leagues to celebrate their members' accomplishments while fostering friendly competition by creating statues of League members based on their performance in various areas.

sections.title: Overview
items: Statuaries are a unique feature of League Halls that allow Leagues to celebrate their members' accomplishments while fostering friendly competition by creating statues of League members based on their performance in various areas.

Within League Halls are a number of pedestals that can be unlocked with Prestige. Once unlocked, any member with "League Hall Admin" permission may select a material and ranking. Once selected, statues are created of the top three League members based on that ranking, made from that material.

sections.title: Materials
items: Materials available are Light Stone, Dark Stone, Bronze, Silver and Gold.
All statues within the same Statuary use the same material. The material and ranking can be changed at any time by members with "League Hall Admin" permission.

The rankings used are based on the League members' activities over the previous monthly cycle (reset on the 1st of each month). Some rankings are based on a single activity, while others may be based on the combination of multiple activities. The rankings are many and varied to allow as much opportunity as possible for a wide assortment of League members to have the opportunity to appear on Statuaries.

sections.title: Achievement List
items: A few examples of activities used for rankings are: Knock Outs, Emotes, Broker Sales or Instances Completed.

Aside from determining which League members appear on the Statuary, the rankings also determine the poses used for each statue. The poses are meant to reflect the themes of the rankings, as well as the activities they are based on.

The appearance of the statues can be adjusted by the League members they represent. An option has been added to all base deco panels (both in personal bases and League Halls) to save your current appearance for use in Statuaries. If you have never saved your appearance in that manner, statues of you will appear as you did when the system went Live.

title: Synthetic Mods
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

Synthetic Mods were Equipment Mods that could be bought with Marks of Victory, instead of being crafted with exobytes through research and development. Plans for synthetic mods do not exist and thus do not have to be researched.
Synthetic Mods opened up higher level options of mods for free and premium players, as previously they were gated by their cash caps ($1500 and $2000 respectively).
There were only single-stat synthetic mods. There were no orange, green or purple ones.
Synthetic Mods were introduced with game update 33 and phased out with game update 73.

title: Tier
summary: Tier can refer generally to content in a video game or more specifically to a special set of endgame armor available from that content level. Normally an endgame set of armor/weapons comes with increased stats as they increase in tier.

sections.title: Overview
items: Tier can refer generally to content in a video game or more specifically to a special set of endgame armor available from that content level. Normally an endgame set of armor/weapons comes with increased stats as they increase in tier.

In DCUO tier refers to the difficulty level of content and strength of equipment from episodes, as measured by combat rating. Once your experience level hits the cap of 30, the vast majority of the game is about raising your combat rating through the tiers by getting better equipment. As of 2026 there are 8 tiers in PvE.
PvP armor has its own system ranging from tier 0 to Tier 5. All armors are available from PvP vendors for Marks of Valor.

sections.title: Tier List
items: With episode 41 ( House of Legends) the PvE tiers were restructured.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Originally there were 10 PvE tiers with the later ones having sub-tiers. PvE content was restructured into 6 tiers in 2021.

The Death of Superman is an anomaly. While it lacks an episode number and was released between Deluge and Teen Titans: The Judas Contract (episodes 31 and 32), Tier 5 episodes, The Death of Superman is considered to be Tier 4 in the On Duty menu.

title: Utility Belt Attachments
summary: Utility Belt Attachments are unique items that, when equipped, increase the amount of trinkets and consumable items the player character can carry.

sections.title: Overview
items: Utility Belt Attachments are unique items that, when equipped, increase the amount of trinkets and consumable items the player character can carry.

Basic Utility Belts can be purchased from the renown vendors located in each Wing (Tech, Magic, Meta) of the player headquarters. Utility Belt Attachments can also be found as rare drops in alerts and raids.
Utility Belt Attachments require the Utility Belt upgrade.

sections.title: Usage
items: When equipped in the trinket slot, a Utility Belt Attachment can offer an additional 2-4 compartment slots with varying purposes; some can be only used for consumable items while others can be only used for trinkets. Higher level Utility Belts will include Wild Card slots that allow the player to equip either a trinket or a consumable.
Some belts also possess locked compartments that can be temporarily unlocked for 60 days with Marks of Victory. Unlocking any slot will cost 5 Marks of Victory.
Attuned gear from more recent episodes, both normal and event versions, have all four slots as Wild Card and permanently unlocked.

sections.title: List
items: Enforcer's Utility Band of the Collective
Healer's Utility Band of the Collective

sections.title: List (continued 2)
items: Taskmaster's Utility Band of the Collective
Vicious Rocketeer Pack of the Brute
Warden's Utility Band of the Collective

sections.title: Trivia
items: Unlocking a slot with Marks of Victory on one Utility Belt unlocks that slot for all Utility Belt Attachments.

Although the player gains the effects of trinkets when equipping them in a Utility Belt Attachment slot (e.g. pets, transformation, etc), the player does not gain the stats that they would had they equipped it in the normal trinket slot.
For Combat Rating calculation, the highest equipped trinket counts, no matter if that is the utility belt itself or another trinket within it.
Prior to March 31st, 2015, Utility Belt access was included in the Hand of Fate DLC pack. Previous owners of the DLC will retain access.

Since game update 73 Utility Belts no longer cost Marks of Victory to unlock their 3rd and 4th slots if present. In addition, most Utility Belt slots are now Wildcards, meaning they can hold either trinkets or consumables. Originally most Utility Belts had a fixed combination of trinket and consumable slots, like e.g. 1/3, 2/2 or 3/1, with few or no wildcards. Thus the rare Utility Belts with wildcards were the most thought-after.

summary: Weapon Equipment Mods are a sub-class of Lair System Dispenser Items called Tactical Mods. These white Equipment Mods can be used to buff the attack, defense or other abilities of the player.

sections.title: Overview
items: Weapon Equipment Mods are a sub-class of Lair System Dispenser Items called Tactical Mods. These white Equipment Mods can be used to buff the attack, defense or other abilities of the player.

sections.title: Tier I
items: Obtained from Tactical Mod Capsule I - Weapon, these require Tactical Mods I unlocked and at least 1 power cell active in the Generator.

table.caption: Tier I
rows: Weapon attacks have a chance to activate a shield, reducing damage by 50% until damage equal to 10% of your Health is prevented. This effect may only occur once every 120 seconds.; Absorb Damage 50% - Self (12 seconds)
Weapon attacks blast your target for additional damage. This effect may only occur once every 60 seconds.
Weapon attacks heal you a small amount. This effect may only occur once every 60 seconds.
Weapon attacks restore additional power. This effect may only occur once every 60 seconds.

sections.title: Tier II
items: Obtained from Tactical Mod Capsule II - Weapon, these require Tactical Mods I and Tactical Mods II unlocked and at least 2 power cells active in the Generator.

table.caption: Tier II
rows: Weapon attacks have a chance to activate a shield, reducing damage by 50% until 500 damage is prevented. This effect may only occur once every 90 seconds.; Absorb Damage 50% - Self (12 seconds)

Weapon attacks have a chance to blast your target and one other nearby enemy for additional damage. This effect may only occur once every 90 seconds.; 20 to 28 Health - Target Area (?); Knockdown - Target Area (2 seconds)
Weapon attacks have a chance to heal you. This effect may only occur once every 90 seconds.
Weapon attacks have a chance to restore additional power. This effect may only occur once every 90 seconds.

sections.title: Boost
items: Obtained from Tactical Mod Capsule III - Weapon, these require Tactical Mods I, Tactical Mods II, and the Boost unlocked, and 3 power cells active in the Generator.

table.caption: Boost
rows: Weapon attacks have a chance to activate a shield, reducing damage by 75% until damage equal to 30% of your Health is prevented. This effect may only occur once every 60 seconds.
Weapon attacks have a chance to blast your target and five other nearby enemies for additional damage. This effect may only occur once every 20 seconds.
Weapon attacks heal you and three other group members a small amount. This effect may only occur once every 20 seconds.
Weapon attacks restore additional power. This effect may only occur once every 20 seconds.

table.caption: Obtained from Marketplace
rows: Weapon Attacks cause an explosion damaging up to 9 additional targets in a 7.5 meter radius for 13% of your Precision.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Usually merely weapons with item level 30 and up have the slot for weapon equipment mods.

Triggering the effect of a Weapon Equipment Mod will trigger the cooldown for all Weapon Equipment Mods, so a cooldown would be in place even if you switch weapons or mods; the cooldown appears to be the longer one between the two you are switching with, if they are not the same.

With game update 47 boost ranks have been consolidated from three to one. Only one unlock is required to fully boost a mainframe ability. Subsequently there were merely three tiers for tactical mods instead of five.

title: Wolf Pack Token
summary: A Wolf Pack Token is a special currency that can only be purchased from the marketplace.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Wolf Pack Token is a special currency that can only be purchased from the marketplace.
A Wolf Pack Token allows you to purchase special Wolf Pack versions of artifacts that are account bound and can be traded to other characters on your account.
A rank 200 integrated artifact is required to purchase and fortify its corresponding Wolf Pack artifact.

sections.title: How It Works
items: Rank up and fortify an artifact to Rank 200.
Purchase a Wolfpack Token from the Marketplace.
Purchase a Rank 0 Wolfpack version of your artifact from the artifact vendor, John Constantine, in the House of Legends.

Fortify the Rank 0 Wolfpack version of your artifact with your Rank 200 artifact.; All XP is transferred and this fortification cannot fail.; This results in a Rank 200 Wolfpack version of your artifact that is account bound.
Wolfpack Artifacts cannot be fortified into other artifacts.
Redeem a Wolfpack Voucher for this artifact, an item that is now visible to you on Constantine in the House of Legends.
Log into any or all other characters on your account.
On each one, you can now redeem a Rank 200 Wolfpack version of your artifact from Constantine in the House of Legends or from your base dispenser.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Wolf Pack artifacts cannot be used to fortify other artifacts if no longer needed.

title: Absolute Amazon Time Capsule
summary: A Absolute Amazon Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 23rd, 2025.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Absolute Amazon Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 23rd, 2025.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through the daily Stabilizer Fragmentation mission.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

title: Level 4 Ally: Mister Freeze
summary: Level 4 Ally: Mister Freeze is an artifact-level item which provides an ally pre-leveled to Affinity Rank 4.

sections.title: Overview
items: Level 4 Ally: Mister Freeze is an artifact-level item which provides an ally pre-leveled to Affinity Rank 4.

sections.title: Biography
items: > "My name is Freeze... learn it well, for it is the chilling sound of your doom!"

Trapped in armor that keeps his body at sub-zero temperatures, Victor Fries is a master of cryogenic technology. Calling him cold a ruthless is an understatement - he'll stop at nothing to save his beloved wife, Nora.
> "Betray me, and I shall send you to an eternal, frozen hell!"

There are several cold-powered villains out there, but none of them have a heart of ice like Victor Fries. Unless you like it cold - and by that, I mean 'sub-zero' - don't get in his way when it comes to saving his frozen wife.

title: Amazon Metal
summary: Amazon Metal is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Amazon Metal is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Wonder Woman (Death Metal) as seen in the Dark Knights episode.

The regular set has Item Level 325, the elite set has Item Level 327, and both can be obtained only Lobo (Vendor) in Death Metal Washington, D.C. and The Catwoman (Episode Vendor) in the headquarters.
The costume style is also available as style items from Star Sapphire Zatanna in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.
The style pieces are also possible rewards in the Wonder Woman Reward Cache. All of them are account bound.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.

title: Amazon Time Capsule
summary: An Amazon Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was released alongside the Amazon Fury Part III episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Amazon Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was released alongside the Amazon Fury Part III episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the new Duo Event, Monster Training. Head to Amazon Underworld to face the children of the God of Monsters! You can find this in your On Duty menu under the “ Events” tab.

Monster Training can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.

title: Ancient Amazon Noble
summary: Ancient Amazon Noble is a Costume Style Set and Iconic Battle Suit for Heroes which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ancient Amazon Noble is a Costume Style Set and Iconic Battle Suit for Heroes which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of the Amazons of Themyscira.

This set has Item Level 100 and 101 and is obtained from the Labyrinth of Lost Souls, Halls of Hades and Throne of the Dead raids. A minimum PvE Combat Rating of 105 for the first two raids, 107 or above for the last raid, and the Amazon Fury Part II episode is pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.
The costume style is also available as style items for heroes and villains from Vending Unit 44 in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Apokoliptian Overlord Time Capsule
summary: A Apokoliptian Overlord Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 24th, 2024.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Apokoliptian Overlord Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 24th, 2024.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through the daily Stabilizer Fragmentation mission.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

title: Arcane Time Capsule
summary: An Arcane Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on July 26th, 2017.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Arcane Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on July 26th, 2017.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the new duo event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmention can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.

The codes to redeem the Batdrone / Flying Jester and other bonus content like Legends Batman character are said to have expired yet some survived. A guy on the fourms posted that he redeemed his in September of 2012 and another was redeemed late of December 2012, 2 years after the collection edition was released

title: Batman Eternal Time Capsule
summary: A Batman Eternal Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 14th, 2023.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Batman Eternal Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 14th, 2023.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Lumos Aura Collection; Perplexing Material Collection; Tut-Tut Emote Collection

Gear; Final Bat-Suitgear; Final Bat-Suit Belt Box; Final Bat-Suit Boots Box; Final Bat-Suit Chestplate Box; Final Bat-Suit Gloves Box; Final Bat-Suit Helm Box; Final Bat-Suit Legplating Box; Final Bat-Suit Shoulderguards Box; Final Bat-Suit Wings Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suitgear; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Belt Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Boots Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Chestplate Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Gloves Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Helm Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Legplating Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Shoulderguards Box; Enhanced Final Bat-Suit Wings Box

title: Bionic
summary: Bionic is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bionic is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Cyborg.
The regular set has Item Level 215, the elite set has Item Level 217, and both can be obtained only from the Titans Equipment Supplier in the headquarters or on Titans Island.
The costume style is also available as style items from Nubia in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.

sections.title: Source
items: Black Cherry Bonbons date back to the original Valentine's Day Event 2011 and are still found during the Love Conquers All event today. A pair of bonbons can be purchased for 4 Hearts or obtained from the Zamaron Love Shard in a player's base. The treat provides a timed buff to the player.

items: "Black Cherry Bonbon" was one of three Consumables that needed to be used in order to earn the feat Life is Like... in 2011. While there was no Valentine's Day Event in 2012, this item was again available in 2013 as part of the Box of Valentine's Candy.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bright Booster is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by Rocket.
The set is available in two distinct forms:
It can be obtained from random mission rewards or drops in Shock to the System content in box form with Item Level 330-353, attuning to your current Combat Rating.

It can be bought as-is from Blue Beetle in Dakota City or The Catwoman (Episode Vendor) in the headquarters for Meta Clinic IDs and from Officer Stone in Dakota City for less Meta Clinic IDs plus Encrypted Schematics. The Item Level is fixed based on tier, up to 340, with the lowest version (Item Level 30) available to players who have reached level 30.
Enhanced Bright Booster gear with item level 10-350 was available for members through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards in May 2023.
The enhanced set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.

title: Bully Buster
summary: Bully Buster is a costume style set for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bully Buster is a costume style set for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by Hammer Harleen/Harley Quinn in Harley Quinn vs. Apokolips content.
The regular set has Item Level 400, the elite set has Item Level 402, and both can be obtained only at Penguin in Apokoliptic Gotham City and The Catwoman (Episode Vendor) in the House of Legends.
The costume style is also available as style items from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Cash
summary: Cash is one of the in-game currencies, and is gained by various means. These include missions, defeating NPC's, and selling items to vendors. It has many uses, but is primarily used to repair damaged equipment or purchase items from vendors.

sections.title: Overview
items: Cash is one of the in-game currencies, and is gained by various means. These include missions, defeating NPC's, and selling items to vendors. It has many uses, but is primarily used to repair damaged equipment or purchase items from vendors.

Free accounts are limited to $50,000 cash. Premium accounts and players with an active subscription have no limit for Cash. If a Free player exceeds this limit, the overflowing cash is locked in Escrow and can only be accessed by upgrading their Membership.
Cash is the currency used to buy and sell items on the Broker.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Free players used to be limited to $1500 cash and premium $2000, which severely restricted vendor options and could lead to inability to repair gear in long raids.
Cash cannot be bought with real-life money, but some items can be bought instead and sold to other players via broker for cash, such as Rare Alliances.

title: Catalyst (Artifacts)
summary: Catalysts (Artifacts) are special items required to break through Milestone Ranks of an artifact. These can be acquired from John Constantine in the Watchtower or Hall of Doom and are also available from the marketplace. Catalyst (Omnipotence) are a subset of Catalyst (Artifacts) specific for use on artifacts that results in a piece of Omnipotence Gear.

sections.title: Overview
items: Not to be confused with Catalyst (Augments).

Catalysts (Artifacts) are special items required to break through Milestone Ranks of an artifact. These can be acquired from John Constantine in the Watchtower or Hall of Doom and are also available from the marketplace. Catalyst (Omnipotence) are a subset of Catalyst (Artifacts) specific for use on artifacts that results in a piece of Omnipotence Gear.
Each Milestone Rank requires a different and specific combination of Catalysts.

sections.title: Artifact Milestone Ranks
items: The higher the milestone rank, the lower the chances for a successful breakthrough are. On a failure the catalysts are destroyed. This can be avoided by using a Seal of Preservation, which will be consumed instead of the catalysts on a failed attempt. For high-level milestone ranks a Seal of Completion is also available, ensuring a successful breakthrough, but being consumed in the process.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Prior to Hotfix 05/07/18 catalysts could be acquired by completing specific duos, alerts, and raids throughout DCUO.
Catalysts are also randomly contained in Kryptonian Time Capsules.
To reach rank 80 - the level at which most artifacts' unique ability unlocks, at the lowest tier - 20 minimum Catalysts are required, estimated 23 on average.

Game update 97 replaced the formerly 21 catalysts with just three new ones. Obsolete catalysts have a "Depowered" prefix added to their names and both them and Catalyst Caches could now be consumed to obtain 10 Source Marks each.

title: Controller Debuff
summary: A Controller Debuff is a Controller role effect that negatively affects an opponent for a short time. They are indicated by red symbols beneath a target's name plate.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Controller Debuff is a Controller role effect that negatively affects an opponent for a short time. They are indicated by red symbols beneath a target's name plate.
There are 3 types of Controller Debuffs:
Damage: Reduces the target's damage output by 10%.
Defense : Reduces the target's defense by 10%.
Healing : Reduces the target's ability to heal by 25%.
Although many of these abilities hit multiple targets, normally the debuff will only be applied to your main target.

table.caption: Controller Debuffs
rows: Gadgets : Gauss Grenade, Stasis Field; Light : Whip Thrash, Light Blast; Mental : Psychic Shock, Telekinetic Pull; Munitions : Five Barrel Minigun, Smoke Grenade Launcher; Quantum : Time Shift, Singularity

Gadgets : Sticky Bomb, Paralyzing Dart; Light : Grasping Hand, Light Weight Strike; Mental : Cryokinesis, Phantom Flames; Munitions : Flak Cannon, Shrapnel Grenade Launcher; Quantum : Warp Barrage, Alcubierre Wave
Gadgets : Napalm Grenade, Cryo-Foam; Light : Entrap, Snap Trap; Mental : Horrific Visage, Pyrokinesis; Munitions : Multi-Net Launcher, Rocket Launcher; Quantum : Anomaly, Gravity Bomb

sections.title: Notes
items: Some Artifacts specifically affect Controller Debuffs.; Parasite's Power Harness restores power and buffs when a Controller Debuff is used.; Amulet of Rao makes Controller Debuffs stronger and affect more targets.; B.O.P. Commlink reduces the duration of Controller Debuffs, but grants a new ability that can apply multiple debuffs, and grant power when hitting a target with 3 debuffs.
Two Affinity Generator Mods can be used to empower controller debuffs: Debuff Efficiency and Debuff Master.

sections.title: Trivia
items: There are other Debuff abilities that are not specific to the Controller role.

The "Controller Debuff" tag was added to specific power descriptions in game update 47. These percentage based Controller Debuffs are more effective with the increased NPC stats introduced in the update. Controller Debuffs can stack according to [1].
A buffed target has to be hit twice with a debuff power in order to debuff it. The first hit neutralizes the buff and the second hit applies the debuff.

title: Inventory Screen
summary: The Inventory Screen is a screen in the Player Character's Menu Interface that allows the player to view the Items, Weapons and Costumes/ Armor they have equipped as well as the items stored in their inventory.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Inventory Screen is a screen in the Player Character's Menu Interface that allows the player to view the Items, Weapons and Costumes/ Armor they have equipped as well as the items stored in their inventory.
Through the Inventory Screen, the player can also view the amount of Cash the character holds and access the Stats, Currency, Forti fy, Augment and Base Sub-screens.
The screen is accessible by pressing "I" (PC), "Start" (PS3), or "Options" (PS4/PS5).

sections.title: Trivia
items: When the Player Character's inventory storage is full, an alert icon will appear below the player's Mini-Map, a similar icon will also appear if any of their equipped costume/armor pieces are broken and in need of repair.
A glitch causes the player with the same settings to be shown with a very dark colours.
Another glitch causes Batman to be displayed instead of the player character.
As part of the Hand of Fate DLC, Players can increase the number of Trinkets and Consumable Items they can carry through the use of Utility Belt.
As of late 2023 an inventory can have up to 28 rows, meaning a player character can max out the inventory to hold 28 * 7 = 196 items at once. Inventory upgrades can be bought from the marketplace.

title: Cursed Gotham Time Capsule
summary: A Cursed Gotham Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 11th, 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Cursed Gotham Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 11th, 2018.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

title: Damaged Lantern
summary: Damaged Lantern is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Damaged Lantern is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Dawnbreaker as seen in Metal Part II.
The regular set has Item Level 255, the elite set has Item Level 257, and both can be obtained only from the Green Lantern Supplier and the Protocol Android Vendor vendors in Thanagar.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Dark Knights Time Capsule
summary: A Dark Knights Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on August 22nd, 2019 before the release of the Metal Part I episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Dark Knights Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on August 22nd, 2019 before the release of the Metal Part I episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Ink Material Collection; Minotaur Helmet Collection; Orange Flux Fire Collection

Gear; Laughing Knightgear; Forbidden Boots Box; Forbidden Belt Box; Forbidden Chains Box; Forbidden Gloves Box; Forbidden Hood Box; Forbidden Jacket Box; Forbidden Leggings Box; Forbidden Shoulderguards Box; Enhanced Laughing Knightgear; Enhanced Forbidden Boots Box; Enhanced Forbidden Belt Box; Enhanced Forbidden Chains Box; Enhanced Forbidden Gloves Box; Enhanced Forbidden Hood Box; Enhanced Forbidden Jacket Box; Enhanced Forbidden Leggings Box; Enhanced Forbidden Shoulderguards Box
Auras; Blue Energy Vortex Aura; Green Mystic Aura; Pink Ultimate Aura; Red Umbral Aura
Also modular versions of all four
Materials; Blue Metal Chroma Pack; Bronze Metal Chroma Pack; Dark Metal Chroma Pack; Green Metal Chroma Pack; Purple Metal Chroma Pack; Red Metal Chroma Pack
Dark Nights Metal Covers (open 15 Dark Knights Time Capsules)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Dark Knights Time Capsule does not contain sub-capsules, but all items directly. A random choice of five items will be presented via Loot Picker once opened.
