title: Dark Robin's Gift
summary: Dark Robin's Gift is an artifact-like item only available in Metal Part I content. It can be ranked up with special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce the Dark Robin's Chain of Omnipotence.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dark Robin's Gift is an artifact-like item only available in Metal Part I content. It can be ranked up with special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce the Dark Robin's Chain of Omnipotence.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Dark Robin in Metal Pt. I: Monsters of Metal
Once obtained, it can be bought for 10 Dark Metal Coins from Sal the Snitch in Metal Gotham City.

references.label: Metal Pt. I: Monsters of Metal

sections.title: Milestone Ranks
items: Dark Robin's Gift has a maximum rank of 3 and can be broken through with the following catalysts:

sections.title: How It Works
items: In Metal Part I, the omnipotent item is a special necklace. The Omnipotent Necklace is obtained using a hybrid system that combines the "Levelling up" method, first introduced with the Chaos Lord's Cloak of Omnipotence in Justice League Dark, and the traditional Omnipotent Collections system that began with Amazon Fury Part III.

Dark Robin's Gift is received from the final boss in the Monsters of Metal raid. Once obtained, players must collect the 3 Omnipotent collections. The rewards for each of these collections are special catalysts, which are used to level up the Dark Robin's Gift item.
Once levelled up, the Dark Robin's Gift will become Dark Robin's Chain of Omnipotence.

sections.title: Trivia
items: As the item is upgraded over time it changes its rarity, rank 0 has uncommon, rank 1 rare, rank 2 epic and rank 3 legendary rarity.

classification.evidence: Dark Robin's Gift is an artifact-like item only available in Metal Part I content. It can be ranked up with special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce the Dark Robin's Chain of Omnipotence.

title: Deadly Katana Time Capsule
summary: A Deadly Katana Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on May 30th, 2024.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Deadly Katana Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on May 30th, 2024.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through the daily Stabilizer Fragmentation mission.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Captured Souls Material Collection; Demon Ink Skin Set Collection; Soul Sliced Hair Collection

Gear; Soulful Katanagear; Soulful Katana Boots Box; Soulful Katana Gauntlets Box; Soulful Katana Jacket Box; Soulful Katana Leggings Box; Soulful Katana Mask Box; Soulful Katana Pauldrons Box; Soulful Katana Sheathed Blade Box; Soulful Katana Wrap Box; Enhanced Soulful Katanagear; Enhanced Soulful Katana Boots Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Gauntlets Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Jacket Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Leggings Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Mask Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Pauldrons Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Sheathed Blade Box; Enhanced Soulful Katana Wrap Box

Emblems; Etrigan Oni Emblem; Outsiders Emblem; Power Kanji Emblem; Sabbac Oni Emblem; Samurai Kanji Emblem; Seeking Sunflower Emblem; Sharp Sakura Emblem; Suicide Squad Emblem; Enhanced Etrigan Oni Emblem; Enhanced Outsiders Emblem; Enhanced Power Kanji Emblem; Enhanced Sabbac Oni Emblem; Enhanced Samurai Kanji Emblem; Enhanced Seeking Sunflower Emblem; Enhanced Sharp Sakura Emblem; Enhanced Suicide Squad Emblem
Katana Doll Accessory (open 15 Deadly Katana Time Capsules)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Deadly Katana Time Capsule does not contain sub-capsules, but all items directly. A random choice of five items will be presented via Loot Picker once opened.

items: The chest emblem on the suit changes depending on which Role the Player Character is in at the time.

Bart Allen has two rings, one is a replica of Barry's, given to him by Wally West, which he uses to house his Impulse costume, and another he uses to store his Kid Flash costume.

title: Demon Figurine
summary: Demon Figurine is a Trinket that temporarily disguises you as a Minion of Greed (male) or a Minion of Lust (female).

sections.title: Overview
items: Demon Figurine is a Trinket that temporarily disguises you as a Minion of Greed (male) or a Minion of Lust (female).

sections.title: Updates
items: Since game update 25 this item cannot be used in PvP arenas anymore.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This form lasts until disabled and does not in any way hamper abilities or combat.

If you use Nature's transformations while transformed by Demon Figurine, you will be turned into a purple version of the animal form, and reactivating Demon Figurine transforms you back into your normal animal colours. Activating Demon Figurine while already in animal form will properly transform you into the demon.; Canine Form in particular has some issues likely due to it being fully non-humanoid. Most abilities have different animations; both Muttabolism and Pack Leader will cause the character to freeze in T-pose and become unable to take most actions. You can still move or use Muttabolism again (it always heals you in any case), or use Emotes, but they do not break out you of this frozen state, which can be done by drinking a Soder Cola or activating certain trinkets (Demon Figurine itself does not work). You can also deactivate Demon Figurine by warping to a different zone via the Map or On Duty.

classification.evidence: Demon Figurine is a Trinket that temporarily disguises you as a Minion of Greed (male) or a Minion of Lust (female).

title: Doomsday (Doomed Metropolis)
summary: Doomsday rampages through Doomed Metropolis, surrounded by a deadly plague, and even Superman is struggling against the monster.

sections.title: Overview
items: Doomsday rampages through Doomed Metropolis, surrounded by a deadly plague, and even Superman is struggling against the monster.

Doomsday is found in the Doomed Metropolis open world zone as part of The Death of Superman. Marked by a skull icon on the minimap similar to other episodic bonus bosses (such as Starro Conqueror and Giant Robot) and also heralded by large red messages given to all players in the open world zone, Doomsday nevertheless has a few differences.
He must be fought for the mission A Reckoning is Beckoning, which is daily instead of weekly.
He has extremely high health, much more so than his peers, but he is not "defeated" in the traditional sense and he instead retreats when his health is down to about 90%.

While he always descends upon Metropolis at the same spot (a crater near the middle to the east of the Doomed Metropolis area) he is also not confined to it and can be found wandering throughout the open world zone and battling Superman. This means players should be cautious of running into other bosses ( Superboy and Steel for villains, Hank Henshaw and Bizarro for heroes; Hank Henshaw in particular because he is often found just east of Doomsday's starting crater).
Finally, he is surrounded by a plague aura so deadly it will kill any player within seconds - Doomsday Plague Probiotic is vital in surviving him.

sections.title: Abilities
items: Doomsday's primary attacks use Brawling combos. He is similar to the version when fought in Doomsday (Raid), but with a few different special attacks.
Charge Slam - Doomsday briefly crouches before running at a target, capable of dealing over 40000 damage.
Doom Spike - Doomsday throws a spike at a target, damaging, grounding and rooting them.
Focused Blast - Doomsday blasts a single target with a devastating Heat Vision.
Rage Rumble - Doomsday repeatedly punches the ground, dealing waves of damage in the immediate area.
Ground Pound - Doomsday jumps and quickly slams down in the same spot.
Spike Wave - Doomsday's poses to strike and then pounds the ground with his fist, sending forth a massive line of stone spikes. Warned by Lethal attack icon.
LexCorp Security Agents on buildings also shoot Doomsday with Rocket Launcher, and the slow-moving rockets explode upon hitting the ground dealing damage to players caught within as well.

sections.title: Trivia
items: When holding Ranged for the continuous attack, pressing the directional keys will change the pose so the character is pointing each gun at a different direction, allowing the player to hit targets almost anywhere around them.

There is a rapid glitch in Jump Shot: In the jumping animation, tapping Melee rapidly to make the player teleport quickly side to side dealing extra melee damage and slightly finishing the jump animation faster. This doesn't happen all the time.

To get into Magnum Round with dealing more damage, go with Lunge Strike > Lifting Strike > Loft Shot > Slip Shot > Jump Shot > Sweep Shot > Magnum Round. Done like this: Hold Melee X3 > Hold Range > Hold Melee X2 > Hold Range

Due to how his parents died, Batman has a strong aversion to guns. When Nightwing worked as a police recruit for the Bludhaven Police Department, Batman wouldn't let him wear his sidearm in the Batcave.
It's safe to say Dual Pistol is the fastest weapon to deal continuous damage and range damage, but also the weapon with the weakest range attack.

The Crimson Avenger (Jill Carlyle) possesses a pair of 1911 Colt handguns that were originally owned by the first Crimson Avenger. These guns are cursed to make whomever wields them serve as a minor Spirit of Vengeance. The guns make Jill mentally relive the death of a victim and then is teleported to their place of burial, from which she is expected to avenge the victim's death but hunting down and killing the culprit. She has thrown the guns away many times and even blown them up but they always return to her holsters and the holsters never come off.

The Dual Pistols can link their combos together: Lunge Strike > Lifting Strike, Loft Shot > Slip Shot, Loft Shot > Jump Shot, Slip Shot > Jump Shot, Jump Shot > Sweep Shot, Jump Shot > Magnum Round, Sweep Shot > Magnum Round. Full auto is the only combo that does not chain.

title: Dystopian Amazon
summary: Dystopian Amazon is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available as enhanced style.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dystopian Amazon is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available as enhanced style.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Donna Troy.
The set has Item Level 225-243 and is also available with Item Level 10-232 from the Detective McNulty in Metal Gotham City and the headquarters.
The enhanced version is tradable, and available as styles from episode content and as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.

title: Elite Henchmen Uplink Device: Envirotech
summary: Elite Henchmen Uplink Device: Envirotech is a trinket that calls in reinforcements. It's exclusively available from the Spring Event.

sections.title: Overview
items: Elite Henchmen Uplink Device: Envirotech is a trinket that calls in reinforcements. It's exclusively available from the Spring Event.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: The Giving Tree / The Misgiving Tree during the Spring Seasonal Event

sections.title: Henchmen Details
items: Big Scoop • Clobber • Home Run • Lunging Smash • Mega Smash • Melee Attack • Ranged Attack

table.caption: Henchmen Details
rows: Weapon; Big Scoop • Clobber • Home Run • Lunging Smash • Mega Smash • Melee Attack • Ranged Attack

sections.title: Notes
items: Envirotech Supervisor is larger and prefers melee attacks, acting similarly to a tank, while Envirotech Biologists are smaller and will attack with ranged abilities from a distance.
Biologists' Nutrient Bubbles are ability pets that heal injured players on contact.
Envirotech henchmen can Heal themselves if they take too much damage with a Drink animation (as if they were drinking Soder Cola).
These henchmen will attack for 86.3 - 87.8 seconds before despawning.
In a test consisting of 5 rounds with CR 512 Henchmen against a single Sparring Target in close range, they deal an average of 9145625 damage, with a minimum of 9032041 and a maximum of 9354843.

In a test consisting of 5 rounds with CR 512 Henchmen against a group of 5 Sparring Targets in close range, they deal an average of 13560626 damage, with a minimum of 11610730 and a maximum of 15040410.
Although it is possible for these henchmen to deal critical hits, they didn't score any critics during the tests above.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This is the very first Elite Back-up. Elite Back-Up or Henchmen deal substantially more damage and have additional effects beyond damage. They also do not require anything unlocked in the mainframe to function, and are unaffected by its upgrades (e.g. it does not give them the ability to fly), although Back-Up/Henchmen I in the mainframe is required to re-obtain their trinkets in the dispenser. The dispenser version is not tradable.
Although not available in PvP arenas, the Nutrient Bubbles heal cross-faction in open world and duels.
Upon release, these henchmen would be left behind if there was any sort of obstacle in their way. Their navigation was later improved.
The Synergy mechanics were added with the introduction of the Ally: Swamp Thing in the Springtime 2026 event. This is the very first pet trinket to have synergy with other items.

sections.title: Feats
items: A Clean Future: Collect the Elite Back-Up Uplink Device: Envirotech (heroes) or the Elite Henchmen Uplink Device: Envirotech (villains) from the 2025 Springtime seasonal event vendor, The Giving Tree (heroes) or The Misgiving Tree (villains) (25 Points)

classification.evidence: Elite Henchmen Uplink Device: Envirotech is a trinket that calls in reinforcements. It's exclusively available from the Spring Event.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Some emblems can only be earned through missions, races, and events, while others can be bought.
The majority of emblems will appear on the front or back of Chest style armour pieces.

Emblem size will depend on whatever it is placed on. For example emblem on Stalwart Defender chest for male characters will be bigger than on T-Shirt chest style. Emblem size and placement may vary for the same costume style depending on if it's on a male or female character.
Emblems for bases are selected individually for each base through Decoration Mode's Color Menu.
Since Home Turf episode there also are base items which can be emblemized, e.g. the Tied Hanging Decorative Drape.

Server Emblems were issued to players as compensation following the move from individual Servers to MegaServers on mid-August, 2011. These emblems represent whichever individual server the player was using before the move.
All regular vendor emblems are also selectable during character creation.

title: Empowered Channeling
summary: Empowered Channeling is a Hands Equipment Mod Lair System Dispenser Item.

sections.title: Overview
items: Empowered Channeling is a Hands Equipment Mod Lair System Dispenser Item.
This White Tactical Mod requires the Tactical Mods Boost to be unlocked and 3 active cells in a lair's Mainframe.

sections.title: Description
items: Channeled super powers are no longer Vulnerable to Interrupt, prevent standard control effects, and increase Defense and Toughness by 5% while active.

This Mod affects Sandblast, Ionic Drain, Absorb Heat, Snuff Out, Fear Gas, Photon Blast, Glacier Flash, Arctic Gust, Avalanche, Freeze Ray, Freezing Breath, Heat Vision, Sonic Shout, Threatening Chainsaw, Minigun, Light Blast, Terrorize, Impaling Thorns, Roar, Bloom, Invocation of Renewal, Final Ruin, Soul Storm, Energy Expulsion, Guardian's Light, Defile, Channel Hate, Chain Gun, Five Barrel Minigun, Particle Gun, Railguns, Rocket Launcher, Small Package, Geiger Beam, Omega Beams, and Torrent.

sections.title: Notes
items: The Empowered Channeling Mod could be useful for a support role that uses one of the affected powers to prevent the long cast from being interrupted.
For example, a Celestial healer that uses Guardian's Light may benefit from the mod.

title: Energy Reaver
summary: Energy Reaver is a costume style set for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Energy Reaver is a costume style set for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by The Reckoning in Day of Reckoning content.
The regular set has Item Level 410, the elite set has Item Level 412, and both can be obtained only at the Kaznian Merchant in Kaznia City and the Episode Vendor in the House of Legends.
The costume style is also available as style items from Ursa in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Availability Scheme
items: In order to acquire the elite gear, first renown with the Laughing Hound Pub needs to be achieved by doing any Day of Reckoning content.
Cooperative (Renown): Elite Head and Elite Hands unlock
Friendly (Renown): Elite Shoulder and Elite Waist unlock
Favorable (Renown): Elite Legs and Elite Feet unlock
Trusted (Renown): Elite Chest and Elite Back unlock

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Energy Reaver's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: Rogue Assassin: Collect all styles in the Energy Reaver set, Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the Head, Chest, Shoulder, Leg, Hand, Feet, Back and Waist Items from the Day of Reckoning vendor. (50 points)

Your Soul Is Mine: Collect all styles in the Enhanced Energy Reaver set, Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the Head, Chest, Shoulder, Leg, Hand, Feet, Back and Waist Items from the Day of Reckoning vendor. (50 points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The style of the Elite gear is called Enhanced Energy Reaver.
Regular and elite gear of the same style would usually differ minimally by the elite set having more glow, sparkle or otherwise enhanced features.
Depleted Siphoner's Veil complements the style since both are based on The Reckoning.

title: Enforcer's Compartment Trinket
summary: The Enforcer's Compartment Trinket is a signet ring with a compartment that contains a low friction bodysuit embued with the Speed Force. The bodysuit temporarily boosts the powers of the user.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Enforcer's Compartment Trinket is a signet ring with a compartment that contains a low friction bodysuit embued with the Speed Force. The bodysuit temporarily boosts the powers of the user.
This trinket temporarily changes the player's appearance and increases their Vitalization stats by 240, and their Dominance stats by 192, for 20 seconds.
It can only be obtained in the Lightning Strikes episode and used by Player Characters who posses the Controller role.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The chest emblem on the suit changes depending on which Role the Player Character is in at the time.

This trinket is based on the Flash's Costume Ring; a small ring with a spring-loaded compartment that Barry Allen uses to conceal his costume while a civilian. By thumbing a small stud on the side, the top of the ring opens and releases the costume, allowing Barry to change clothes when entering super-speed.
Wally West also uses one of these rings.
Bart Allen has two rings, one is a replica of Barry's, given to him by Wally West, which he uses to house his Impulse costume, and another he uses to store his Kid Flash costume.

title: Equipment Interface
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
Not to be confused with Inventory.
Equipment Interfaces are one-use R&D Parts related to the assembly of Equipment Mods.
They are used in conjuction with Exobytes and other R&D-specific items to create Equipment Mods.
While Equipment Interfaces can be bought from any R&D vendor, the extra items required for assembly are obtained mainly through salvaging.
After tier 8 another system to build equipment mods had been introduced.

sections.title: Feats
items: Collecting the full style set unlocks the feat The Immutable (25 points).

classification.evidence: Eternal is an armor style set originally only available for villains. Available from LexCorp Drone "LexCorp Drone 2 (Vendor)") in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends and a vendor in the Hall of Doom's Magic Wing "Magic Wing (Hall of Doom)"). Requires cooperative renown with the Cult of Trigon.

sections.title: Overview
items: Events are seasonal or themed instances or promotions that provide players with unique rewards, items, currency, and seasonal feats. Accessing event content can be rather specific depending on the type of Event — the Events tab on the Menu Interface is the player's best source for direction on how to proceed and begin.

Since 2017 the most recent episode/ chapter features event-level versions of its content in order to let low(er)-level player characters access the newly released content as well. Game update 151 renamed those versions to Story Mode and brought back all related episode content that previously had an event version. Game update 152 renamed them to Casual Mode.
Since early 2025 events and promotions may feature extra Event Progression rewards.

title: Face Styles
summary: Face Styles are the visual representations of the various Face Costume Pieces collected by the Player Character.

sections.title: Overview
items: Face Styles are the visual representations of the various Face Costume Pieces collected by the Player Character.
Once a costume piece is equipped, the player will automatically and permanently have that piece's appearance added to their Style collection, allowing it to be used via the Style Window.

Usually obtained via enemy drops and Treasure Chests, styles may also be collected via Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards, Player Briefings, Investigations and Collections awards, bought from a Vendor or Kiosk, or obtained during special events and promotions.

Face styles are often physically obscured by Head Styles; in some cases, a head style can fully prohibit face styles from appearing, even if they appear to have an open space where the face style would be.

These White equipment Mods can be used to buff the attack, defense or other abilities of the player.

table.caption: Feet Equipment Mods
rows: Your Dodge roll is no longer Vulnerable to Interrupt.; You may also tap the movement controls to cancel out of your dodge roll into a combo.
Requires Agile Movement; You recover 2% of your total Power per second while using Rocket Assisted Glide.
Your Block Counter causes additional damage equal to 5% of your Precision.
Your Block Counter knocks enemies much further away and increases their helpless duration by up to 1 second.
Requires Aerial Movement; Tap melee to perform a Swoop Attack combo following Air Burst, Downdraft, High Pressure, Low Pressure, Swoop Attack or Whirlwind Attack.
Requires Aerial Movement; Recover 6% of your maximum Power over three seconds after performing the Dive Bomb attack.; This effect can occur once every 15 seconds.
Requires Swift Movement; Tap melee to perform a Dash Attack combo following Vortex Trap, Tornado Pull, Cyclone Push, Whirling Dervish or Phase Dodge.
Requires Swift Movement; Recover 6% of your maximum Power over three seconds when using Inertial Flywheel.; This effect can occur once every 15 seconds.

table.caption: Obtained from Marketplace
rows: Your Dodge is no longer vulnerable to interrupt. When performing a Dodge, gain a shield based on 30% of your mx Health that blocks 75% of incoming damage for 12 seconds.

items: The Fighter's Compartment Trinket is a signet ring with a compartment that contains a low friction bodysuit imbued with the Speed Force. The bodysuit temporarily boosts the powers of the user.
This trinket temporarily changes the player's appearance and increases their Might stat by 343, and their Precision stat by 390, for 20 seconds.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The chest emblem on the suit changes depending on which Role the Player Character is in at the time.

This trinket is based on the Flash's Costume Ring; a small ring with a spring-loaded compartment that Barry Allen uses to conceal his costume while a civilian. By thumbing a small stud on the side, the top of the ring opens and releases the costume, allowing Barry to change clothes when entering super-speed.
Wally West also uses one of these rings.
Bart Allen has two rings, one is a replica of Barry's, given to him by Wally West, which he uses to house his Impulse costume, and another he uses to store his Kid Flash costume.

title: Flashpoint Time Capsule
summary: A Flashpoint Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on August 6th, 2020 shortly after the release of the Wonderverse episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Flashpoint Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on August 6th, 2020 shortly after the release of the Wonderverse episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Future Flash Cowl Collection; Madness Chroma Collection; Lasso of Truth Style Collection

Gear; Amazonian Conquerorgear; Amazonian Conqueror's Belt Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Breastplate Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Cape Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Gauntlets Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Helm Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Legguards Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Sabatons Box; Amazonian Conqueror's Shoulderguards Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conquerorgear; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Belt Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Breastplate Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Cape Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Gauntlets Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Helm Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Legguards Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Sabatons Box; Enhanced Amazonian Conqueror's Shoulderguards Box

Emblems; Blackout; Flashpoint Aquaman Emblem; Flashpoint Batman Emblem; Flashpoint Cyborg Emblem; Flashpoint Joker Emblem; Flashpoint Wonder Woman Emblem; Subject 0 Emblem; Subject 1 Emblem; Enhanced Blackout; Enhanced Flashpoint Aquaman Emblem; Enhanced Flashpoint Batman Emblem; Enhanced Flashpoint Cyborg Emblem; Enhanced Flashpoint Joker Emblem; Enhanced Flashpoint Wonder Woman Emblem; Enhanced Subject 0 Emblem; Enhanced Subject 1 Emblem
Half-Up Ponytail Hairstyle (open 15 Flashpoint Time Capsules)

items: The Flashpoint Time Capsule does not contain sub-capsules, but all items directly. A random choice of five items will be presented via Loot Picker once opened.

title: Form: Angry Gorilla
summary: Form: Angry Gorilla is a toy trinket that transforms the player into an Angry Gorilla.

sections.title: Overview
items: Form: Angry Gorilla is a toy trinket that transforms the player into an Angry Gorilla.

sections.title: Updates
items: Since game update 25 this item cannot be used in PvP arenas anymore.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This transformation lasts for a set period of time and changes the abilities loadout. It is not advisable to use this trinket in combat.

The trinket restores power on activation which is why it often can be seen being activated in the dueling areas in the Watchtower and the Hall of Doom. Merely two trinkets are known to have this effect, the other being the Form: Robot Pterosaur.

classification.evidence: Form: Angry Gorilla is a toy trinket that transforms the player into an Angry Gorilla.

title: Gotham Time Capsule
summary: An Gotham Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 27th, 2017.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Gotham Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on September 27th, 2017.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmention can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.
Gotham Collector's Capsule; Energy Vortex Aura Collection; "Riddle Me This" Aura Collection; Sandstorm Aura Collection

sections.title: History
items: The Void Wind is one of the 9 Dark Forces of the Multiverse — the other 8 being the Still Force, the Invisible Spectrum, the Tear of Extinction, the Black Apple, the Sixth Note, Faithlessness, the Anti-Life Equation, and Chaos Magic). It is the dark reflection of the Sphere of the Gods.

title: Influence
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
Influence is a currency acquired from PVP combat, including Arena PVP and Legends PVP.

sections.title: Acquisition
items: Influence is gained upon completion of a PVP match, with 50 being granted to the winning team, and 25 granted to the losing team. 1 Influence is also awarded for each enemy your team manages to knock out while in a given match.
It can also be exchanged for other currencies at the following rates:
1 x Mark of Legend - > 10 x Influence

sections.title: Usage
items: Influence can be used to purchase level 30 Tier 1 PVP Gear from PVP vendors within the Watchtower and Hall of Doom. For Heroes, these vendors are available in the Reactor Core of the Watchtower. For Villains, these vendors are available in the Power Core of the Hall of Doom.

There are certain vendors that sell PVP all weapon types for all roles, costing 775 influence. These vendors appear after the Diamond Heist PVP event for the winning team. Here ( after update 15 you can buy those weapons at the reactor room in the watchtower)
It is also possible to purchase several level 25 PVP weapons from additional vendors within the various safe houses in Gotham and Metropolis.
As of update 4, players can purchase Tier 2 PVP Gear for Influence.

items: Various gear types can be purchased for different amounts of influence, as follows:

sections.title: Trivia
items: Influence was removed with game update 25, though Influence earned by a player character stayed in his/her inventory and the PvP vendors kept Supply Boxes in store, for which the remaining amount could be used.

title: Joker's Legacy Time Capsule
summary: A Joker's Legacy Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 10th, 2022.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Joker's Legacy Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 10th, 2022.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Doll Skin Set Collection; Joker's Wild Card Accessory Collection; Wild Style Hair Collection

Gear; Two-Faced Clowngear; Two-Faced Clown Belt Box; Two-Faced Clown Boots Box; Two-Faced Clown Gloves Box; Two-Faced Clown Gramophone Box; Two-Faced Clown Hat Box; Two-Faced Clown Leggings Box; Two-Faced Clown Shirt Box; Two-Faced Clown Shoulderpads Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clowngear; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Belt Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Boots Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Gloves Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Gramophone Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Hat Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Leggings Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Shirt Box; Enhanced Two-Faced Clown Shoulderpads Box

Emblems; All Smiles Joker Emblem; Bombshell Joker Decal Emblem; Clockwork Flower Emblem; Crown of Clownery Emblem; Demented D Emblem; Diamond Trio Emblem; Ha Ha Ha Emblem; Twisted Smile Emblem; Enhanced All Smiles Joker Emblem; Enhanced Bombshell Joker Decal Emblem; Enhanced Clockwork Flower Emblem; Enhanced Crown of Clownery Emblem; Enhanced Demented D Emblem; Enhanced Diamond Trio Emblem; Enhanced Ha Ha Ha Emblem; Enhanced Twisted Smile Emblem
Joker Doll Accessory (open 15 Joker's Legacy Time Capsules)
Ally: Bombshell Harley Quinn (open 25 Joker's Legacy Time Capsules)

items: Journeyman's Boots is a name used in various fantasy MMORPG's for a set of footwear that increases travel speed, including World of Warcraft and Everquest I & II.

title: Knight of Vengeance Time Capsule
summary: A Knight of Vengeance Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on March 18th, 2021 shortly before the release of the World of Flashpoint episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Knight of Vengeance Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on March 18th, 2021 shortly before the release of the World of Flashpoint episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Element Mist Aura Collection; Swindler Mask Collection; Resistance Ponytail Pack Collection

title: Lethal attack
summary: Lethal attack, sometimes known as Special attack, Massive attack or Skull attack, is an ability used by some enemies that is signified by a skull sign above them moments before they unleash the attack, allowing players to prepare, dodge, defend against or interrupt them. sections.title: Overview
items: Lethal attack, sometimes known as Special attack, Massive attack or Skull attack, is an ability used by some enemies that is signified by a skull sign above them moments before they unleash the attack, allowing players to prepare, dodge, defend against or interrupt them. If the opponent using a Lethal attack is outside of view, the skull sign would instead appear on the side of the screen, pointing to the left or right depending on where the opponent is (and both if they are directly behind you).

Brainiac Overseer on the Brainiac Harvester Ship is the first opponent faced to use a Lethal attack "Overload Slam" in which it runs in place with an orange aura before charging, allowing players to block in time.

sections.title: Trivia
items: "Lethal attack" appears to only be named in-game in the old version of The Awakening (where the Brainiac Overseer must be fought solo by the player and acts as a tutorial for Lethal attacks). It might very well be a generic term and not a proper one, but it is kept as a placeholder. Players also often refer to it as a Skull attack (or 'red skull' or red skull icon') due to the icon having a skull in it.

Not all deadly attacks in the game are indicated by the skull icon. However there would always be a distinct visual and/or audible tell like for example a certain movement like raising an arm or saying the same sentence beforehand.

In elite content skull attacks must be blocked or sometimes evaded as not reacting properly would mean certain knockout. Exceptions can only be made for skull attacks which aim merely at one player or in a certain direction only.

title: LexCorp Exclusive Time Capsule
summary: A LexCorp Exclusive Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on July 7th, 2022.

sections.title: Overview
items: A LexCorp Exclusive Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on July 7th, 2022.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

title: Mark of Victory
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

Marks of Victory are a form of Currency awarded to players though various PvE activities. They are used to purchase Tier 1 through Tier 9 PvE Iconic Battle Suits, certain Research and Development materials, Catalyst Caches, Artifacts from John Constantine, and miscellaneous items.
They have been replaced by Source Marks.

sections.title: Acquisition
items: Most instances that grant Marks of Victory has a Combat Rating cap; above that cap, only 1 or 2 marks would be available occasionally.
By doing the daily Toyman mission on Stryker's Island
Through defeating a Hard Alerts's Boss: Area 51, ACE Chemicals, Watchtower Containment, Smallville, Strykers Island, and Arkham Asylum
Through completing Missions or Briefings found in Hard Alerts: Area 51, ACE Chemicals, Watchtower Containment, Smallville, Strykers Island, and Arkham Asylum
Converted from Marks of Krypton, Distinction, Strategy, Tactics, and Momentum

Doing event versions of Challenges, Duos, Alerts, and Raids from episode content if you are below the minimum Combat Rating required of the normal version, or completing daily or weekly missions if you fall within the Combat Rating range.

Sometimes marks of victory are directly added to the player's currency tab. Other times they are put into the inventory, and the player may redeem them by right clicking. This does not work if the player already has an overflow of items. When the player deletes an item to do this, it may glitch and prevent the player from redeeming the marks. This could usually be solved by removing another item.

sections.title: Usage
items: Marks of Victory are used to purchase Iconic PVE gear from one of the three origin's vendors. These vendors can be found standing next to a display case showcasing the armor that they are selling.
(for heroes) In the Watchtower, in the top right area of each wing;
(for villains) in the Hall of Doom, in the bottom right area of each wing near the entrance to the Pit.

Marks of Victory can also be used at the faction vendors in the JLA Watchtower and the Hall of Doom to buy starter PVE sets (CR 34) for a total of 8 marks. Players must have reached the cooperative renown level with a faction to buy its set. If they reach the trusted renown level, they can also buy the faction's emblem for 1 mark of victory. Marks can be used to buy Commendations for 25 marks, that will grand 125 renown with that specific faction.
Marks of Victory can be used to buy Triumph Tokens so player can complete their Tokens of Merit feats.
Marks of Victory can also be used in the Lair System to buy the features off the mainframe, after first activating the energy cells.

Marks from instances are doubled (such as Challenges, Duos, Alerts, Raids, as well as the event versions of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract content). However, only the marks awarded by the instance itself is doubled - some bosses in them may have marks available as a possible option via Loot Picker and those aren't doubled.

In addition to this set gear, Marks of Victory can be used to purchase additional PVP gear from the PVP vendors located in The Reactor Core (Heroes), or the Hall of Doom (Villains). More powerful weapons are also available from the Ring War PVP event in Metropolis, or the Diamond Heist PVP Event in Gotham , where a vendor will appear upon your faction's victory.

title: Mark of War
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

Marks of War are a type of currency earned from Tier 4 Raids, Operations and Alerts. They are used to purchase Tier 4 PvE Iconic Battle Suits. A player can earn up to 14 Marks of War a week prior to the addition of Batcave: Inner Sanctum as an tier 4 alert.

After an update, tier 4 content no longer gives mark of war but instead Mark of Triumph. All tier 4 armors are now bought with mark of triumph and all existing mark of war could be traded for mark of triumph in the 1:125 ratio.

sections.title: Acquisition
items: Previously, Marks of War can only be obtained in content found from The Battle for Earth and The Hand of Fate DLC packs. After an update, Batcave: Inner Sanctum is added as a tier 4 alert with the only requirement being a combat rating of 70, although this is very hard to obtain as a free player.
The Battle for Earth includes two tier 4 raids:; Themyscira: Gates of Tartarus; The Prime Battleground

The Hand of Fate includes two 8 player operations (tier 4):; With a Vengeance (heroes); A Black Dawn (heroes); Unpaid Dues (villains); Seeds of Rot (villains); As well as a 4 player operation (tier 4):; Wayward Souls (heroes); Soul Alchemy (villains); Arcane Edicts, mini missions gotten from successfully doing The Hand of Fate instances

sections.title: Usage

title: Medic's Compartment Trinket
summary: The Medic's Compartment Trinket is a signet ring with a compartment that contains a low friction bodysuit embued with the Speed Force. The bodysuit temporarily boosts the powers of the user.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Medic's Compartment Trinket is a signet ring with a compartment that contains a low friction bodysuit embued with the Speed Force. The bodysuit temporarily boosts the powers of the user.
This trinket temporarily changes the player's appearance and increases their Restoration stats by 432, and their Power stats by 1039, for 20 seconds.
It can only be obtained in the Lightning Strikes episode and used by Player Characters who posses the Healer role.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The chest emblem on the suit changes depending on which Role the Player Character is in at the time.

This trinket is based on the Flash's Costume Ring; a small ring with a spring-loaded compartment that Barry Allen uses to conceal his costume while a civilian. By thumbing a small stud on the side, the top of the ring opens and releases the costume, allowing Barry to change clothes when entering super-speed.
Wally West also uses one of these rings.
Bart Allen has two rings, one is a replica of Barry's, given to him by Wally West, which he uses to house his Impulse costume, and another he uses to store his Kid Flash costume.

Superpower Damage = Base Superpower Multiplier * (100% Might)

The Escalating Might Tactical Mod can temporarily increase Might.

summary: The Mystical Legs of the Satyr are a rare style item in the legs costume class.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: The item is a reward for finishing the collection Broken Amazon Weapons.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Satyrs and Satyresses have a hyper strong libido that has led to their species becoming most famous for their active pursuit of sex and all things sexual. When aroused, they seem to harbour no discrepancy for the age, gender or species of their consort, and only care for the amount of sexual gratification they can give and obtain from them.

A famous legend pertaining to Zeus assuming the form of a satyr goes as follows: Antiope was a princess of the Boeotian city of Thebe and the daughter of Nycteus; prince of Thebes and Polyxo (although the river god Asopus was her real father). Antiope's stunning beauty immediately attracted Zeus, who assumed the form of a satyr, approached Antiope while she and her entourage were reclining on Mt Cithairon, and forced her into having sex with him while her handmaidens were being similarly forced into fornicating by a group of satyrs who had witnessed and become emboldened by Zeus' actions. When Antiope was with child, her father threatened to kill her for the loss of her chastity and she ran away to Sikyon, where she married Epopeus, the king of Sikyon. Nycteus killed himself in despair, but charged his brother Lycus to avenge him on Epopeus and Antiope. Lycus accordingly marched against Sicyon, took the town, slew Epopeus, and carried Antiope with him to Eleutherae in Boeotia. During her imprisonment there she gave birth to two sons, Amphion and Zethus, who she was forced to abandon, but were found and brought up by shepherds. Hermes, as god of music, gave Amphion a lyre, who practiced song and music, while his brother spent his time in hunting and tending the flocks. Meanwhile, Antiope had been very ill-treated by Lycus and his wife, Dirce, as their prisoner but managed to escaped from her prison when her chains became "miraculously loosened" by Zeus. Fleeing Lycus' pursuit, Antiope found shelter within her son's house. With the gods' help, Antiope's sons recognized their mother and went to Thebes to avenge her mistreatment. Amphion and Zethus captured Queen Dirce on Mt Cithairon as she was celebrating the revels of Dionysus and tied her to a bull to be torn apart before slaying King Lycus and seizing the throne of Thebes. While their cause was just, Dionysus was offended by the death of his devotee (Dirce) and drove Antiope into a state of madness in retribution. In this condition Antiope wandered about Greece, until Phocus of Tithorca, prince of Corinth, cured and married her. Antiope and her sons, Amphion and Zethos, were later honoured as heroes at Thebes. Unlike most heroes however--which produced long lines of descendants--their house was cut short by the untimely deaths of the twins and their children due to the hubris of their wives. Some say that one of Amphion's daughters, Chloris, survived, and that she became the mother of the Trojan War hero Nestor.

title: Mystical Magician Time Capsule
summary: A Mystical Magician Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on January 28th, 2025.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Mystical Magician Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on January 28th, 2025.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through the daily Stabilizer Fragmentation mission.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Arcane Glyph Accessory Collection; Reaper Mask Style Collection; Spellbound Skin Set Collection

Gear; Mystical Magiciangear; Mystical Magician's Coat Box; Mystical Magician's Gloves Box; Mystical Magician's Hat Box; Mystical Magician's Pants Box; Mystical Magician's Sheathed Scythe Box; Mystical Magician's Shoes Box; Mystical Magician's Shoulders Box; Mystical Magician's Waistband Box; Enhanced Mystical Magiciangear; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Coat Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Gloves Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Hat Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Pants Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Sheathed Scythe Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Shoes Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Shoulders Box; Enhanced Mystical Magician's Waistband Box

Emblems; Happy Inverted Pentacle Emblem; Hellblazer Spell Emblem; Hellspawn Ward Emblem; Midnite Club Emblem; Pain Ward Emblem; Raven Skull Emblem; Shield Magic Emblem; Vision Magic Emblem; Enhanced Happy Inverted Pentacle Emblem; Enhanced Hellblazer Spell Emblem; Enhanced Hellspawn Ward Emblem; Enhanced Midnite Club Emblem; Enhanced Pain Ward Emblem; Enhanced Raven Skull Emblem; Enhanced Shield Magic Emblem; Enhanced Vision Magic Emblem

title: Neck Equipment Mod
summary: Neck Equipment Mods are a sub-class of Lair System Dispenser Items called Tactical Mods.

sections.title: Overview
items: Neck Equipment Mods are a sub-class of Lair System Dispenser Items called Tactical Mods.
These White equipment Mods can be used to buff the attack, defense or other abilities of the player.

sections.title: Neck Equipment Mods
items: Additionally available is Guardian Angel, which was originally available through Time Capsules. It is now available in any Neck Tactical Mod Capsule.

table.caption: Neck Equipment Mods
rows: Increases your Defense by an additional 10% while not blocking.
Blocking increases your Defense by an additional 10%.
Increases your Power Critical Chance by 1% for 6 seconds each time you use Defibrillator, Recharge, Psychic Empowerment, Temporal Extortion or Reload.; This effect stacks with itself.
Increases your Critical Power Chance by 5% for 6 seconds when you use a Group Power Heal.
Increases your Restoration by 70 until you are hit by an attack.; This effect is reapplied every 10 seconds.
Increases your Restoration by 5% until you are hit by an attack.; This effect is reapplied every 10 seconds.
Increases your Might by 22 for 8 seconds each time you hit an enemy with a harmful super power.; This effect can stack up to three times. Does not work with Supercharge powers.
Increases your Might by 2% for 8 seconds when you hit an enemy with a harmful super power. Does not work with Supercharge powers.
Increases your Precision by 39 while you maintain the hit counter above 9 and for six seconds afterward.; 39 Precision - Self (6 seconds)
Increases your Precision by 4% while you maintain the hit counter above 9 and for six seconds afterward.

rows: Increases Might by 25% and Precision by 30% for 4 seconds once you attain a hit counter above 25.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Only neck equipment with item level 25 and up has a slot for neck equipment mods.

Originally all Tactical Mods had a cap of four items. Once you had four pieces of the same mod in your possession, the mod in question would disappear from the Dispenser until you delete or salvage the modded gear piece or overwrite it with another Tactical Mod. This was later removed with an update.

title: Neon Technomancer Time Capsule
summary: A Neon Technomancer Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 2nd, 2023.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Neon Technomancer Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 2nd, 2023.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.
Collections; Hecate's Crown Accessory Collection; Cybernetic Hair Collection; Cybernetic Skin Set Collection

Gear; Cybernetic Sorceressgear; Cybernetic Sorceress Apparatus Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Belt Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Boots Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Cuirass Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Gauntlets Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Prosthetic Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Shoulderguards Box; Cybernetic Sorceress Visor Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceressgear; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Apparatus Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Belt Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Boots Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Cuirass Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Gauntlets Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Prosthetic Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Shoulderguards Box; Enhanced Cybernetic Sorceress Visor Box
Materials; Royal Sorceress Neon Chroma Pack

Emblems; Cyber-Beastiamorph Emblem; Digital Sunset Emblem; Ensorcelled Reality Emblem; Ghost-Maker Emblem; Glitched Skull Emblem; Hecate Tag Emblem; Integrated Circuit Emblem; Serial Code Emblem; Enhanced Cyber-Beastiamorph Emblem; Enhanced Digital Sunset Emblem; Enhanced Ensorcelled Reality Emblem; Enhanced Ghost-Maker Emblem; Enhanced Glitched Skull Emblem; Enhanced Hecate Tag Emblem; Enhanced Integrated Circuit Emblem; Enhanced Serial Code Emblem
Circe Doll Accessory (open 15 Neon Technomancer Time Capsules)

sections.title: Trivia

title: Ninth Tride Tyrant
summary: Ninth Tride Tyrant is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ninth Tride Tyrant is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Corum Rath as seen in Atlantis (Episode).
The regular set has Item Level 225, the elite set has Item Level 227, and both can be obtained only from the Supplier Sibyl in the headquarters or in Atlantis.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items named Tride Tyrant from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Availability Scheme
items: While visible to all players with a Combat Rating of at least 241 in the event version of the vendor, both sets require membership or ownership of Atlantis to purchase.
In order to acquire the elite gear, first renown with the Undercurrent needs to be achieved by doing the elite version of the Atlantis: Crown of Thorns and Atlantis: The Throne raids.
Cooperative (Renown): Elite Head and Elite Hands unlock
Friendly (Renown): Elite Shoulder and Elite Waist unlock
Favorable (Renown): Elite Legs and Elite Feet unlock
Trusted (Renown): Elite Chest and Elite Back unlock

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Ninth Tride Tyrant's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: The Dictator's New Clothes: Collect all styles in the Ninth Tride Tyrant set. Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the Head, Shoulder, Legs, Hands, Feet, Back, and Waist items from the Supplier Sibyl. (50 Points)

Terror from the Deep: Collect all styles in the Enhanced Ninth Tride Tyrant set. Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the elite Head, Shoulder, Legs, Hands, Feet, Back, and Waist items from the Supplier Sibyl (50 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The style of the Elite gear is called Enhanced Ninth Tride Tyrant.
Regular and elite gear of the same style would usually differ minimally by the elite set having more glow, sparkle or otherwise enhanced features.

title: Notorious Time Capsule
summary: An Notorious Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on November 20th, 2017.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Notorious Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on November 20th, 2017.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmention can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.
Notorious Collector's Capsule; Chrome Material Collection ( now rewards Metallic Material); Crimson Kryptonian Aura - Hands Collection; Umbral Aura Collection

sections.title: Time Capsule Versions
items: Regular time capsule count stands at: 37

sections.title: Trivia
items: Initially the Visitor's gear from this Time Capsule did not grant the Earth 3 episode related feat to increase the drop chance of the golden op collection items. This was changed with Hotfix 22/11/17.

classification.evidence: An Notorious Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on November 20th, 2017.

title: Oracle's Time Capsule
summary: A Oracle's Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 20th, 2020 before the release of the Birds of Prey episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Oracle's Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on February 20th, 2020 before the release of the Birds of Prey episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

sections.title: Overview
items: Orbital Strike is an Uplink Device type trinket activated by the Player Character to support them in combat by dealing a large amount of damage to a targeted enemy and all other enemies in that target's vicinity. Lair System access is necessary to use these trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. Some trinkets are awarded from Events or Story Arcs content.

sections.title: Details
items: Level 1 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals damage to your target and nearby enemies.
Level 2 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals increased damage to your target and nearby enemies.
Level 3 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals massive damage to your target and nearby enemies.

sections.title: Elite Uplink Device
items: Various Elite Uplink Devices unleash unique versions of Orbital Strike with different mechanics. They are identified by the "Elite Uplink Device" in their names and are of Legendary rarity rather than Epic rarity.
For a comprehensive list of the various versions of this trinket, see the page:

sections.title: Notes
items: The Orbital Strike deals damage against all targets in a small radius, apparently based on a formula that uses the player's Combat Rating. This is further modified by a Damage Modifier specific to the Uplink Device. At 400 Combat Rating, using a basic Uplink Device, Boosted, deals 97047 damage per hit for five hits, or 485235 damage total.

This damage is not reduced when hitting multiple opponents (always at full damage), has no randomization, and cannot crit (although visually it uses a white hitsplat same as weapon attacks). It is generally unaffected by damage boosts.
Boost II additionally roots and stuns all targets hit (this triggers Ally: House of Legends Bot's passive effect).

Orbital Strike can be aimed at a target or at the player's location. The maximum range is exactly the same range as when the targeting reticle on an opponent turns red instead of grey. If used outside of maximum range, it will be used at the player's location.
The stun targeting is technically separate from the damage; if a mob outside of maximum range is targeted, the stun zone can occur around that mob, while the damage zone occurs around the player.
A number of bosses, including Terra in Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn and The Merciless in Metal Pt. I: False Idols, have mechanics that specifically counter Orbital Strikes, discouraging their use.

Certain boss mechanics that reduce all damage taken will also further reduce damage from Orbital Strikes, like Deadly Isis in SoBA: Godseye Pyramid with all orbs, or Neron in SoBA: Neron's Underworld at the beginning of the battle.
Orbital Strike can target targetable objects, subject to the same damage cap of regular attacks.
The Dead King's Scepter artifact can be used to boost the effects of Orbital Strikes.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Previously, it deals damage against all targets in a small radius equal to a percentage of their maximum health (25% default, 35% Boost I, and 45% Boost II) in 5 hits over 2 seconds (or 5%, 7%, and 9% per hit), reduced for bosses. The smallest amount of damage an Orbital Strike can deal in one hit is 10. Targets with less than 200 maximum health are immune to its damage, but not Boost II's control effects. After the damage formula change, Orbital Strikes can now one-shot low level mobs.; Orange Lanterns in the open-world Christmas event, which normally reduces all damage taken to 1 and have 6 total health, can still be damaged by Orbital Strikes (at 1 damage).

Previously, Sparring Targets in the Watchtower and League Halls take reduced damage, but not the Sparring Targets in House of Legends. The latter took 2160000 damage per hit at max rank, indicating that they have 240000000 (24 million) maximum health.
There are many versions of the device. Once a unique device has been equipped, it becomes integrated and untradeable, and can be retrieved infinitely from the Base Dispenser like the regular version.

There are many bosses with attacks that resemble an Orbital Strike of their theme, like Dawnbreaker, Darkfather, and Ultraviolet Nightmare. However, those attack do not use the same damage formula but rather often does massive or one-shot damage if not evaded.
