items: Owlsuit is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of the Owlman.
This set has Item Level 195 and can be obtained only from the Earth 3 Equipment Supplier in Earth 3.
The costume style is also available as style items from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.

title: Paradox Time Capsule
summary: A Paradox Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on January 10th, 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Paradox Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on January 10th, 2018.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmention can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.
Paradox Collector's Capsule; Anti-Matter Cache Collection; Exoskeleton Cache Collection; Forcefield Material Collection

items: Regular time capsule count stands at: 37

title: Powerless Red Daughter Mask
summary: Powerless Red Daughter Mask is an artifact-like uncommon item in the face class. It is only available in Shadows Over Argo content. It can be ranked up with the Red Kryptonite Ore reagent and special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce the Red Daughter Mask of Omnipotence (Elite).

sections.title: Overview
items: Powerless Red Daughter Mask is an artifact-like uncommon item in the face class. It is only available in Shadows Over Argo content. It can be ranked up with the Red Kryptonite Ore reagent and special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce the Red Daughter Mask of Omnipotence (Elite).

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Atlantean Supplier in Sunken Argo City

sections.title: Milestone Ranks
items: Powerless Red Daughter Mask has a maximum rank of 40 and can be broken through with the following catalysts:

table.caption: Milestone Ranks
rows: 5x Red Lantern Energy, 1x Refined Red Kryptonite Shard
10x Red Lantern Energy, 2x Refined Red Kryptonite Shard
15x Red Lantern Energy, 3x Refined Red Kryptonite Shard
20x Red Lantern Energy, 4x Refined Red Kryptonite Shard

sections.title: Feats
items: Masking The Anger: Fortify the Red Daughter Mask to rank 10 (10 Points)
Sunny Spite: Fortify the Red Daughter Mask to rank 20 (25 Points)
Tempers Flare: Fortify the Red Daughter Mask to rank 30 (25 Points)
For the last feat in this series, see Red Daughter Mask of Omnipotence (Elite).

sections.title: Trivia
items: As the item is upgraded over time it changes its rarity, rank 0-9 has Uncommon, rank 10-19 rare, rank 20-29 epic and rank 30-39 artifact rarity.

title: Quark-Gluon Aura
summary: A Quark-Gluon Aura is a Power Interaction activated by specific Atomic powers.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Quark-Gluon Aura is a Power Interaction activated by specific Atomic powers.
A Quark-Gluon Aura grants +7% Critical Strike Chance, +10% Critical Strike Damage and +15% Might while active.

In Tank role, the Quark-Gluon Aura grants +15% Control Resistance, +20% Damage Absorption while not Blocking and attacks heal equal to 2% of max Health. The initial activation of the Quark-Gluon Aura provides immunity to control effects for a short time for up to 7 group members.
A Quark-Gluon Aura can be refreshed by using Atomic Combos which provide Molecular Charges.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Qwardian Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released alongside the Anniversary Anti-Matters event on January 4th, 2017. Currently they are discontinued but old Qwardian Time Capsules can still be opened and traded.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Anti-Matter Research can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.

title: R&D Gear
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
R&D Gear are armor pieces which can be produced through the process of research and development.
R&D plans and R&D parts needed to assemble gear are bound to episode cycles, e.g episode 18, 19 and 20, and will only produce gear dropping from those specific episodes.
Every episode cycle will have items which do not drop from playing content and thus exclusively are available as R&D Gear.

Introduced with game update 54 R&D Gear is primarily meant as a last resort to obtain gear not dropping as loot from doing content. It is not meant to replace the need to play content to get gear, thus its assembly costs and parts gathering time have been made quite expensive.

sections.title: Plans
items: The R&D plans needed to produce R&D Gear are episode specific and can be bought from the episode vendors.
Episodes 15, 16 and 17: Equipment Supplier 151617 (Style: Energy Armor)
Episodes 18, 19 and 20: Equipment Supplier 181920 (Style: Herald of the Black)
Plans become available at the vendor alongside the episode cycle's release scheme for regular gear.
Episode 1/3: Fused Scraps, Chest, Back, Legs and Waist
Episode 2/3: Head, Hands, Feet and Shoulders, Face
Episode 3/3: Neck, Trinket, Utility Belt, Weapon Box, Ring

sections.title: Scraps
items: Scraps are the remainders of salvaging unneeded gear at an R&D Station. They are the raw materials for producing R&D gear.
Depending on its rarity, salvaged gear will produce a guaranteed minimum number of scraps and might in very rare cases produce up to 396.
Every episode cycle has its own unique kind of scraps, meaning to produce gear from e.g. episodes 18, 19 and 20 you will need to also salvage gear from those episodes.

sections.title: Fused Scraps
items: Fused Scraps can be made at an R&D Station from Scraps previously salvaged. 100 Scraps will provide 1 Fused Scrap. The R&D plan for the Fused Scraps is available at the episode vendor.

sections.title: Matter Enhancer
items: Matter Enhancers are R&D Parts used to assemble R&D Gear. They are available from R&D Vendors and cost 5 Marks of Victory.

sections.title: How-to Assemble R&D Gear
items: Play content from the episodes in question and salvage unneeded gear at an R&D Station to produce the episodes specific scraps, for episodes 18, 19 and 20 that would be Metalloid Scraps.
Visit the episode vendor for the episodes you are missing gear from, e.g. Equipment Supplier 181920.

Buy the plan to produce Fused Scraps for that episode cycle, for episodes 18, 19 and 20 that would be Plans: Fused Metalloid Scraps. 100 scraps from salvaged gear will allow you to assemble 1 Fused Scrap.

Buy the plan for the gear piece you want to assemble, e.g. chest, trinket or rings. Use it and go to an R&D Station to check out the number of parts you will need. Plans for R&D Gear will appear below all other plans in the Assembly tab of the R&D Station.
Buy the number of Matter Enhancers needed to assemble the wanted gear piece from a R&D vendor.

If you have gathered the required amount of scraps to produce the Fused Scraps needed and have bought the required number of Matter Enhancers, you are ready to assemble the wanted gear piece at a R&D Station.

sections.title: Available Plans
items: * R&D only item, not available as loot drop

sections.title: Trivia
items: Originally released for episodes 18, 19 and 20 with game update 54 the R&D Gear system was made available for episodes 15, 16 and 17 with hotfix 11/12/15.
Hotfix 02/08/16 reduced the number of Fused Scraps necessary to build each armor piece.
The concept of R&D Gear was discontinued with the return to large content releases ( Amazon Fury Part III), though it remained in place for content from episode 15 to episode 26.
R&D Gear was removed from the game with game update 85.

title: Resurgence Mega Capsule (3)
summary: A Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping February 20th, 2019, and was available until March 19th, 2019.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping February 20th, 2019, and was available until March 19th, 2019.
Each capsule is account bound and perishable. It will expire after 14 days.

A Resurgence Mega Capsule can only be opened using 7 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that drop in special events such as the Stabilizer Fragmentation duo.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of the previous nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.
To recap, you will get $9 worth of unlocked Time Capsules for just 700 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash or 7 Stabilizers.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each dropped Resurgence Mega Capsule can be opened using 7 Stabilizers OR you can purchase the Resurgence Mega Capsule directly in the Marketplace for 700 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (PS, Xbox). There is no difference between the dropped version and the Marketplace version, so you can go ahead and choose whichever method is most convenient for you.

sections.title: What is Inside a Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each Resurgence Mega Capsule will also contain one unlocked version of every previous Time Capsule. This would count towards any feats for opening those Time Capsules.

sections.title: Time Capsule Versions
items: Regular time capsule count stands at: 37

sections.title: Trivia
items: The update post mentions it containing a "Accessory Reward Box" but in-game the accessory is not in a box but instead is directly obtained. Upon release, it was labeled as "Geo Aura" in the item description, but this was fixed and now reads "Accessory" correctly.
When opening a Resurgence Mega Capsule, the pop up message fails to pluralize the word "Stabilizer", although 7 are required.

sections.title: To use rifle skills effectively:
items: The rifle has remarkable DPS when utilized skillfully. The ingame help is brief, and, on the skill tree page, downright misleading. It mentions some combo of holding right mouse button and a few arrow keys, but here's how to use the rifle skills and more information on what each does.
Note: To use each of these skills, you must first unlock them by putting a Skill Point into them, as well as having all prerequisite skills, if any.
Grenade Launcher: Simply tap right mouse button. Does AoE damage and knockback, good for clearing some space.

Rolling Barrage: Hold right mouse button and forward (up arrow or W) while far away from an enemy. You leap forward, deal nice damage, and knock your opponent into the air. Good for closing to melee; combo this with Flip Burst for a nice stunlock.

Flip Burst: Hold right mouse button and backward (down arrow or S) while close to an enemy. You flip backward, deal nice damage, and knock your opponent into the air. Good for escaping melee AoE's and for getting some distance between you and dangerous opponents. Alternate Rolling Barrage and Flip Burst for decent damage and stunlock (until the enemy becomes immune, anyway).

Mortar: Hold right mouse button and backward (down arrow or S) while far away from an enemy. Launches several mortars to the targeted enemy's spot, dealing heavy AoE damage after a second and knocking everyone back. Spamming this essentially turns you into AoE artillery. Spectacular against grouped enemies while another player has their attention.

Flamethrower: Hold right mouse button and forward (up arrow or W) while near an enemy. Unleashes a stream of flame, dealing damage and stunning anyone in a line in front of you. Great for locking down grouped opponents in melee if you don't want to knock them back with Grenade Launcher.

Surprise Volley: Hold left mouse button. Unleashes a three-shot burst at one enemy, stopping a ranged charge-up (the skull over their head), if the enemy is using one. Warning: Doesn't work on other charge-ups; damage is nice at low levels, but you should switch to Rolling Barrage/Flip Burst for better damage when you unlock them.

Overhead Smash: Tap, then hold left mouse button. You leap forward and clobber your target with your rifle. Stops ranged charge-ups and does more damage than Surprise Volley, but like Surprise Volley, you should use something else if it's not a ranged charge-up (try holding Shift).

Rifle Slam: Tap left mouse five times. If you're spamming melee attacks with left clicks, you'll use this every five hits. Deals heavy damage and knocks your target back. Spectacular for soloing or against one target if you like staying in melee; for groups of enemies, try Grenade Launcher or Flamethrower.

sections.title: Rifle Strategies: Putting it all together
items: Each skill has its uses, and some make nice combos together.
While far away from an enemy: Hold right mouse and back to rain down explosives with Mortar, or hold right mouse and forward to launch towards the enemy using Rolling Barrage.

While close to an enemy: Hold right mouse and back to clear some distance with Flip Burst, or hold right mouse and forward to stun them with Flamethrower. Or, just keep tapping left mouse button to dish out some damage, unleashing a Rifle Slam every fifth hit. Hold left mouse to quickly stop a ranged charge-up with Surprise Volley, or tap and then hold left mouse for an even more impressive ranged charge-up interrupt with Overhead Smash.

While far away or close to: Just hold right mouse button to keep shooting the enemy. (Your rifle will fire for thirteen consecutive shots and then stop. To resume firing simply let go of the right mouse button for a moment.)

This requires more testing, but it seems that against a single target, alternating Flip Burst and Rolling Barrage does more damage and recharges more power than simply holding right mouse. (It's certainly more impressive.)

Surprise Volley is also unusual among basic lunges in all weapon types in that it only moves you towards the target slightly instead of jumping all the way to it. This allows you to interrupt your target without having to get into melee range.

title: Secrets of Kahndaq Time Capsule
summary: A Secrets of Kahndaq Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 19th, 2022.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Secrets of Kahndaq Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 19th, 2022.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

title: Shazam! Time Capsule
summary: A Shazam! Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on March 20th, 2019 shortly before the release of the Justice League Dark episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Shazam! Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on March 20th, 2019 shortly before the release of the Justice League Dark episode.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

title: Shroud of Anubis
summary: The Shroud of Anubis is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for Villains. Named for the Egyptian god of death, this shroud bestows the powers of the Egyptian gods upon the wearer.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Shroud of Anubis is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for Villains. Named for the Egyptian god of death, this shroud bestows the powers of the Egyptian gods upon the wearer.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after Black Adam and is a specialized Tier 1 PvP ( Player versus Player) set only available from Felix Faust in the Magic Wing of the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Sidekicks and Accomplices
summary: Sidekicks and Accomplices are NPCs that can be summoned by the Player Character via trinket to support them in combat. Lair System access is necessary to use these Uplink Device type trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. Some trinkets are awarded from Events or Story Arcs content.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sidekicks and Accomplices are NPCs that can be summoned by the Player Character via trinket to support them in combat. Lair System access is necessary to use these Uplink Device type trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. Some trinkets are awarded from Events or Story Arcs content.

Players can choose the weapon their Sidekick/Accomplice will use for the Base Dispenser supplied trinkets. Sidekicks and Accomplices act in a similar manner to Pets and will stay with the Player for 50 seconds before being subjected to a 3-and-a-half minute cool-down period, after which they can be summoned again.

items: Sidekicks (Heroes) and Accomplices (Villains) can be upgraded via the Mainframe, with each upgrade allowing the NPC to be more effective in supporting the player in combat.
The gender of the Sidekick/Accomplice will match the gender of the Player Character (e.g. Female Player Character = Female Sidekick/Accomplice).

sections.title: Notes
items: Prior to Game Update 47 there were 5 possible levels for your Sidekick/Accomplice. Levels 1 and 2 are unchanged, but previously level 3 (originally called 'talented sidekick') only attacked enemies, taunted, and healed the caster. Level 4 (originally called 'elite sidekick') added the ability to replenish power to the caster and level 5 was the same as level 3, today.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Many of the "big name" heroes have had sidekicks or at least a protégée at one point in their careers; most notably Batman whose famous sidekick/partner goes by the name of Robin.

Other heroes and villains who have had a sidekick, protégée or noted accomplice during their careers are; Wonder Woman, Superman, Joker, Lex Luthor, Booster Gold, Steel, Green Arrow, Flash (Barry Allen), Aquaman, Deathstroke, the Riddler and Martian Manhunter.
Snapper Carr is a civilian who was enlisted as an honorary member, temporary mascot and sidekick to the entire Justice League of America. He currently operates as a member of Checkmate.

During his time in New York, Green Lantern (Alan Scott) had a sidekick in the form of a cab driver called Doiby Dickles (Derby Dickles), who aided Scott in fighting Nazis and at one point helped the hero save an alien princess from a galactic tyrant. Becoming enamored with the cab driver, the princess and Doiby eventually wed and Dickles now lives peacefully on his wife's home planet of Myrg.

In the TV show Static Shock, Static had a sidekick named Gear, who is Richard Osgood "Richie" Foley, Virgil Hawkins' best friend.; In the comics, a girl named Freida Goren fulfilled Gear's role as sidekick. Gear doesn't appear in the comics.; Gear is actually based on Richard "Rick" Stone, Static's best friend in the comics.

summary: A Sixth Dimension Kryptonian Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on June 9th, 2021.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Sixth Dimension Kryptonian Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on June 9th, 2021.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the Duo Event, Stabilizer Fragmentation.

Stabilizer Fragmentation can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

sections.title: Overview
items: Soder Cola Extreme is a common, low-level consumable. Found as a dropped item, granted as a mission reward, and even purchased from vendors, this cola can be used to replenish an amount of both Health and Power.

They can also be used as an ingredient to make advanced consumables, typically by combining it with Soder Cola Enhancers and Exo-Material at an R&D Station. They retain Soder Cola Extreme's effect while also buffing certain stats.

sections.title: Source
items: Soder Cola Extreme can be purchased from general vendors found throughout both Gotham City and Metropolis, as well as many instanced maps.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This item was introduced with Game Update 44 and replaced Soder Cola Extreme (2011-2015).
Prior to game update 80 this consumable stacked to 12.

Assuming even probability distribution, Bottled City Soder's power restore surpasses it by rank 7, and the heal surpasses it at rank 6. By rank 8, its guaranteed effects ties with Soder Cola Extreme's maximum healing and surpasses its power restore, and effectively becomes an unlimited source of stat restores that is equal or superior in every way, although it costs considerable Nth Metal (Artifacts) and Catalyst (Artifacts) to reach that point.
Lower-levelled Soders can no longer be bought, but existing Soders remain and now restore as much as Soder Cola Extreme.

Soder Cola Extreme used to cost $900 per 6 (5x of what it is now). Prior to cash cap for free players raising from $1500 to $50000, they were a convenient way to store cash in the inventory for gear repair if they get KO'ed a lot in a raid.

title: Son of Belial
summary: Son of Belial is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Son of Belial is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Etrigan as seen in Justice League Dark.
The regular set has Item Level 235, the elite set has Item Level 237, and both can be obtained only from the ARGUS Special Requisitions and Bound Daemon vendors in Chaos Gotham.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Source Mark
summary: Source Marks are a currency introduced with game update 94.

sections.title: Overview
items: Source Marks are a currency introduced with game update 94.

They are the new general purpose currency and replaced the Marks of Victory and several older episode specific tokens with an exchange rate of 1:1. All episode specific tokens prior to The Death of Superman were removed. The exchange only happens for tokens you already have in possession - the tokens in missions and instances are no longer given and no additional marks are given either.

As of Day of Reckoning, only the three most recent episodes award episode-specific currency in addition to Source Marks; any of those previously earned in older episodes can be 1:1 exchanged to Source Marks, and those episodes' rewards can now be purchased with Source Marks.

They are a form of Currency awarded to players though various PvE activities. They are used to purchase all but the most recent Iconic Battle Suits, certain Research and Development materials, Catalyst (Artifacts), Artifacts from John Constantine, Allies, and miscellaneous items.

sections.title: Acquisition
items: Challenges, Duos, Alerts, Raids, and open world missions from episode content
Daily Toyman mission on Stryker's Island
Missions or Briefings found in Alerts: Area 51, ACE Chemicals, Watchtower Containment, Smallville, Strykers Island, and Arkham Asylum

Since the release of House of Legends (Episode), any On Duty instance always award Source Marks, regardless of player CR. Loot locks also does not apply for any instances other than the latest 3 episodes. Therefore, Source Marks can be farmed from most instances for any amount of time. Although player CR is scaled to the content tier, generally low tier content is still easier. However, only the latest 3 episodes also award the same amount in episode-specific currency, which could eventually be 1:1 converted to Source Marks (i.e. those instances essentially give 2x marks).

S.T.A.R. Labs Facility is a 1-player challenge (Tier 2) that is extremely easy and fast to complete (completion time can be under 3 minutes) for high CR players and is one of the best ways to grind Source Marks (and generic gear if necessary).

Wonderverse: Temples of Source Power (Tier 6) can potentially be even faster due to Platinum Engavings giving +1 Source Marks each, for 3 Source Marks in one run, but requires a lot of investment in the augments and is harder.

Fortress of Solitude: Sunstone Matrix is a 8-player raid (Tier 1) that usually takes about 6 minutes to complete and awards 6 Source Marks. It is slightly harder than other options here (especially with players who are not familiar with Kryptonian Medics and yellow Sunstone Sentries which can wipe your team), but nearly half the time is just cutscenes.

Doomsday (Raid) (Tier 4) is popular due to its short length and simplicity ( Doomsday (Metropolis: Ground Zero) is the boss and the only enemy in the whole raid). It should take about 6 minutes and awards 5 Source Marks.

Most other raids (8-player content) award the full 10 Source Marks. However, they are harder and often much longer, with a few exceptions:; Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund (Tier 6) is very easy and usually takes ~8 minutes.; FP: Flash to the Future (Tier 6) is fairly easy and usually takes ~10 minutes.; Ultimate Soldier (Operation) (Tier 4) is potentially very fast (~5 minutes) if you use the fast way, but it is also very difficult. The slow and easy way is too slow to be worth grinding for Marks. See that page for details.; Happiness Home (Tier 3) is also potentially sub-10 minutes, but also generally too hard for random teams.; Titans: The Machine (Tier 5) is closer to 15 minutes, but is relatively easy. It is sub-optimal, but you'd likely need to queue for multiple raids to be able to get in them more frequently. It also always drops a box that can have up to 3 extra Marks.; SoBA: Rock of Eternity (Tier 6). A short raid (~10 minutes) that is fairly easy.

Occasionally there are events during which Source Marks earned are doubled, indicated by Source Marks appearing in loot in a second, silvery frame. Only Source Marks given inherently by content are doubled - those possibly appearing in Loot Picker are not. Omnibus bonus Source Marks from Steve Trevor is also doubled.

sections.title: Usage
items: They are used to purchase Iconic Battle Suits and various rewards from Episode vendors, other than the suits from the 3 most recent episodes, which could only bought with episode-specific currency. When the next episode is released, the rewards from the oldest of the three is changed to be buyable with Source Marks, and their episode-specific currency can be traded in for Source Marks in a 1:1 ratio.

They can also be used at the faction vendors in the Watchtower and the Hall of Doom to buy starter PVE sets (CR 34). Players must have reached the cooperative renown level with a faction to buy its set. If they reach the trusted renown level, they can also buy the faction's emblem for 1 mark. 5 marks can be used to buy Commendations, that will grand 125 renown with that specific faction.
They can also be used in the Lair System to buy the features off the mainframe, after first activating the energy cells.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Source Marks were introduced between Justice League Dark (Episode) and Metal Part I, the latter of which launched the Source saga proper, which eventually culminated in Dark Knights (Episode).

title: Speed Force
summary: The Speed Force is a form of kinetic energy that can be tapped into to produce super speed in an individual or item.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Speed Force is a form of kinetic energy that can be tapped into to produce super speed in an individual or item.

To physically enter the realm that the Speed Force has developed into, individuals need to reach a speed that exceeds beyond the speed of sound, light and time. Once entering the realm, individuals run the risk of becoming one with the energy due to their speed. Individuals need a "lightning rod" to ground themselves with their original realities in order to ensure their return from the Speed Force.

sections.title: History
items: The energy was developed and first generated by Flash (Barry Allen) as a by-product of his super speed. As the kinetic energy grew every time Allen utilized his abilities, the Speed Force eventually grew into an energy realm where others could tap into and use its energies.

As the Speed Force continued to grow, it eventually became a kinetic wall between the present and the time barrier that allowed access to the past and future. It now manifests as an electrical energy that exists in every dimension, every universe, and every era.

sections.title: Involvement
items: In Flashback, The Flash (heroes) or Professor Zoom (villains) use the Cosmic Treadmill to tunnel through the Speed Force, allowing two players to fight through Paradox Reapers to reach CCPD in the past to stop Abra Kadabra from preventing Barry Allen from becoming The Flash.

Origin Crisis; In Brothers in Arms and Family Reunion, you must travel through time via the Speed Force to influence the histories of Superman and Batman respectively.; In Paradox Wave, you must defeat the Paradox Tyrant to prevent the destruction of timelines.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Locations of disruptions of the Speed Force (e.g. in the main area of Paradox Wave) may have a unique afterimage trail effect, in which an object leaves a trail of many fading copies of its image, similar to a common glitch in older Windows computers when a program is not responding but is dragged around.
The Speed Force serves as the ultimate measure of velocity in the DC Universe.
The Black Flash is the representation of Death associated with the Speed Force.
3x2(9YZ)4A=? is the formula that created the Speed Force and, once recited, allows Johnny Quick and Liberty Belle access to the energy.

Max Mercury, although he was granted super speed by Native American rituals, tried to find the fuel for his powers and began studying the Speed Force. Though he never quite entered it, his attempts to access it allowed him to inadvertently travel forward through time.

The Speed Force is actually split between two charges; positive (generated by Barry Allen) and negative (generated by Eobard Thawne). The positive energy charge is commonly colorized as yellow lightning while the negative energy is red.

summary: Static's Damaged Goggles is an artifact-like rare drop in the face costume class. It is only available in Long Live the Legion content. It can be ranked up with the Quintile Crystal Shard reagent and special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce Static's Goggles of Omnipotence.

sections.title: Overview
items: Static's Damaged Goggles is an artifact-like rare drop in the face costume class. It is only available in Long Live the Legion content. It can be ranked up with the Quintile Crystal Shard reagent and special catalysts and is necessary to eventually produce Static's Goggles of Omnipotence.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Static in Gotta Get Up, Gotta Go!

sections.title: Milestone Ranks
items: Static's Damaged Googles has a maximum rank of 32 and can be broken through with the following catalysts:

table.caption: Milestone Ranks
rows: 3 x Ionized Gas, 1 x Faraday Cage, 1 x 8-Terabit Encryption Key
4 x Ionized Gas, 2 x Faraday Cage, 2 x 8-Terabit Encryption Key
6 x Ionized Gas, 3 x Faraday Cage, 3 x 8-Terabit Encryption Key
9 x Ionized Gas, 5 x Faraday Cage, 4 x 8-Terabit Encryption Key

sections.title: Trivia
items: As the item is upgraded over time it changes its rarity, rank 0 has rare, rank 8 epic and ... rarity

This is the first time an artefact that is fortified to produce Omnipotence gear can be equipped at the start and not upon completion ( Static's Goggles of Omnipotence). This makes it a viable piece of gear (even though it pales compared to the full version) with its unique style being collectible without huge investment. This formula is replicated for every episode afterwards as of Dark Knights (Episode).
The item can make use of Face Equipment Mods.

The three types of catalysts refer to real-life concepts:; Ionized Gas: Ionization occurs when molecules gain a positive or negative charge. Ionized gas is more conductive, allowing for phenomena like lightning.; Faraday Cage: A Faraday cage is a structure that can block electromagnetic fields.; 8-Terabit Encryption Key: A key in cryptography is basically a high-tech password that can only be read by machines. "8-Terabit" indicates a key length of 8 trillion bits. A longer length generally indicates a higher strength in the key (in real life this is only in the hundreds or thousands).

title: Sun God
summary: Sun God is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sun God is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the Egyptian sun god Ra.
The set is available in two distinct forms:
It can be obtained from random mission rewards or drops in The Sins of Black Adam content in box form with Item Level 315-338, attuning to your current Combat Rating.

It can be bought as-is from Sentinel Archibald in Infernal Kahndaq or The Catwoman (Episode Vendor) in the headquarters. The Item Level is fixed based on tier, up to 325, with the lowest version (Item Level 30) available to players who have reached level 30.
Enhanced Sun God gear with item level 10-335 was available for members through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards in December 2022.
The enhanced set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Supply Box is a container item originally introduced for providing PvP only consumables as a reward for winning PvP instances, but also could be purchased at PvP vendors for 500 Influence .
The scope of Supply Boxes expanded to include any such box containing a random general purpose supply consumable.

Supply Boxes were also further expanded for use as Event Progression rewards that would contain a quantity of Story Arc specific Currency items. These types of Supply Boxes always carry the currency in the item title, such as: Mogo Sprout Supply Box.

title: Team-Up Time Capsule
summary: A Team-Up Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released alongside the Starro the Conqueror event.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Team-Up Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released alongside the Starro the Conqueror event.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the new Duo Event, Mental Manifestations.

Mental Manifestations can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.

title: Thrall of Ekron
summary: Thrall of Ekron is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Thrall of Ekron is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Emerald Empress as seen in the Long Live the Legion episode.

The regular set has Item Level 285, the elite set has Item Level 287, and both can be obtained from the ProbeTek VendoBot 9000 in 31st Century: New Earth (requires 310 CR). The regular set can also be obtained from Tempus Fuginaut (Vendor) (requires 280 CR) at the House of Legends.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items from Emerald Empress in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Time Capsule
summary: A Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. They were first introduced alongside game update 63.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. They were first introduced alongside game update 63.

A Time Capsule can only be opened using a Stabilizer. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that drop in special events such as the Suicide Squad Training Duo.

Time Capsules that drop while the Suicide Squad Training Duo is active may contain a Future Crusader's Gear piece, a Lantern Corps Emblem, a Stat mod, an Ability mod, Exobytes, R&D materials or another Style. Time Capsules that drop when other Stabilizer Events are active may contain different Gear pieces and Styles. Stabilizer events will repeat similar to Legends PvE events with one event active at any time.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new mods, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

As of the Flashpoint Time Capsule, this probabilities chart was included in the Tooltip for the capsule to specify the odds of receiving rewards of a given rarity, either as a choice or a direct drop (with slightly varying percentages across capsules):

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the new Duo Event, Suicide Squad Training Head to Belle Reve to fight against guards, and possibly come face-to-face with a member of the Suicide Squad! You can find this in your On Duty menu under the “ Events” tab.

Suicide Squad Training can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account. .
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a separate capsule or box inside the Time Capsule.
These contain styles, auras, collections, and gear, including:

Get one of these boxes in your Time Capsules and you’ll find it contains Future Batman-inspired gear that is level-appropriate to your character. There are different boxes for different item types, including Head, Shoulders, Back, Chest, Waist, Hands, Legs, or Boots.These boxes are tradable until they’re consumed; then, since the gear becomes attuned to your current character’s role and level, they will be locked to that character.Until sub-capsules were phased out these gear boxes were originally contained in Future Crusader's Capsules.
Show your support of the Lantern Corps with these new Emblems! There is an emblem available for every Corps:

In addition to adding flair to your in-game appearance, each Emblem grants a feat, as does collecting them all!Until sub-capsules were phased out these emblems were originally contained in Lantern Emblem Capsules.
When you collect certain items from the capsules, they will go towards completing a collection that rewards you with a misted aura – Green, Amber, or Red!

New stat/ability mods, Exobytes, R&D materials, other styles, and additional helpful items will also be found in the capsules.During the Stabilizer Resurgence event, a Time Capsule also included a Time & Space Anomaly Capsule.

title: Ultimate
summary: Ultimate is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ultimate is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Subject Doomsday as seen in the World of Flashpoint episode.

The regular set has Item Level 295, the elite set has Item Level 297, and both can be obtained from either the Cobblepot's Fence in Flashpoint Gotham City, or the Flashpoint Supply Bot in the headquarters.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items from Ursa in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Availability Scheme
items: In order to acquire the elite gear, first renown with the The Resistance needs to be achieved by doing the elite versions of the FP: Queen's Row Penitentiary duo, the FP: The Royal War 4-player operation and the FP: Flashtastic Voyage and FP: Flash to the Future raids.
Cooperative (Renown): Elite Head and Elite Hands unlock
Friendly (Renown): Elite Shoulder and Elite Waist unlock
Favorable (Renown): Elite Legs and Elite Feet unlock
Trusted (Renown): Elite Chest and Elite Back unlock

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Ultimate's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: Thick Skinned: Collect all styles in the Ultimate set. Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the elite Head, Shoulder, Legs, Hands, Feet, Back, and Waist items from the World of Flashpoint vendor. (50 Points)

Doomsday Cosplay: Collect all styles in the Enhanced Ultimate set. Completing this feat will grant you a cost reduction on the elite Head, Shoulder, Legs, Hands, Feet, Back, and Waist items from the World of Flashpoint vendor. (50 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The style of the Elite gear is called Enhanced Ultimate.
Regular and elite gear of the same style would usually differ minimally by the elite set having more glow, sparkle or otherwise enhanced features.

title: Vitalization
summary: Vitalization does NOT affect passive power regeneration or power regeneration from weapon attacks.

sections.title: Overview
items: Vitalization determines the potency of power heals.
Vitalization does NOT affect passive power regeneration or power regeneration from weapon attacks.
Power Healing = Base Power Multiplier * (50% Vitalization)
Vitalization is the primary stat for Controllers.
Gadgets, Light, Mental, Quantum and Munitions gain +35% Vitalization in Controller role.

Vitalization can be increased using Artifacts, Augments, Generator Mods and spending Stat Points in Vitalization. It can also temporarily be increased through the use of consumables such as Vitamin Soders or Compound Omega.

title: Wondrous Time Capsule
summary: A Wondrous Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 21st, 2021.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Wondrous Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 21st, 2021.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

sections.title: Source
items: You Wish! treats date back to the original Valentine's Day Event 2011 and are still found during the Love Conquers All event today. The treat can be purchased for 2 Hearts. The treat produces a fun animation and sound for the player character.

items: "You Wish!" was one of six treat consumables that needed to be used in order to earn the feat I Choo-Choo-Choose You!. I Choo-Choo-Choose You!: Consume all of the Valentine's Day hearts (10 points) -- deprecated and auto-granted
A Hallmark of Success: Complete the following Love Conquers All seasonal events (25 points, title) -- deprecated and auto-granted

items: You Wish! treats were originally obtained from Imp and Cherub item vendors found within Aphrodite's Realm, as well as console merchants found in the Watchtower and the Hall of Doom during the 2011 Valentine's Day Event. The items could be purchased for 1 Aphrodite's Token each.
While there was no Valentine's Day Event in 2012, this item was again available in 2013 as part of the Box of Valentine's Candy.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Barbarian is an Armor Style Set themed on the warriors of Skartaris; a pocket-dimension located within the core of the Earth.

The dimension has various levels of culture ranging from the primitive to medieval, with the most advanced inhabiting city state monarchies. The practice of magic is well developed, with numerous sorcerers being known, and remnants of the scientific technology of Kingdom of Atlantis can also be found. Skartaris is overrun by a variety of prehistoric creatures from all geological eras, notably dinosaurs, and as such has a reputation for being a very savage place to live
This set has Item Level ?? and is obtained from various tier 1 to tier 3 content.
The set is also available as Attuned Gear with Item Levels 145 to 163 from doing content from the Amazon Fury Part III episode.

items: Bewitching Battlesuit is a costume style set available for villains only.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Future Circe.

The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 near The Pit.
The costume style is also available as style items from Emerald Empress in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Beyond High-Tech

sections.title: Overview
items: Beyond High-Tech is an armor style set for heroes and villains exclusively available from Gotham Time Capsules.
Consisting of eight plus one pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Terry McGinnis in Batman Beyond.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Biohazard is a Costume Style Set is a Costume Style Set for heroes and villains.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the HAZMAT suits of the Envirotech HAZMAT officers.

This set has Item Level 74 and is obtained as reward for doing the daily missions (heroes) or the Ace Chemicals Experiment bounty (villains) of the Home Turf episode. A minimum PvE combat rating of 70 or above and the Home Turf episode are pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.

title: Biomech
summary: Biomech is an Armor Style Set available from Mobs, Bosses, and Treasure Chest drops in various instances.

sections.title: Overview
items: Biomech is an Armor Style Set available from Mobs, Bosses, and Treasure Chest drops in various instances.
The style items are also available as drops in The Vault during seasonal events.
The style is a biomechanical "super-suit" of alien origin.

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Biomech's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do appear on the chest of this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: Collecting the full style set unlocks the feat Bio Booster (25 points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The style is also available from tier 5 gear which drops in instances from the Origin Crisis DLC pack.

The Biomech set was intended as a reference to " The Guyver" 1991 movie. The movie was based on the Manga/Anime series of the same name. The film tells the story of Sean Barkera; a young man who discovers an alien artifact called The Unit which transforms Barker into a alien-hybrid super soldier called The Guyver. The movie featured Mark Hamill playing the role of CIA agent Max Reed.

title: Bone Hilt Katana
summary: The Bone Hilt Katana is a Weapon Style for either One-Handed or Dual Wield weapons.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Bone Hilt Katana is a Weapon Style for either One-Handed or Dual Wield weapons.
With an ornate handle molded from the bones of an unknown creature, the base of the handle is etched into the head of a jackal; the symbol of the League of Assassins.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The practice of using bone in blade manufacture is often just a decorative feature often used to display the weapon wielder's status in high society. However, there are some cultures that believe incorporating the bones of an animal will bestow the weapon with that animal's power or spirit. Other cultures believe that the practice is a desecration of the animal's remains and is frowned upon.

classification.evidence: The Bone Hilt Katana is a Weapon Style for either One-Handed or Dual Wield weapons. With an ornate handle molded from the bones of an unknown creature, the base of the handle is etched into the head of a jackal; the symbol of the League of Assassins.

title: Brainiac Ship Guardian
summary: The Brainiac Ship Guardian is the endgame boss in the initial mission, the ship guardian watches off the ships weapon supports until they are destroyed and then expends his life in a last stand against intruders.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Brainiac Ship Guardian is the endgame boss in the initial mission, the ship guardian watches off the ships weapon supports until they are destroyed and then expends his life in a last stand against intruders.

sections.title: Involvement
items: The Brainiac Ship Guardian is the final boss of the It's a Big Scary World Out There! quest.

references.label: It's a Big Scary World Out There!

sections.title: Strategy
items: First Destroy the four gun brackets in the room to disable his force field and trigger his boss fight. Don't bother with the Sentries and Subjagators - they are endless.

Circle this boss firing off standard range attacks, and it is possible to build your hit count up to over 100 hits unlocking the associated hit feats. If the Ship Guardian charges up his pulse attack, flee to the opposite end of the chamber to avoid the radial wave and taking damage, or simply block it to reduce damage to 4. After the pulse attack, it would need to recharge and stop attacking. When it teleports, it fires off an arc of energy orbs dealing moderate damage and knocks back the player. Normal use of combo's and power attacks should be sufficient to take him out.

images.label: The Ship Guardian is recharging - attack now!

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Brainiac Ship Guardian is visually very similar to the Brainiac Encloser, except that the latter glows yellow rather than green.

classification.evidence: The Brainiac Ship Guardian is the endgame boss in the initial mission, the ship guardian watches off the ships weapon supports until they are destroyed and then expends his life in a last stand against intruders.

items: Checkmate Informant is the retired Tier 4 PVP Armor for heroes and villains introduced in Game Update 13 and was purchasable with Marks of Strategy (which replaced Marks of Conquest) obtained in Legends PVP and Arena PVP matches.

While the armor itself is retired, players are still able to buy the styles from Requisitions-H-STYL (Watchtower) and Requisitions-V-STYL (Hall of Doom) for 800 Marks of Valor each and are able to complete the Sneaky Service style feat.

title: Conqueror
summary: Conqueror is a Costume Style Set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which was first available during the Starro the Conqueror event.

sections.title: Overview
items: Conqueror is a Costume Style Set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which was first available during the Starro the Conqueror event.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is a PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by Starro.
This set is attuned gear, has Item Levels 10 to 190 and can be obtained from the Starro the Conqueror: Loot Boxes contained in the member loot boxes of the Deluge content.
Regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The enhanced set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.
A visually enhanced version of the set is available through the process of Research and Development.

title: Dark Specter Batsuit
summary: The Dark Specter Batsuit is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for Tech-based Heroes. Bestowed upon his "Agents of the Bat", this batsuit allows the wearer to carry and enforce the influence that Batman's image has over the criminal underworld.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Dark Specter Batsuit is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for Tech-based Heroes. Bestowed upon his "Agents of the Bat", this batsuit allows the wearer to carry and enforce the influence that Batman's image has over the criminal underworld.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after Batman and is a specialized Tier 2 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set only available from Batgirl in the Tech Wing of the JLA Watchtower.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower.
The costume style is also available as style items from Red Tornado in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Electrostatic
summary: Electrostatic is an Iconic Battle Suit style set available for heroes and villains.

sections.title: Overview
items: Electrostatic is an Iconic Battle Suit style set available for heroes and villains.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Static.

This set has Item Level 138 and 141 and is obtained from the Equipment Supplier 212223 in the Watchtower or the Hall of Doom. A minimum PvE Combat Rating of 142 or above and episodes 21 and 22 are pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.
The costume style is also available as style items from Nubia in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Overview
items: Green Knight is an armor style set for heroes and villains exclusively available from Arcane Time Capsules.

Consisting of eight plus one pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Green Lantern (Alan Scott) of Earth 22 (aka the Kingdom Come universe).
This set is attuned gear with an Item Level 10 to 428 and is obtained from Arcane Time Capsules.
It is also directly purchasable with Quarks from Booster Gold in House of Legends, Watchtower and Hall of Doom.

items: Laughing Knight is an armor style set for heroes and villains exclusively available from Dark Knights Time Capsules.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of The Batman Who Laughs.
This set and its enhanced version are attuned gear with an Item Level 10 to 428 and are randomly contained in Dark Knights Time Capsules.
It is also directly purchasable with Quarks from Booster Gold in House of Legends, Watchtower and Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Trivia

Any gear boxes, e.g. the Forbidden Hood Box, will give the choice of a damage role or a support role piece and are randomly contained in Dark Knights Time Capsules.
The visually enhanced style of the Laughing Knight costume style is called Enhanced Laughing Knight.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Enhanced styles can be style unlocked for free.

Any gear boxes, e.g. the Mid-Nite Tunic Box, will give the choice of a damage role or a support role piece and are randomly contained in Mid-Nite Gear Capsules, the latter of which are randomly contained in Time Torn Time Capsules.
The visually enhanced style of the Mid-Nite costume style is called Enhanced Mid-Nite.
Initially the back style was bugged and not visible.
The set was originally contained in Mid-Nite Gear Capsules and with an Item Level 10 to 172. It's now dropping directly from the time capsules.

The enhanced style was originally available as style items through the process of Research and Development with the time capsules dropping R&D plans. This was changed with the introduction of augments. Now the enhanced style is available as attuned gear too.

title: Primeval
summary: Primeval is an armor style set for heroes and villains exclusively available from Atlantean Time Capsules.

sections.title: Overview
items: Primeval is an armor style set for heroes and villains exclusively available from Atlantean Time Capsules.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Aquaman's mother, Atlanna, on Prime Earth.
This set and its enhanced version are attuned gear with an Item Level 10 to 428 and are randomly contained in Atlantean Time Capsules.
It is also directly purchasable with Quarks from Booster Gold in House of Legends, Watchtower and Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Trivia
items: In order to get the highest item level of 222, the player character needs to have a CR of 250 or better.
Any gear boxes, e.g. the Primeval Gloves Box, will give the choice of a damage role or a support role piece and are randomly contained in Assassin Time Capsules.
The visually enhanced style of the Primeval costume style is called Enhanced Primeval.

Typically the Enhanced style is very similar to the base style, but with more glow; however, the back style of Enhanced Primeval is quite different. Regular Primeval includes a large, rectangular scabbard while the blade is bare in the Enhanced version.
Enhanced back style and Dead King's Weapon Style Box share appearances.

title: Shim'Tar Regalia
summary: Shim'Tar Regalia is an armor style set style set for heroes and villains originally exclusively available from Amazon Time Capsules.

sections.title: Overview
items: Shim'Tar Regalia is an armor style set style set for heroes and villains originally exclusively available from Amazon Time Capsules.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of the champion of the Amazons of Bana-Mighdall.
This set is attuned gear with Item Level 10 to 428 and is obtained randomly from Amazon Time Capsules. Its maximum item level was originally at 164 and has been gradually increased with updates.
It is also directly purchasable with Quarks from Booster Gold in House of Legends, Watchtower and Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Enhanced styles can be style unlocked for free.
Any gear boxes, e.g. the Leggings of Shim'Tar Box, will give the choice of a damage role or a support role piece.
Shim'tar is a title given to the champion of the Amazons of Bana-Mighdall. Once Artemis was holder of it.
Shim'Tar Regalia gear is not salvageable at an R&D Station. It can only be sold to a vendor.
This set originally was released as attuned gear with Item Level 10 to 164 and the enhanced version as R&D Styles, distributed through Shim'Tar Regalia Capsules contained in the times capsules.
On occasion of the 10th anniversary of the game in 2021, the Restored Enhanced Shim'Tar Regalia costume style set was granted to all members.

Consisting of eight plus one pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Red Death, one of the evil versions of Batman in the Dark Knights, from the Dark Multiverse.
This set is attuned gear with an Item Level 10 to 428 and is obtained from Speed-Metal Gear Capsules randomly contained in Paradox Time Capsules.
It is also directly purchasable with Quarks from Booster Gold in House of Legends, Watchtower and Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Speed-Metal's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: A Flash of Metal: Collect all styles in the Speed-Metal set (50 Points)
Metal Couture: Collect all styles in the Enhanced Speed-Metal set, grants title: the Deadly (n/a)
Particle Powered: Wear equipment pieces that grant you at least a total of eight Antiparticles. (10 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: Any gear boxes, e.g. the Speed-Metal Mask Box, will give the choice of a damage role or a support role piece and are randomly contained in Speed-Metal Gear Capsules, the latter of which are randomly contained in Paradox Time Capsules.
The visually enhanced style of the Speed-Metal costume style is called Enhanced Speed-Metal.
The set was originally with an Item Level 10 to 192.

The enhanced style was originally available as style items through the process of Research and Development with the time capsules dropping R&D plans. This was changed with the introduction of augments. Now the enhanced style is available as attuned gear too.
Enhanced styles can be style unlocked for free.

summary: The Expert Marksman is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Expert Marksman is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the villain Deadshot as a specialized Tier 5 PvP ( Player versus Player) set available from the Requisitions-HA in the Hall of Heroes of the JLA Watchtower and from Requisitions-VA in the Power Core of the Hall of Doom. The set has PvP item level 101.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30 and have a PvP combat rating of 100 or above.
The costume style is also available as style items from Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Fear Gas
summary: For the Gadgets ability, see Fear Gas (Power).

sections.title: Overview
items: For the Gadgets ability, see Fear Gas (Power).

Fear Gas, also known as Fear Toxin, is the signature weapon used by the Scarecrow. Coming in a variety of forms (gas, liquid, powder) the substance induces involuntary and sometimes irrational fear in a victims' mind. Depending on the dosage amount and amount of time infected the gas has the ability to psychologically break the victim's mind; driving them insane.

A versatile substance, Fear Gas can be delivered through a variety of means through gas, darts, capsules, etc. His mask was made in order to enhance the effects of the hallucinogen while also acting as a gas mask to keep from poisoning himself.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Player Characters with the Gadgets power can gain the Fear Gas ability which sprays out fear gas to paralyze victims with terror.

sections.title: Heroes
items: In the Gotham City Sewers, the New Heroes must clear out canisters leaking Fear Gas from the sewers in order to proceed to the Scarecrow's lair.

sections.title: Trivia
items: As he is with most chemicals, the Joker is immune to Scarecrow's Fear Gas.
Due to his excessive use of psychological chemicals, Scarecrow has become unable to feel fear and claims that Batman is the only one capable of scaring him.
After being dosed with a new strain of fear gas by Scarecrow, a strain that only affects women, Catwoman discovered that her primary fear is the fear of dependency.

items: "Hanging Bat" Glitch: A fun glitch to perform with the Form: Man-Bat trinket is the "Hanging Bat" glitch. The Hanging-Bat glitch will enable you to access the special hanging bat animation. This animation is performed by Man-Bat, at the top of the Batcave map above the Bat Computer, prior to engaging him in the final boss encounter in the Rise of the Bat 4-player operation. It isn't built into the trinket, as the trinket forces your character into the Acrobatics movement mode. The glitch requires players to have the Monitor Propulsion Pack from Doctor Fate (Vendor) or Legion Flight Ring that forces your characters movement mode to temporarily switch to Flight. How to Perform:
Use the Form: Man-Bat trinket to switch into Man-Bat form.
Stop moving. Your character should now be suspended in mid air, upside down, with his hands resting on his chest.

items: Fuginaut Counselor is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available as enhanced version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of the Tempus Fuginaut as seen in the House of Legends episode.

The enhanced version was released in account bound boxes with Item Level 10-280, available through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards in September 2021, and can now also be purchased from Doctor Fate (Vendor).
The enhanced set is also available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.
