title: Gotham Knight
summary: The Gotham Knight is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Gotham Knight is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the hero Nightwing as a specialized Tier 4 PvP ( Player versus Player) set only available from the Requisitions-HA in the Hall of Heroes of the JLA Watchtower or Requisitions-VA in the Power Core of the Hall of Doom.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30 and have a PvP combat rating of 99 or above.
The set is also available as style items from Doctor Fate in the Main Observation Deck of the House of Legends.

Peak Human Hair Styling: Acquire an Gotham Knight Hair Style from the Metal Part II Vendor (10 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Gotham Knight was released alongside the Vengeful Surgeon with Game Update 41 as part of Season 3 of the PvP seasons.
At some point the pattern on the shoulder style was changed from wings on the sides to v.
Along with the Vengeful Surgeon armor set for villains the first gear to feature the new prismatic sockets which allow for any colored equipment mod.

Richard Grayson chose the mantle of “Nightwing” after his departure from operating under the Batman as “Robin”. Initially choosing a blue and yellow colour scheme, his suit possessed a flared collar and domino mask reminiscent of his circus acrobat origins. Grayson would later evolve his suit to include the ability to catch wind drafts and help him to paraglide through the use of specialized “wings” built into the suit. This design was short-lived however as he found the suit’s weight encumbering and disliked how the “wings” would sometimes randomly catch drafts and push him off balance. Choosing a colour scheme that was closer to the dark themes of Batman, Grayson removed the “wing” design and instead augmented his suit with pouches in his gauntlets and boots, as well as including a pair of spring-loaded pouches in the suit’s back to store a pair of polymer escrima sticks for use as weapons.

To be able to access the next gear tier at the PvP vendors, all gear slots in the inventory have to hold a gear piece of the previous tier. E.g. to get access to this set (tier 4 PvP gear, PvP item level 100), *all* equipped gear must be of PvP item level 99.

title: Heart of the Lion
summary: The Heart of the Lion is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Heart of the Lion is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the symbol of the Lion as a specialized Tier 4 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set only available from the Amazon in the Magic Wing of the JLA Watchtower for heroes and the Bestiamorph in the Magic Wing of the Hall of Doom for villains.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30, have a PvE combat rating1 of 70 or above and have the The Battle for Earth episode.
All pieces on sale have a item level of 78.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower and near The Pit in the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from Nubia in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Hera's Strength
summary: The Hera's Strength is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for Magic-based Heroes. Named for Hera, Greek goddess of women and marriage, and the wife of Zeus, this armor comes from Olympus itself, with each armor piece created to favor one of the attributes of the various Greek Gods.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Hera's Strength is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for Magic-based Heroes. Named for Hera, Greek goddess of women and marriage, and the wife of Zeus, this armor comes from Olympus itself, with each armor piece created to favor one of the attributes of the various Greek Gods.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after Wonder Woman and is a specialized Tier 2 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set only available from Donna Troy in the Magic Wing of the JLA Watchtower.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower.
The costume style is also available as style items from Star Sapphire Zatanna in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

items: Swear of Themyscira: Collect all styles in the Hera's Strength set. (50 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The armor style is based off of a ceremonial golden armor set that Wonder Woman frequently wears at various times in her comic book history. Dubbed the "Golden Chicken" by fans, the set was made by the Greek god, Hephaestus, and comes with golden wings, pteruges, chest-plate, and a golden helmet in the shape of an Eagle's head. Since its appearance in 1998, the battle armor has become a staple of Wonder Woman's frequently-worn costumes and a set has been extended to the possession of both Donna Troy (silver) and Wonder Girl (bronze).
Wonder Woman's leotard is actually the under-armor of her battle armor set.

Prior to Update 18, Marks of Distinction were used to purchase Tier 2 PvE Iconic Battle Suits; earned by completing Tier 2 Duos, by defeating bosses in Tier 2 Alerts, completing the Daily Tier 1 Alert, and completing South Gotham oriented quests only available in The Battle for Earth episode.

title: High Voltage
summary: High Voltage is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for heroes only available in the Lightning Strikes episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: High Voltage is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for heroes only available in the Lightning Strikes episode.

Having a Combat Rating of at least 53, you gain access to Central City through the Hangar of the JLA Watchtower in the Tech Wing where next to the teleporter over at Central City the vendor Quick Lee is located, offering the set through various crates around him as 'Souvenirs'. Interacting with them opens up a window similar to a real Vendor where you can trade your Mark of Triumph for the set pieces and various non-set Role specific Rings/Necklaces/Weapons, depending which crate you interact with.
All items on offer have a Combat Rating of 62.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower.
The costume style is also available as style items for heroes or villains from Red Tornado in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower.
The costume style is also available as style items from Metamorpho in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Kryptonian Commander
summary: The Kryptonian Commander is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for players with the Controller combat role. Created and infused with Sunstone Crystal technology, the set for heroes possesses the Kryptonian Family Crest of El while the set for villains possesses the Kryptonian Family Crest of Zod.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Kryptonian Commander is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for players with the Controller combat role. Created and infused with Sunstone Crystal technology, the set for heroes possesses the Kryptonian Family Crest of El while the set for villains possesses the Kryptonian Family Crest of Zod.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after Krypton and is a specialized Tier 3 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set. It is available from Supergirl and Non in the Meta Wings of the JLA Watchtower and the Hall of Doom respectively.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30 and have a PvE Combat Rating of 53 or above.
The price for the whole set is : 3891 Cash and 400 Marks of Triumph
All pieces on sale have an Item Level of 70.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower and near The Pit in the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from either Metamorpho or Ursa in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Kryptonian Medico
summary: The Kryptonian Medico is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for healers. Created and infused with Sunstone Crystal technology, the set for heroes possesses the family crest of El while the set for villains possesses the family crest of Zod.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Kryptonian Medico is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for healers. Created and infused with Sunstone Crystal technology, the set for heroes possesses the family crest of El while the set for villains possesses the family crest of Zod.
Consisting of eight pieces, the specialized Tier 3 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set is available from Supergirl and Non in the Meta Wings of the JLA Watchtower and the Hall of Doom respectively.
The requirement to be able to purchase the set is being Level 30 and having a Combat Rating of 53 or above.
The price for the whole set is : 3891 Cash, 400 Marks of Triumph.
All pieces on sale have a Item Level of 70.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower and near The Pit in the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from either Metamorpho or Ursa in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

items: The LexCorp Salvation is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for Meta-based Villains. Representing the pinnacle of LexCorp R&D, this suit is designed to turn the tide against Brainiac and any other Metahuman force bent on Earth's destruction.

title: Logistics Officer
summary: Logistics Officer is a armor style setand Iconic Battle Suit set for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: Logistics Officer is a armor style setand Iconic Battle Suit set for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after conventional military uniforms as a specialized Tier 3 PvP ( Player versus Player) set only available from the Requisitions-HA in the Hall of Heroes of the JLA Watchtower for heroes and the Requisitions-VA in the Power Core of the Hall of Doom for villains.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30 and have a PvP Combat Rating of 87 or above.
The style items may also be available as drops in The Vault during seasonal events.
The costume style is now available as style items from Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magnetic Paladin is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available as enhanced version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Cosmic Boy as seen in the Long Live the Legion episode.

The set has Item Level 265-283 and is also available with Item Level 10-272 from the ProbeTek VendoBot 2000 in 31st Century: New Earth and the in the headquarters. An attuned version of this gear also drops from Omnibus content.

The enhanced version is not tradable and available as gear with Item Level 10-272 from the ProbeTek VendoBot 2000 in 31st Century: New Earth. It was also available for members in January 2023 from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.
The enhanced set is also available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards enhanced gear boxes only for members.

items: Black Manta's battle-suit is adapted to an oceanic environment, giving him complete resistance to the cold and pressures of deep sea conditions and grants him the ability to breathe underwater (whether this is due to a hidden oxygen supply or its ability to extract oxygen from the water like the gills of a fish is unknown), a jet pack which functions in or out of water, a telepathic scrambler (used to temporarily strip Aquaman of his aquatic telepathy), and a varying array of weapons, including twin blades, a hand-held trident, energy beams and a harpoon gun that he can fire from his right wrist gauntlet, miniaturized torpedoes, and optic blasts emitted from the eye lenses in his helmet. It is not known how his suit is powered or how long it can function before needing recharging (or if it even needs to be).

title: Orbital Strike Uplink Device
summary: Orbital Strike Uplink Device is an epic trinket that allows the player character to deal a large amount of damage to a targeted enemy and all other enemies in that target's vicinity. It is available from the Dispenser in a player character's Base after unlocking it in the Mainframe.

sections.title: Overview
items: Orbital Strike Uplink Device is an epic trinket that allows the player character to deal a large amount of damage to a targeted enemy and all other enemies in that target's vicinity. It is available from the Dispenser in a player character's Base after unlocking it in the Mainframe.

sections.title: Details
items: Level 1 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals damage to your target and nearby enemies.
Level 2 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals increased damage to your target and nearby enemies.
Level 3 - Calls down an Orbital Strike that deals massive damage to your target and nearby enemies.

sections.title: Notes
items: The Orbital Strike deals damage against all targets in a small radius, apparently based on a formula that uses the player's Combat Rating. This is further modified by a Damage Modifier specific to the Uplink Device. At 400 Combat Rating, using a basic Uplink Device, Boosted, deals 97047 damage per hit for five hits, or 485235 damage total.

This damage is not reduced when hitting multiple opponents (always at full damage), has no randomization, and cannot crit (although visually it uses a white hitsplat same as weapon attacks). It is generally unaffected by damage boosts.
Boost II additionally roots and stuns all targets hit (this triggers Ally: House of Legends Bot's passive effect).

Orbital Strike can be aimed at a target or at the player's location. The maximum range is exactly the same range as when the targeting reticle on an opponent turns red instead of grey. If used outside of maximum range, it will be used at the player's location.
The stun targeting is technically separate from the damage; if a mob outside of maximum range is targeted, the stun zone can occur around that mob, while the damage zone occurs around the player.
A number of bosses, including Terra in Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn and The Merciless in Metal Pt. I: False Idols, have mechanics that specifically counter Orbital Strikes, discouraging their use.

Certain boss mechanics that reduce all damage taken will also further reduce damage from Orbital Strikes, like Deadly Isis in SoBA: Godseye Pyramid with all orbs, or Neron in SoBA: Neron's Underworld at the beginning of the battle.
Orbital Strike can target targetable objects, subject to the same damage cap of regular attacks.
The Dead King's Scepter artifact can be used to boost the effects of orbital strikes.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Previously, it deals damage against all targets in a small radius equal to a percentage of their maximum health (25% default, 35% Boost I, and 45% Boost II) in 5 hits over 2 seconds (or 5%, 7%, and 9% per hit), reduced for bosses. The smallest amount of damage an Orbital Strike can deal in one hit is 10. Targets with less than 200 maximum health are immune to its damage, but not Boost II's control effects. After the damage formula change, Orbital Strikes can now one-shot low level mobs.; Orange Lanterns in the open-world Christmas event, which normally reduces all damage taken to 1 and have 6 total health, can still be damaged by Orbital Strikes (at 1 damage).

Previously, Sparring Targets in the Watchtower and League Halls take reduced damage, but not the Sparring Targets in House of Legends. The latter took 2160000 damage per hit at max rank, indicating that they have 240000000 (24 million) maximum health.

There are many versions of the device, the difference between them is only in visuals. Once a unique device has been equipped, it becomes integrated and untradeable, and can be retrieved infinitely from the Base Dispenser like the regular version.

There are many bosses with attacks that resemble an Orbital Strike of their theme, like Dawnbreaker, Darkfather, and Ultraviolet Nightmare. However, those attack do not use the same damage formula but rather often does massive or one-shot damage if not evaded.

classification.evidence: Orbital Strike Uplink Device is an epic trinket that allows the player character to deal a large amount of damage to a targeted enemy and all other enemies in that target's vicinity. It is available from the Dispenser in a player character's Base after unlocking it in the Mainframe.

images.label: Feat - Am I Here To Amuse You

references.label: Am I Here to Amuse You?

sections.title: Trivia
items: The gear available from The Vault originally had item levels 10-172 and was later upgraded to 10-180. Since the release of the Deluge episode it was 10-190, with the advent of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract it is 10-200, with Atlantis (Episode) 10-210 and with Justice League Dark (Episode) it is 10-220. It continued to be upgraded with every new episode, to the same as the purple gear from drops in the event version. However, the level you get relative to your CR is only as high as green gear (e.g. if the drops give you level 208, 209, and 210 for green, blue and purple, even though Psycho had max 210 at the time it would still only give you 208 until you reach a higher CR). This was eventually stopped at level 280, and The Vault was discontinued (existing gear boxes can still be opened). Gear boxes obtained prior to the episode release would also be upgraded to the higher level, so for free players it may be a good idea to save them especially if you are already at or near the maximum possible CR.

title: Raptor Infiltrator
summary: The Raptor Infiltrator is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for Heroes. Resulting from years of in-field study and research, this suit is the pinnacle of Batman's Robin-suit designs; built with the intention of protecting the wearer from harm while on duty in Gotham.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Raptor Infiltrator is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for Heroes. Resulting from years of in-field study and research, this suit is the pinnacle of Batman's Robin-suit designs; built with the intention of protecting the wearer from harm while on duty in Gotham.

Raptor Infiltrator was previously an armor set, but is now only a style themed after Robin. It is available from the vendor Requisitions-H-STYL in the Hall of Heroes in the JLA Watchtower for 800 Marks of Valor and $250 per piece.

Previously, the set consisted of eight pieces, and was a specialized Tier 1 PvP ( Player versus Player) set only available from Robin in the Tech Wing of the JLA Watchtower. The full set required 6086 cash and 315 Marks of Valor.
Before game update 25 the full set required 2664 cash and 3400 Influence.
The costume style is also available as style items from Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Reverse
summary: Reverse is a costume style set for villains only available in the Lightning Strikes episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Reverse is a costume style set for villains only available in the Lightning Strikes episode.

Accessible only with the Lightning Strikes episode and having a Combat Rating of at least 53, you gain access to Central City through the Hangar of the Hall of Doom in the Tech Wing where next to the teleporter over at Central City the vendor Short Order is located, offering the set through various crates around him as 'Souvenirs'. Interacting with them opens up a window similar to a real vendor where you can trade your Mark of Triumph for the set pieces and various non-set role specific rings/necklaces/weapons, depending on which crate you interact with.
All items on offer have a Combat Rating of 62.
Purchasing the whole Style Set requires at least 3578 Cash and 4200 Mark of Triumph
Each crate displays with the Role icon which type of gear they offer.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 near The Pit.
The costume style is also available for heroes or villains as style items from Evil Star in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Runes of the Norsemen's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do appear on this style.

sections.title: Feats
items: Collecting the full style set unlocks the feat Runes to My Memory (50 points).

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Runes of the Norsemen costume pieces are a tad better than normal tier 4 PvE gear and were the best armor in the game before tier 5 was released.

The Runes of the Norsemen costume pieces originally were the only armor pieces which neither dropped nor could be bought at a vendor. They have to be made at an R&D station from Codices found in eight player tier 4 operations of the Hand of Fate episode. Later they also became available at Vending Unit 22.

This set has Item Level 128 and 131 and is obtained from the Equipment Supplier 181920 in the Watchtower or the Hall of Doom. A minimum PvE Combat Rating of 131 or above and episodes 18 and 19 are pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.
The costume style is also available as style items from Harley Quinn in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the appearance of the Ram and is a specialized Tier 4 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set only available from the Amazon in the Magic Wing of the JLA Watchtower and the of the Hall of Doom.
The requirement to be able to purchase the set is being Level 30, having a Combat Rating of 70 and have access to The Battle for Earth episode.
The price for the whole set for each role is : 5476 Cash and 50,000 Marks of Triumph.
All pieces on sale have a Item Level of 78.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower and near The Pit in the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from Nubia in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: Sunstone Crystal
summary: Sunstone Crystal is a type of crystal first developed and used on the planet Krypton, both as a building material and as a form of computer system.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sunstone Crystal is a type of crystal first developed and used on the planet Krypton, both as a building material and as a form of computer system.

Similar in nature to organic lifeforms, a sunstone crystal can be "shaped" to serve specific purposes. Some, when activated, can duplicate their mass; forming structures such as buildings or vehicles. Others shape themselves into hive-like nests to act as computer systems. While others again can serve as small communicative devices or tools and instruments.

Upon their discovery on Earth by Lex Luthor, who had found a Kryptonian Sunstone Warship and had attempted to destroy Metropolis with it, Superman disassembled the ship and inadvertently created a new Fortress of Solitude with one crystal.
Keeping the remaining crystals within the fortress, Superman continues to study their natures while determining how their use may benefit Earth and human-kind.

sections.title: Involvement
items: The entire structure of the Fortress of Solitude is made up of sunstone crystals. During the Fortress of Solitude raids, Brainiac assimilated the sunstones of the Fortress to fortify his armies.
The Kryptonian Medico, Sunstone Edge, Kryptonian Commander and Sunstone Bulwark Iconic Battle Suits were all created and infused with Sunstone Crystal technology.
The Krypton: House of El's security system is comprised entirely of Sunstone Crystals.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Several incarnations of the Fortress of Solitude are made mainly from sunstone crystals, or otherwise incorporate them into its design.
Supergirl possesses sunstone crystals within her body which were surgically embedded by her father as a weapon against Phantom Zone "ghosts".
The lenses of Clark Kent's glasses are made out of the Sunstone Crystals from his space ship. They were initially given to Clark by his mother to keep his heat vision in check during high school.

title: The Last Aurochs
summary: The Last Aurochs is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Last Aurochs is a costume style set and Iconic Battle Suit for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the symbol of the Bull as a specialized Tier 4 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set only available from the Amazon in the Magic Wing of the JLA Watchtower for heroes and the Bestiamorph in the Magic Wing of the Hall of Doom for villains.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30, have a PvE Combat Rating of 70 or above and have the The Battle for Earth DLC.
The price for the whole set for each Role is : 5476 Cash and 50,000 Marks of Triumph.
All pieces on sale have a Item Level of 78.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower and near The Pit in the Hall of Doom.
The costume style is also available as style items from Nubia in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The set was originally purchased using Marks of War, which were earned by completing Tier 4 alerts, raids and operations. The currency was debunked following game update 25 and replaced with Marks of Triumph.

The set's name refers to the aurochs (the name is the same in singular and plural), real-life ancestors of the modern domestic cattle, that went extinct a few hundred years ago; the last known real-life aurochs died in 1627 in what is today Poland. This also makes the set the only one out of the four tier 4 Iconic Battle Suits to be based on an extinct animal.

title: Themysciran Battlesuit
summary: Themysciran Battlesuit is a costume style set for heroes only.

sections.title: Overview
items: Themysciran Battlesuit is a costume style set for heroes only.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Artemis.

This set has Item Level 99 and is obtained from Karen in the Themyscira Command Post. A minimum PvE Combat Rating of 106 or above and the Amazon Fury Part II episode is pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.
The set is also available as style items from Vending Unit 00 in the Aquacultural Area of the Watchtower.
The set is also available as attuned gear with item levels 255-269 (green) and 255-271 (blue) from Wonderverse content.
The costume style is also available as style items from Star Sapphire Zatanna in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

The Vengeance is an Iconic Battle Suit Style set for any role.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after the hero Huntress as a specialized Tier 4 PvP ( Player versus Player) set only available from the Requisitions-HA in the Hall of Heroes of the Watchtower.
To obtain this set, players must be at Level 30, have a PvP Combat Rating of ??? or above.
The costume style is also available as style items from Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Huntress' first suit was designed by Paulo Siguera; the designer of Italy's military and police uniforms. The Huntress' second suit she gained through additional funding from an "unknown benefactor". This benefactor turned out to be Thomas Elliot who offered her his support as part of a hidden plan to attack Bruce Wayne.

Omertà is a Southern Italian code of honor that places importance on a deep-rooted "code of silence". The code implies "the prohibition of cooperation with state authorities or reliance on its services, even when one has been the victim of a crime". A person should absolutely avoid interfering in the business of others and should not inform the authorities of a crime under any circumstances (though if justified they may personally avenge a physical attack on themselves or on their family by vendetta). Within Mafia culture, breaking Omertà is punishable by death.

title: Absolute Arrow Time Capsule
summary: An Absolute Arrow Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 6th, 2026.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Absolute Arrow Time Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It was first released on October 6th, 2026.

sections.title: Description
items: Booster Gold filled some Time Capsules full of useful items from different times and places within the Multiverse and brought them here! In order to open a capsule full of goods players must have a Stabilizer. Capsules are given liberally in game, but Stabilizers are sold on the marketplace or earned in game.
Each capsule is full of goodies including gear, new styles, auras, crafting materials, and more.

A collection of relics, rogue tech, and iconic Gotham-inspired rewards curated by Booster Gold from across fractured timelines. Within this capsule, players will uncover items tied to Gotham’s most infamous figures, experimental breakthroughs, and enhanced gear forged in the chaos of Gotham City. Inspired by the looks of the Absolute Universe!

sections.title: How to Obtain a Time Capsule
items: Time Capsules can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

sections.title: How to Open a Time Capsule
items: To open a capsule, you’ll need a Stabilizer. There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.
When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find Stabilizer Fragments. You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned through the daily Stabilizer Fragmentation mission.
It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.
Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

sections.title: What is Inside a Time Capsule
items: Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items.

Collections; Collections: A Crushed Collection yields Absolute Hawk Helm Style; Collections: Strange Foes of the Titans yields Black Hand Corruption Iconic Ability; Collections: Once A Titan... yields Absolute Harley Skin Set

title: Absorption Adapter I
summary: Absorption Adapter I is a Weapon Equipment Mod Lair System Dispenser Item.

sections.title: Overview
items: Absorption Adapter I is a Weapon Equipment Mod Lair System Dispenser Item.
This White Tactical Mod requires the Tactical Mods I to be unlocked and 1 active cell in a lair's Mainframe.

sections.title: Description
items: Weapon attacks have a chance to activate a shield, reducing damage by 50% until damage equal to 10% of your Health is prevented.[sic] This effect may only occur once every 120 seconds.

items: Account Bound is an item quality indicating that the item cannot be traded to player characters other than the player's alternate characters.

Account bound items can be traded to a player's alternate character via the Shared Bank tab of the bank.

items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
Aerial Crusader Belt of Aggression is an uncommon waist equipment item available from the PvP vendors.

sections.title: Updates
items: The item was available since game update 25 and until game update 33.
When this item was phased out, it was upgraded to PvP item level 85 to fit into the new PvP scheme.

items: A waist equipment item with PvP item level 77 is a must-have to complete PvP level 77 and unlock PvP level 81 gear at the vendors.

items: An Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping January, 6th, 2026 and lasted until January, 26th, 2026.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of the previous nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.
To recap, you will get $9 worth of unlocked Time Capsules for just 700 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash or 7 Stabilizers.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each dropped Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule can be opened using 7 Stabilizers OR you can purchase the Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule directly in the Marketplace for 700 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (PS, Xbox). There is no difference between the dropped version and the Marketplace version, so you can go ahead and choose whichever method is most convenient for you.

sections.title: What is Inside a Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each Resurgence Mega Capsule will also contain one unlocked version of the last nine previous Time Capsule. This would count towards any feats for opening those Time Capsules.

title: Batarang
summary: The Batarang is a bat-shaped throwing weapon used by the Batman and his associates as a non-lethal ranged attack alternative to firearms.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Batarang is a bat-shaped throwing weapon used by the Batman and his associates as a non-lethal ranged attack alternative to firearms.
Inspired by the Australian boomerang, the Batarang can incapacitate a foe, knock weapons out of assailants' hands, or travel long distances to attach itself to objects.

Through the years Batman developed other uses for the Batarang, including a veritable arsenal of customized Batarangs that wailed like a siren, emitted smoke, exploded, acted as tracer beacons, amongst others. Batman also developed smaller Batarangs that worked like Japanese shuriken or darts, sharpened to cut into criminals' hands or arms in order to disarm them.

sections.title: History
items: The earliest renditions of the weapon were scalloped, metal boomerangs which were used to attack opponents and return to the thrower in one throw. Variations of these batarangs include those which were able to be folded for compact storage, those which can be explosively charged and those which are electrified. A grappling hook made out of a batarang and a rope was common until Batman began using an upgraded grappling hook device.
Since the first rendition, batarangs have been shown for varying purposes in varying shapes and sizes from sharp to blunt, explosive, impact, electric, adhessive and cutting.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Players can acquire the Iconic Power Batarang Multi-Shot
Players who preordered the DC Universe Online game on the game's release received, amongst others, the Bladed Batarang as a bonus item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The original concept of the Batarang was developed by Bill Finger and first appeared in Detective Comics #31 (September 1939) in the same year that Batman was introduced. They have since become a staple of Batman's arsenal, appearing in every major Batman media adaptation to date.
After becoming Nightwing, Richard Grayson used his own modified versions of a Batarang, which are shaped after a bird. He often refers to them as "Wing-Dings".

Whenever possible, Batman and Robin recollected used weapons to keep them out of the hands of criminals or curious civilians who might injure themselves. As a result, real Batarangs remain rare objects beyond Batman's control.

The modern authentic Batarangs are foldable, composite-graphite molded, unbreakable to 10,000 psi, laser-honed so that they never lose their edge, are aerodynamically tested, perfectly balanced and still returning.
Next to jet fuel, batarangs are the Bat Family's number one operating cost.

title: Batman-Inspired Mask
summary: The Batman-Inspired Mask is a Head Armour Style issued as part of a special package to DCUO players in 2011.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Batman-Inspired Mask is a Head Armour Style issued as part of a special package to DCUO players in 2011.

While primarily used to hide the identity of the wearer, the cowls and masks of the Bat Family possess advanced technology that mimick a bat's natural abilities through starlite lenses to see in utter darkness; aural-electronics to discern the faintest whispers; and inertial navigators and echolocation to assist in navigation and balance.

They also contain internal computers that are linked directly to the Batcave computers. Through the computer, information such as medical records, building layouts and maps can be accessed and brought to eyesight through the cowl's lenses.

Kevlar panels in the cowls provide protection over vulnerable skull areas against ballistics. The front of the skull and the sides of the temples also have small armor inserts to increase the effectiveness of skull strikes and protect from concussive blows. The cowl is also shielded against various methods of mind control.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: The style was released on August 31st, 2011 following a hacker attack that shut the SOE servers down following security concerns. The style was part of a "Welcome Back" package that also included the Two-Face-Inspired Mask, the Hack Attack Hoodie and 20 Marks of Distinction.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The process of donning the cowl is a symbolic gesture to Bruce Wayne; who sees it as a way to reaffirm the oath he made to protect Gotham and fight the crime that killed his parents.

Psychologically, some members of the hero community; such as Jason Blood, argue that the cowl is Bruce Wayne's real face and that the public "Bruce Wayne" is the mask. Even Superman has agreed that there is some truth to this statement.

The starlight lenses of the cowls allow the wearer to see in infrared vision (heat sensors), night vision, and ultraviolet vision. The cowls and masks also contain audio processors and, in Batman's case, a high gain antenna for communication purposes and enables voice-command control over various equipment such as the Batmobiles.

Batman's cowl, on which this cowl is based, also features additional security defense mechanisms that deploy deterrents against unsanctioned removal of the cowl; such as electric shock and stun gas. In order to keep the wearer’s identity secret the cowl is even lined with lead to prevent x-ray sight.

title: Batwoman's Serrated Cape
summary: Batwoman's Serrated Cape is a Back armour piece associated with Batwoman. Based on the design worn by the Batman, the serrated points of this cape are lead-weighted for offensive purposes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Batwoman's Serrated Cape is a Back armour piece associated with Batwoman. Based on the design worn by the Batman, the serrated points of this cape are lead-weighted for offensive purposes.

The original intention of the cape was to draw the enemy's fire as well as to assist the wearer in blending into the shadows. Through the years the cape was found to have additional uses such as concealing the wearer's hands, adding additional protection to the body and giving the supernatural impression of wings.
Its association with an iconic DC character and its rarity classifies it as an Iconic Equipment item.

sections.title: Gotham City
items: Bruno Mannheim in Temple of Crime

sections.title: Trivia
items: Although the armour is named for Batwoman, Batman, Batgirl and Robin also wear serrated capes.

The cape was the most difficult part of his uniform to adjust too when Batman first donned his uniform. However, after a time and various weight adjustments he found its uses were worth the irritation.

sections.title: Overview
items: This powerful bounty has a simple but knock-back personality. While in bounty form, she uses sound blasts to stun and possibly knock down enemies. Not only is it sound that damages you but her Martial Arts weapon packs a punch also. Many people hate the fact that she is pretty easy to knock out alone but she is partnered with Green Arrow Bounty which counts for a ton of other damage also. Her basic damage numbers are around 100-150 but when she has that "Skull" icon on her target bar you better watch out! sections.title: Overview
items: Bouncers are found outside each Safe House. There are usually two of them at each location and they perform massive knock backs to players that are of the opposing morality (e.g. a Hero character will be knocked away from the entrance of the Club 539, as will a Villain character be knocked away from the entrance of the GCPD 12th Precinct). While this also grounds a player and prevents them from using abilities or attacks, this is usually not a problem as they knock back the player so hard ( breakout cannot be used), by the time they hit the ground the effect would wear off, unless they land on a tall building.

Previously, most bouncers could actually be killed by attacking from the edge of the player's range. They are level 30, have a lot of health and no drops. After an update, bouncers at Safe Houses are no longer attackable NPCs. However, level 34 bouncers STAR Sentry Knox and STAR Sentry Erickson, who guard Researcher Quinn, remain attackable (by villain players). There is a possible Exo-Material spawn spot right behind the trio, so a villain player must KO both Sentries before they can reach it. They drop generic items (like Nth Metal (Artifacts)) and would respawn after a few seconds.

Only some attacks have a long enough range to hit the bouncers without them being able to hit back (they are immune to crowd control and are immobile, much like turrets). Notably, Rifle's Grenade Launcher is able to do so as the grenade explodes at maximum range. This is an accessible way to KO them as it requires only a single skill point into Rifle and does not depend on Powers. Pets are also able to attack them continuously after you have landed a blow on them, and they are not targeted directly by bouncers' knockback (although they would be forced to return to the player if the player is knocked back).

title: Broodmother's Cranium
summary: The Broodmother's Cranium is an epic iconic item in the head costume class.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Broodmother's Cranium is an epic iconic item in the head costume class.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Sunstone Broodmother in Fortress of Solitude: The Chasm

sections.title: Trivia
items: During the F.O.S raids players must stop Brainiac from harvesting the power from Superman's Fortress of Solitude Power Core. The 2nd Boss of F.O.S 1, the Sunstone Broodmother, is encased in a shield. Players must defeat crabs or insect Brainiac ads that jump from the surrounding canyon. Once defeated the crabs or insects drop shards that must be brought to the shield in order to break it. Once successful you will have your chance to defeat the Sunstone Broodmother and a chance to gain the iconic "Brainiac Sunstone" style.

The requirement to enter the F.O.S raids is a combat rating of 53 for expert raids and 50 for novice. Players are suggested to run F.O.S 1 and F.O.S 3 until achieving a combat rating of 70 or higher to complete F.O.S 2. Best of luck and hopefully this iconic will drop for you!

The chances of the Broodmother's Cranium style dropping are equivalent to the chances of a Remix Plan or the Helm of Omnipotence dropping or less than 1%. In order to get a good chance of getting the Cranium you must defeat the Broodmother boss once every week for at least 7 years since your 7 group members will probably get the Cranium.

classification.evidence: The Broodmother's Cranium is an epic iconic item in the head costume class.

title: Catalyst (Omnipotence)
summary: Not to be confused with Catalyst (Augments) or the similar group Catalyst (Artifacts).

sections.title: Overview
items: Not to be confused with Catalyst (Augments) or the similar group Catalyst (Artifacts).

Catalyst (Omnipotence) , as labeled in-game, are a subset of Catalyst (Artifacts), required to break through Milestone Ranks of an artifact to produce a piece of Omnipotence Gear. Each Milestone Rank requires a different and specific combination of catalysts & reagents in order to fortify the artifact to higher levels.

These can be acquired, alongside the appropriate Reagents (Omnipotence), from vendors in each episode or chapter. The Catwoman Story Arc Vendor in the House of Legends also sells the three most recent sets.

sections.title: Artifact Milestone Ranks
items: The higher the milestone rank, the lower the chances for a successful breakthrough are. On a failure the catalysts are destroyed. This can be avoided by using a Seal of Preservation, which will be consumed instead of the catalysts on a failed attempt. For high-level milestone ranks a Seal of Completion is also available, ensuring a successful breakthrough, but being consumed in the process.

Chest costume pieces fill the Chest Costume Slot as shown in the Player Character's Inventory screen. Once equipped, the costume piece's appearance will be added to the Player Character's Style collection and can be accessed via the Style Window.

title: Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule
summary: A Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping May, 9th, 2025.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping May, 9th, 2025.

A Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule can only be opened using 7 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that are available from Stabilizer Fragmentation.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of the previous nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.
To recap, you will get $9 worth of unlocked Time Capsules for just 700 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash or 7 Stabilizers.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each dropped Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule can be opened using 7 Stabilizers OR you can purchase the Chromatic Corps Resurgence Mega Capsule directly in the Marketplace for 700 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (PS, Xbox). There is no difference between the dropped version and the Marketplace version, so you can go ahead and choose whichever method is most convenient for you.

sections.title: What is Inside a Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule will also contain one unlocked version of the last nine previous Time Capsule. This would count towards any feats for opening those Time Capsules.

title: Energy Battery Backpack
summary: The Energy Battery Backpack is a Back armour piece associated with the intergalactic villain Krona. The backpack was originally developed by Krona as a predecessor to the Lantern Power Battery, upon voice activation it taps into the emotional spectrum and channels the spectrum's power into connected Energy Battery Gloves to be used by the wielder similar to a Power Ring.

items: The Energy Battery Backpack is only available as an Epic loot drop from Krona in the Oan Sciencells Alert.

The other half of the Gauntlet of Power are the Energy Battery Gloves.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Epic Collector's Capsule is an epic box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping on September 15th, 2022.

An Epic Collector's Capsule can only be opened using 3 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments provided by Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.

sections.title: Description
items: Each Epic Collector's Capsule guarantees you an Epic or better rarity item or collection piece from previous Time Capsules. When opened, you can choose between three randomly selected rewards (or a fourth choice, Quarks). That first choice will ALWAYS contain an item of Epic or better rarity.

sections.title: How to Obtain an Epic Collector's Capsule
items: The Epic Collector's Capsule drops in-game from any defeated enemy (to be opened with Stabilizers) or is also available for purchase directly in the Marketplace. Each capsule costs 3 Stabilizers or 300 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash to open.

title: Father Box
summary: A Father Box (sometimes spelled as Fatherbox) is a sentient supercomputer powered with energy from The Source and has Anti-Life properties. It is the Apokoliptian spin on the Mother Box.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Father Box (sometimes spelled as Fatherbox) is a sentient supercomputer powered with energy from The Source and has Anti-Life properties. It is the Apokoliptian spin on the Mother Box.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Father Box was created by Walt Simonson, first appearing in Orion #8 (2001), 30 years after the first appearance of a Mother Box.; Their first design (during the New Earth in the Post-Crisis era) was made in the likes of the Mother Box of that era - a retro-futuristic mobile device with exposed circuitry in the shape of a walkman, and later of a PDA and a smartphone - but engraved with spikes and scales, and emitting a "ting" sound instead of Mother's characteristic "ping" (see gallery).; The current cubic design of the Mother/Father boxes was introduced in the The New 52 era (2011-2016), but the idea of engravings in the boxes first appeared in the DC Extended Universe movies (2013-2025) - those have been introduced in the game in the Wonderverse episode.

title: Soul Aura
summary: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.

sections.title: Overview
items: This subject has been replaced or otherwise rendered obsolete by various updates, downloadable content packages, or general system upgrades.
Soul Auras are special buffs granted by certain powers in Sorcery.
Only one Soul Aura can be active at a time on a player character.

table.caption: Soul Aura Power Interactions
rows: Sorcery : Soul Well, Fury, Guardian, Watcher,; Soul Siphon (Damage role)
Grants Golden Soul Aura; +10% critical healing chance
Sorcery : Invocation of Renewal, Rejuvenate, Vengeance, Soul Siphon (Healer role)
Additional Damage when Red Soul Aura is active
Inflicts Damage when Red Soul Aura is active

sections.title: Red Soul Aura
items: A Guardian, Fury, Soul Well or Watcher will grant the caster a Red Soul Aura when an enemy is defeated.
Casting Soul Siphon in the Damage role grants a Red Soul Aura.
Soul Storm, Transmutation and Wrath cause additional damage when a Red Soul Aura is active.
Boon of Souls causes damage to opponents that hit the shield when Red Soul Aura is active.

sections.title: Golden Soul Aura
items: The Golden Soul Aura increases Critical Healing Chance by 10%.
Casting Invocation of Renewal or Rejuvenate grants a Golden Soul Aura if a Red Soul Aura is not active.
Casting Soul Siphon in the Healer role grants a Golden Soul Aura.
Using Vengeance on an enemy with afflicted with Bad Karma also grants a Golden Soul Aura.

sections.title: Vengeance Soul Aura
items: The Vengeance Soul Aura was removed in Game Update 32.
It increased Critical Healing Chance by 10%, Critical Healing Magnitude by 15%, Critical Ability Chance by 10% and Critical Ability Damage by 1% for 18 seconds.
Prior to Update 32, Weapon attacks on a Bad Karma inflicted opponent that has been hit with Vengeance would grant a Vengeance Soul Aura.
The Vengeance Soul Aura used the same animation as the Golden Soul Aura.
Allies of the Vengeance caster could gain the Vengeance Soul Aura.

title: Goth Leggings
summary: The Goth Leggings, also known as Net Legs is a Legs style item based on the fishnet tights worn by Black Canary and Zatanna Zatara.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Goth Leggings, also known as Net Legs is a Legs style item based on the fishnet tights worn by Black Canary and Zatanna Zatara.
Fishnet hosiery is defined by an open, diamond shaped knit most often used as a material for stockings, tights or bodystockings.

A fashion statement that originated during the 1950's and gathering mainstream appeal throughout the 1960's/70's, when worn, the knit helps accentuate curves by applying a grid against the body that will follow the body's contours, accentuating muscular definition. Fishnet was most commonly worn as a means to decorate exposed skin.

sections.title: Source
items: The Goth Leggings is only available as a purchasable style item from the Marketplace, or Doctor Fate in the House of Legends.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Both Zatanna and Black Canary are famed for wearing fishnets with their hero uniforms. So much so that the hosiery are considered part of their iconic images respectively.

When purchased from the Marketplace, the player will be presented with and be able to redeem both the Goth Leggings and the Goth Tights (also known as the Sheer Net legs style); the difference between which is that the leggings are enclosed tights (meaning the tights' "skin tone" can be altered) while the latter are sheer tights which exposes the character's skin tone.

title: H-Dial
summary: The H-Dial is a powerful artifact capable of turning the user into a super-powered being for a limited time.

sections.title: Overview
items: The H-Dial is a powerful artifact capable of turning the user into a super-powered being for a limited time.

Several copies of this artifact except in the world, with several having possessed its power over the centuries; most have come to regret using it however, due to the trouble the artifacts seem to attract.
Shaped like a phone dial, each time the owner dials the letters H-E-R-O, they turn into a different superpowered being; dialing O-R-E-H makes them revert to their normal form.

At the end of an hour, the H-Dial transformation must be reversed; if this is not done, the personality of whatever hero or villain the powers come from starts overtaking the host's mind until the original is completely rewritten.

sections.title: History
items: Existing for unknown eons, a H-Dial was first reportedly found within a cave in modern time by Robby Reed, who used it to transform into a plethora of superheroes to defend his hometown of Littleville, Colorado, from aliens, mutants, robots and a menagerie of odd disasters drawn to the dial.

Two other dials are discovered years later by teenagers Christopher "Chris" King and Victoria "Vicky" Grant of the New England town of Fairfax in a 'haunted' house. The friends used their H-Dials to combat a strange array of villains while being pursued by a foe known as The Master, and aided by a mysterious ally, known as The Wizard. Eventually, it was revealed both the Master and the Wizard were alter-egos of Robby Reed, who had separated into them by using the Dial to disarm a dead man's switch and had never been able to recover the dial to return to his normal shape until then.

Vicky and Chris later demonstrated the ability to internalize the Dials' powers, presumably due to extended exposure, though not without side effects: Vicky became mentally unstable, while Chris found himself unable to control his transformations. Vicky's H-Dial was eventually discovered by the Scavenger and fell into the hands of Hero Cruz, who used it to gain super powers and later to aid Vicky in regaining her sanity.

sections.title: Involvement
items: The H-Dial is an artefact that will randomly appear in the last boss arena of the Nexus of Reality raid. The artefact will summon two metahumans at a time. They often blockbreak the tank so it's recommended to wipe them out quickly.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The H-Dial first appeared in House of Mystery #156 (January, 1966).

Robby's H-Dial was once used by his foe, Daffy Dagan, who briefly becomes a supervillain after dialing V-I-L-L-A-I-N. Robby's girlfriend, Suzie, also uses the dial, dialing H-E-R-O-I-N-E to temporarily transform into Gem Girl.
The superhero Hero Cruz wielded a form of the H-Dial inset in his belt; it was confirmed this version functioned by merging temporarily different versions of people through Hypertime.
Dialing it backwards first (O-R-E-H) produces monstrous transformations.
In the 31st Century, another H-Dial was given to Lori Morning by the Time Trapper, though this Dial was eventually destroyed.
In spite of having been confirmed as been seen as far as 20,000 BC, the H-Dial contains Interlac scripture, which is not invented until the 30th century.

title: Heartbreak
summary: The Heartbreak is an epic vendor item and pet in the trinket class. It was first available during the Valentine's Day Event 2017.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Heartbreak is an epic vendor item and pet in the trinket class. It was first available during the Valentine's Day Event 2017.

sections.title: Abilities
items: Increases player character might by 246 for 20 seconds
Charges, stuns, debuffs and damages enemies

sections.title: Trivia
items: The stats in the infobox are at the maximum item level of 191. The Might buff on use does not scale with level - it is always 246 Might for 20 seconds.
For the item to attune to its maximum item level of 191, player characters need to have a combat rating of 217.
For its first year 2017, the item had item levels 10-164.
It is best to use high damage attacks when debuffs is activated.
Debuff enemy defense around 7% according to https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V49X4D9jqGk&t=310s

classification.evidence: The Heartbreak is an epic vendor item and pet in the trinket class. It was first available during the Valentine's Day Event 2017.

sections.title: Notes
items: These henchmen will attack for 41.3 - 42.3 seconds before despawning.

Calling in these henchmen while close to the target will result in more damage dealt than calling them in from a distance. This is probably due to the fact that some rifle attacks will move them out of reach more frequently in the latter.

In a test consisting of 5 rounds with CR 512 Tier 3 Henchmen against a single Sparring Target in close range, they deal an average of 1216052 damage, with a minimum of 964805 and a maximum of 1574548.

In a test consisting of 5 rounds with CR 512 Tier 3 Henchmen against a group of 5 Sparring Targets in close range, they deal an average of 1899927 damage, with a minimum of 1629816 and a maximum of 2441255.
Although it is possible for these henchmen to deal critical hits, they didn't score any critics during the tests above.

title: House of El 2019
summary: The House of El 2019 is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for new heroes and new villains. Created from crystals in the Fortress of Solitude the suit is based on armour designs worn by the royal guards of the House of El on Krypton.

sections.title: Overview
items: The House of El 2019 is a costume style set and an Iconic Battle Suit for new heroes and new villains. Created from crystals in the Fortress of Solitude the suit is based on armour designs worn by the royal guards of the House of El on Krypton.

Consisting of eight pieces, the set is themed after Superman and is a specialized Tier 5 PvE ( Player versus Environment) set available from the Combat Rating 210 Box contained in the CR 210 Advance. The style set is available in Marketplace.

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The House of El 2019's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
The diamond and the "S" in the House of El symbol on the chest, belt, and cape are always red, and the empty space in the diamond is always black, regardless of your colour scheme.
Emblems do not appear while wearing this style.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The set is a retexturing of the previously released House of El Warsuit costume style set.
The pieces of this set would occasionally sparkle when equipped.

title: Katana (Style)
summary: The Katana is a Weapon Style for either One-Handed or Dual Wield weapons. The style is based on the weapon of the same name.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Katana is a Weapon Style for either One-Handed or Dual Wield weapons. The style is based on the weapon of the same name.
Heavily associated with its country of origin; Japan, the katana is a curved, slender, single-edged blade with a circular or squared guard and long grip to accommodate two hands.

Traditionally made from a specialized Japanese steel called "Tamahagane", the katana evolved from the Tachi blade in the 1400's. The rise in the katana's popularity is believed to have been due to the changing nature of close-combat warfare where the sword's quicker draw enabled the wielder an edge in duels and one-on-one encounters.

During the Meiji period the modernization of Japan's military and the disbanding of the Samurai class saw a decline in sword manufacture until pre-World War II when all Japanese officers were required to wear a sword. After the war, sword manufacture and sword related martial arts were banned in Japan and many swords were confiscated and destroyed until 1953, when they were allowed to return.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The katana evolved from the Tachi at around the 1400's. The Tachi is a lighter blade with a more pronounced curve that was worn with the cutting edge facing downward when sheathed (katana are worn in the sheath with the cutting edge facing upward).

The katana was often paired with a similar smaller companion sword, such as a wakizashi or a tantō dagger. The pairing of a katana with a smaller sword is called "the daishō". The daisho could only be worn by samurai and it represented the social power and personal honor of the samurai.

Since 1953 Japanese sword-smiths and martial arts have been allowed to return, but with severe restrictions: sword-smiths must be licensed and serve a five-year apprenticeship before-hand. They are also only allowed to produce two long swords per month. All swords must be registered by the Japanese Government.

Tatsu Yamashiro (aka Katana), a prominent member of the Outsiders hero team, is a trained samurai who wields a mystical katana named "Soultaker". Soultaker was, along with its non-powered twin, forged in the 14th century by Muramasa, whose swords were said to be cursed. The blade has the mystical ability to take the souls of those it slays, storing them inside the sword, where they can engage in limited communication with the wielder.

title: Lasher
summary: Lashers appear in cell block six of the Stryker's Island Penitentiary Hard Mode Alert, in the Meta-Powered Inmate's solitary confinement area, between the main cell block and the point where the Rogues obtain their confiscated gear.

sections.title: Overview
items: Lashers appear in cell block six of the Stryker's Island Penitentiary Hard Mode Alert, in the Meta-Powered Inmate's solitary confinement area, between the main cell block and the point where the Rogues obtain their confiscated gear.

The characterizing attack that the Lashers use is a ground/pull/root. The distance is comparable to that of any ranged weapon, making most ranged attacks useless, and all ranged attacks short-lived. The length of the root time is relatively very long. Binding their enemies gives an opportunity for other Penitentiary inmates to cause damage, since their own damage after binding is rather low. Running away will immediately cause a player to be pulled back and bound again, with another large hit of initial damage. They are vulnerable to close-range attacks, with melee attacks and weapons doing the most damage.

title: Lucius Fox
summary: Lucius Fox is the current business manager and corporate executive of Wayne Enterprises.

sections.title: Overview
items: Lucius Fox is the current business manager and corporate executive of Wayne Enterprises.

A close friend and confidante to Bruce Wayne, with whom Fox frequently acts as financial liaison, Fox's actions are, albeit indirectly and unknowingly, responsible for many of the resources that go towards the development of the Batman's gadgetry and crime-fighting equipment.

sections.title: Background
items: Graduating magna cum laude from the Morton School of Business, Lucius first took a position as Vice President of Atwater Air and in just a few years turned the near-bankrupt commuter air service into a leading competitor and was made CEO of the company while avoiding the massive layoffs endorsed by every business pundit of the time. After that Fox was sought after by several large corporations in the world for his "midas touch" in turning failing businesses into successful conglomerates.

Eventually working for Pontefract Industries, Bruce Wayne managed to entice him into coming to Gotham to run WayneTech after Wayne had returned home to discover his father's company, Wayne Enterprises, being mismanaged by corruption within the board of directors.

With Wayne's subtle manipulations, Fox worked his way up from being head of WayneTech's Aerospace division to first running the Wayne Foundation and then Wayne Enterprises itself. As president, Fox returned Wayne Enterprises to its former glory and elected to stay, having been given an unparalleled freedom in the company after Wayne, who was spending more and more time operating as the Batman, handed the reigns of the company over to him.
Bringing even more wealth and resources to the company by going global, Fox has survived multiple kidnappings and a stroke to constantly spring back into his role as the CEO of Wayne Enterprises.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Lucius Fox first appeared in Batman #307 (January 1979).
Lucius Fox is voiced by Leif Anders.
Lucius is married to Tanya Fox and has four children; Tiffany, Tim, Tamara and Luke. He named Tamara after his idol, Thomas Wayne.

Wayne and Fox first met when Fox was rescued from muggers while in Paris by a teenage Bruce Wayne. Afterwards, Fox put forth the notion of using Wayne's wealth for a charitable foundation but Wayne turned down the offer, intent instead on pursuing his "mission".
Fox was head of WayneTech's Aerospace division when Bruce Wayne first began "acquiring" model prototypes to build what would become the first Batwing.
Wayne's further acquirement of other prototypes have sometimes aroused Fox's suspicion as to who Wayne really is behind the "bored playboy" persona.

title: Mother Box
summary: Grain of Time Meta Clinic ID Coney Coin Sunstone Fragment

sections.title: Overview
items: Grain of Time Meta Clinic ID Coney Coin Sunstone Fragment
" It is difficult to describe a Mother Box to outsiders [...] It is not unlike your planet's... smartphone? Just a whole lot better." — Big Barda
A Mother Box (sometimes spelled as Motherbox) is a sentient supercomputer operated by New Gods.

sections.title: History
items: The Mother Box technology was created by the New God inventor Himon using a metal known Element X and drawing power from the The Source. A Mother Box is considered a living being and is referred as "she/her", and is extremely loyal to her owner, with whom she shares a special affinity that allows communication via telepathy.

Only a being born on New Genesis or Apokolips can be capable of manufacturing a Mother Box. Still, it requires training and skill to succeed in creating one. Mister Miracle is known to be one of those skilled individuals, lending a prototype of one of his own designs to help the Exobyte-powered heroes fight the forces of Apokolips.

In DCUO, Mother Boxes have been seen opening Boom Tubes and healing their owners, as well as fighting enemies. According to Big Barda, they're also capable of manipulating energy and rearranging matter.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Note: Any appearance of a Boom Tube counts as a Mother Box being used - except for Boom Tubes opened by Cyborg, Murder Machine, Father Boxes, or Alfred Boxes.

table.caption: Involvement
columns: Episode 11: Halls of Power Part I
rows: Episode 14: Halls of Power Part II
Collections: Fourth World Items of Interest
Children of Krypton, Chapter 1: Shadows Over Argo
Children of Krypton, Chapter 2: Wrath of the Worldkillers

references.label: Collections: Fourth World Items of Interest

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Mother Boxes were created by Jack Kirby, first appearing in Forever People #1 (1971).; Their first design (during the Earth-One in the Pre-Crisis era) was of a red rectangular cuboid; it was later changed to look like retro-futuristic mobile device with exposed circuitry in the shape of a walkman, and later of a PDA and a smartphone - the latter is the version of the Mother Box referenced in the game in the Halls of Power storyline, recognizable for their characteristic "ping" sound when interacted with (see gallery).; The current cubic design was introduced in the The New 52 era (2011-2016), but the idea of engravings in the boxes first appeared in the DC Extended Universe movies (2013-2025) - those have been introduced in the game in the Wonderverse episode.

Although the concept for the Mother Box has been introduced in Episode 11, Mother Boxes only got a physical representation in the game in Episode 38 with the introduction of the Mother Box combat pet.
Apokolips: New Genesis Undercity is the first time an NPC's Mother Box has a physical form in the game.

summary: The Plasmic Aura was exclusively and randomly available from the temporary promotional offer Booster Bundle at the marketplace.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Plasmic Aura was exclusively and randomly available from the temporary promotional offer Booster Bundle at the marketplace.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Aura Reward Box from Booster Bundle

sections.title: Trivia
items: The promotional marketplace offer which may have contained this item was available to players with a PSG account on the EU PC Server only from July, 24th to July, 30th. It was then available on US PC & US PS3 servers from August, 13th to August 26th, 2013, and on the EU PS3 server from August 14th to August 27th, 2013.
The color of this item is not affected by your color palette.

The value of the Plasmic aura, as of September 2013, was between $50,000,000 and $100,000,000 on US servers. Also, the only way to obtain the Plasmic Aura now is from another player who luckily received the item from the Booster Bundle. Promethium Lockboxes do not drop the Plasmic aura. It is likely that there are no unconsumed Plasmic Auras in existence, but the possiblity continues to have intrigue. It is frequently the source of scam attempts and ploys for real world money.

title: Power (Style)
summary: Power is a Female-only Armor Style Set based on the uniform of the superhero Power Girl.

sections.title: Overview
items: Power is a Female-only Armor Style Set based on the uniform of the superhero Power Girl.

While otherwise indistinct from the typical superhero garb of tight spandex, Power Girl's uniform is largely noted within the communities of both heroes and villains for the material cutout centered across the chest which reveals her cleavage.

Power Girl initially left the chest of her uniform open because she wanted to decide on a symbol to put there, like Superman's. However, nowadays, when asked about the window, she replies that the costume " shows what I am: female, healthy and strong. If men want to degrade themselves by staring, that's their problem, I'm not going to apologize for it."

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Power's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Trivia
items: According to Black Canary, Power Girl's bosom is the most famous bosom in the superhero community, with Wonder Woman's being the second.
Power Girl almost always wears her costume under her civilian clothes, " except like a cocktail dress or a bikini-type situation."

The origin of Power Girl's bosom size stemmed from when comic book artist Wally Wood was given the job to draw Power Girl. Convinced that the editors were not paying attention to anything he did, Wood and his inker drew Power Girl's breasts bigger each comic book issue until the editors noticed. It wasn't until issue 7 or issue 8 that one of the editors spoke up about the character's increasing bust size and Wood decided to keep her bosom at that size for the remainder of her appearances.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Reagents (exabytes) for Adaptive Augments have undergone changes over the years:; Initially, four rank bonuses were available requiring dedicated exobytes of Flawed, Solid, and Pristine qualities. The Augments had common rarity at rank 0, and could be leveled to rank 23--which required four different varieties of catalysts to achieve.; Atlantis episode reduced the variety of catalysts to three.; The Wonderverse episode introduced event-level (weaker) Adaptive Augments and exobyte reagents of Flawless and Timeless qualities. Adaptive Augments now have six rank bonuses available. Augments missions were replaced by the Grant system.; With the Legion of Doom episode, augments now have eight rank bonuses available. Exobyte reagent qualities were reduced to Solid, Pristine, and Flawless.; With The Sins of Black Adam episode, augments now have seven rank bonuses available.; With Light and Rain: Raging Night, the variety of catalysts and exobyte reagents were reduced to one each.

title: Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule
summary: A Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping January, 7th, 2025.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping January, 7th, 2025.

A Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule can only be opened using 7 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that are available from Stabilizer Fragmentation.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of the previous nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.
To recap, you will get $9 worth of unlocked Time Capsules for just 700 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash or 7 Stabilizers.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each dropped Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule can be opened using 7 Stabilizers OR you can purchase the Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule directly in the Marketplace for 700 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (PS, Xbox). There is no difference between the dropped version and the Marketplace version, so you can go ahead and choose whichever method is most convenient for you.

sections.title: What is Inside a Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each Regalia Resurgence Mega Capsule will also contain one unlocked version of the last nine previous Time Capsule. This would count towards any feats for opening those Time Capsules.
Unlocked Secrets of Kahndaq Time Capsule
5.88% Chance: One random Powerset Regalia Accessory
Green Glowing Regalia Accessory ( Light - Hero)
5.88% Chance: One random Legacy Powerset Skin
7.14% Chance: One random Legacy Neon Chroma Pack

items: Restored Shim'Tar Regalia is a costume style set available from the Skip to CR 290 bundle.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of the champion of the Amazons of Bana-Mighdall.
The enhanced veresion was available as styles from the Member Appreciation Gift granted on occasion of the game's 10th anniversary in 2021 and is currently available in Marketplace.

title: Resurgence Mega Capsule (1)
summary: A Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping on March 22nd, 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping on March 22nd, 2018.
Each capsule is account bound and perishable. It will expire after 14 days.

A Resurgence Mega Capsule can only be opened using 7 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that drop in special events such as the Stabilizer Fragmentation duo.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of our existing nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.

Additionally, the Resurgence Mega Capsule comes with the Powerset Aura Reward Box, which randomly includes one of the following all-new auras, inspired by the powersets in DC Universe Online. There's no rarity here, just an equally weighted random chance to get ANY of these 17 new auras with each Resurgence Mega Capsule you open.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This Cache and the Seal of Completion both cost 1 Destiny Token to purchase. Due to the decreasing probability of successfully breaking through artifact ranks, the Cache is, on average, more cost effective for rank 140 or below breakthroughs. The Cache is likely best used for only rank 140, as lower ranks cost less Source Marks and have 40%+ probability, so seals are less necessary. At rank 160, both options are on average, equal in cost - but Seal of Completion is reliable due to it being a guaranteed success. For ranks 180 and 200, Seals of Completion are significantly superior due to the otherwise very low chance of success.
