title: Speed-Force Spectrum 2018
summary: Speed-Force Spectrum 2018 is a Costume Style Set which was freely available during the Flash appreciation week in 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: Speed-Force Spectrum 2018 is a Costume Style Set which was freely available during the Flash appreciation week in 2018.

Consisting of eight pieces, it was freely available from the Marketplace for all players having logged in between February 8th and February 14th, 2018. Later it was put on the marketplace for 600 Daybreak Cash under the name Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Suit.

table.caption: Sets
rows: - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Head Style (head); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Shoulders Style (shoulders); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Chest Style (chest); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Legs Style (legs); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Feet Style (feet); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Hands Style (hands); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Waist Style (waist); - Enhanced Speed-Force Spectrum Back Style (back)

sections.title: Color-Schemes
items: The Speed-Force Spectrum 2018's overall color-scheme consists of three colors that can be chosen by the Player in the Style Window. Specific sections of the style's pieces can also be allocated a more specific colour by the Player.
Emblems do not appear on this style.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Supporting Golden Exobyte can only be used to fortify augments which boost support stats.

title: Swirling Fluxline Cache
summary: Swirling Fluxline Cache is a unique purple item originally granted by developers for players who participated in a scavenger hunt for their live stream "Springtime in Metropolis" during the Springtime 2026 event.

sections.title: Overview
items: Swirling Fluxline Cache is a unique purple item originally granted by developers for players who participated in a scavenger hunt for their live stream "Springtime in Metropolis" during the Springtime 2026 event.

All players received world broadcast messages from an unknown character (likely typed by a developer in real time, given minor typos and corrections) who said they were at Giordano Botanical Gardens (which is a short distance northeast from the Springtime event warp location), and later left hints that led players to Living Quarters at the House of Legends, next to the large tree ("domitree"). While the character remained unseen, they announced moving from phase to phase in order (as accessible through the map), and players there received the Cache.
It took place in April 10th, from around 9:30pm to 10:30pm UTC on US servers, and around 22:30-23:00 UTC on EU servers.

title: Tattooed
summary: Tattooed is a Skin Style bestowed upon the Player Character by Future Lex Luthor's Exobytes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Tattooed is a Skin Style bestowed upon the Player Character by Future Lex Luthor's Exobytes.

The skin is based on individuals like the supervillain Tattooed Man (Mark Richards), who can manipulate the tattoos on his body due to a form of living ink, and the superhero Grace Choi, who wears tattoos partially to express herself and partially to conceal a branding scar from her time spent in a prostitution slave ring.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Thanks to the Exobyte research done separately by S.T.A.R. Labs and LexCorp, Player Characters are able to manipulate their Exobyte-given appearance, should they wish to change the appearance of their "skins", simply by seeking out either Doctor Dean at Ace Chemicals or Researcher Quinn at the S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility to obtain new "skin styles".

While some people wear tattoos as a form of identification with a certain group or ideal, others derive strength and focus from tattoos using their belief in a totemistic symbol imprinted in their skin to lessen their doubt and fear responses; much in the same way a person might do with a pendant or talisman.

title: Unstable Seal of Completion
summary: Unstable Seal of Completion is a gift to all players during Bonus Catalyst/Augment Catalysts Weekends, which can be used in the process of upgrading artifacts at any breakthrough level.

sections.title: Overview
items: Unstable Seal of Completion is a gift to all players during Bonus Catalyst/Augment Catalysts Weekends, which can be used in the process of upgrading artifacts at any breakthrough level.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The text when claiming this item read: Maximize the potential of your bonus Catalysts with this Unstable Seal of Completion. Note: this seal is unstable and has begun to decay. Be sure to use it before it expires!

Artifact breakthroughs have a lower breakthrough chance the higher the artifact level, as low as 3% at level 200. 3% meaning that merely three out of hundred breakthrough attempts would be successful on average. Thus this item can speed up breakthroughs at levels 140 to 200 considerably.

classification.evidence: Unstable Seal of Completion is a gift to all players during Bonus Catalyst/Augment Catalysts Weekends, which can be used in the process of upgrading artifacts at any breakthrough level.

title: Uplink Device
summary: Uplink Device is a type of trinket, usually tied to the Lair System that assists the player character in combat by either initiating an Orbital Strike, summoning 1-3 NPC fighters to temporarily join the fight, or to recharge Power & Health via a Supply Drop. They can be acquired from Base Dispenser, Vendors, Event Progression, or as a drop from defeated enemies.

sections.title: Overview
items: Uplink Device is a type of trinket, usually tied to the Lair System that assists the player character in combat by either initiating an Orbital Strike, summoning 1-3 NPC fighters to temporarily join the fight, or to recharge Power & Health via a Supply Drop. They can be acquired from Base Dispenser, Vendors, Event Progression, or as a drop from defeated enemies.

Many Uplink Devices require related activation in the Player's Base Mainframe, as well as active cells in the Player's Base Generator. A note in the Tooltip for the device will describe any limitations or requirements.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Voidgazer's Resurgence Mega Capsule is a legendary box item dropped randomly by any enemy defeated by the player once they reach level 10. It started dropping May 5th, 2026 and lasted until June 1st, 2026.

The Voidgazer's Resurgence Mega Capsule can only be opened using 7 Stabilizers. Stabilizers can be purchased in the Marketplace or created by combining 15 Stabilizer Fragments that are available from Stabilizer Fragmentation.

sections.title: Description
items: This capsule includes one of each of the previous nine Time Capsules - again, that's NINE Time Capsules - already unlocked and ready for you to open.
To recap, you will get $9 worth of unlocked Time Capsules for just 700 Daybreak/Marketplace Cash or 7 Stabilizers.

sections.title: How to Obtain a Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule
items: Each dropped Voidgazer's Resurgence Mega Capsule can be opened using 7 Stabilizers OR you can purchase the Anomaly Resurgence Mega Capsule directly in the Marketplace for 700 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (PS, Xbox). There is no difference between the dropped version and the Marketplace version, so you can go ahead and choose whichever method is most convenient for you.

title: Wicked Shillelagh
summary: The Wicked Shillelagh is a Staff weapon that is only available during the St. Patrick's Day Seasonal Event.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Wicked Shillelagh is a Staff weapon that is only available during the St. Patrick's Day Seasonal Event.

A shillelagh is a wooden walking stick and club that is associated with Ireland and Irish folklore. It is typically made from a stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top and was named after the Shillelagh Forest in County Wicklow where the majority of Ireland's wood is exported from.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: The Wicked Shillelagh is a random drop from Golden Coins that appears only during the St. Patrick's Day Seasonal Event.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This item can not be salvaged for parts at R&D stations.
The shillelagh is considered to be a badge of honor for those who carried one.

The shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner—like pistols in colonial America, or the katana in Japan. Modern practitioners of bataireacht study the use of the shillelagh as a martial art.

classification.evidence: The Wicked Shillelagh is a Staff weapon that is only available during the St. Patrick's Day Seasonal Event. title: Bottled City Soder
summary: Bottled City Soder is an artifact consumable suitable for any role and available from a feat for opening 15 Kryptonian Time Capsules.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bottled City Soder is an artifact consumable suitable for any role and available from a feat for opening 15 Kryptonian Time Capsules.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: The item is a reward for completing the Pour One Out.
The item is also available from the Rewards from Time and Space vendor for 75 Quarks, or 25 if the Pour One Out feat has already been completed.

sections.title: Notes
items: It is the only artifact not to be equipped in an artifact slot but instead in a consumable slot. It shares a cooldown with normal Soder Colas.
It also has a unique rank up pattern that is essentially "compressed": it has much fewer ranks, but each rank requires much more experience, and the milestone ranks are tightly packed.

Assuming even probability distribution, its power restore surpasses Soder Cola Extreme by rank 7, and the heal surpasses it at rank 6. By rank 8, its guaranteed effects ties with Soder Cola Extreme's maximum healing and surpasses its power restore, and effectively becomes an unlimited source of stat restores that is equal or superior in every way, although it costs considerable Nth Metal (Artifacts) and Catalyst (Artifacts) to reach that point.

title: Eye of Gemini
summary: Eye of Gemini is an artifact recommended for any role.

sections.title: Overview
items: Eye of Gemini is an artifact recommended for any role.
This is a highly recommended artifact for endgame in DC Universe Online, especially for DPS, Healers and Tanks.

sections.title: Notes
items: Supercharge abilities with a lower cost would be more efficient in activating this artifact.
Rage has Vindictive, which costs a minimum of 2000 Supercharge, but is a toggle.
Movement Modes all have 2 or 3 abilities that costs 2500 Supercharge ( Perfect Poise, Devastating Flip, Dustoff, Vacuum Bubble, Metabolic Boost, Speed Drain, Dash Attack).
Pheromone Bloom is the only 2500 Supercharge ability available to absolutely anyone, being from Iconic Powers.
Out of Heart of Isis' new abilities, only ! triggers Eye of Gemini.

sections.title: Castor's Watch
items: While not stated in the description, Castor's Watch will restore Supercharge not just to the user, but to all nearby players that are in the user's group. This makes it extremely powerful, especially in experienced endgame content groups with healers or tanks that can afford to spam low-cost Supercharges instead of standard abilities.

At rank 160, and with any 2500 Supercharge abilities, Eye of Gemini would restore 12% Supercharge over 6 seconds upon use, nearly half the abilities' cost. The appropriate Head Equipment Mod, if available, allow it to recover 14.5% Supercharge. Even more Supercharge would be restored if the Power & Supercharge league proficiency is activated or if Scrap of the Soul Cloak is used. 2500 Supercharge abilities can generate more Supercharge than their cost (minding Scrap's 30s internal cooldown).

sections.title: Pollux's Gaze
items: Allies and the triggering Supercharge ability itself counts towards Pollux's Gaze's extra damage, but Orbital Strike Uplink Device does not.

Pollux's Gaze hits all targets in range, but the damage is equally divided, not all targets being hit for the full damage (e.g. if Pollux's Gaze recorded 10000 damage during the period and there are 5 targets in range, Pollux's Gaze will deal an extra hit of 400 on each target).

sections.title: Notes
items: Heart of Isis grants 7 new abilities, as seen here.
Although unstated, rank 80 is required to unlock the 7 new abilities.
The 7 abilities share one ability slot, and can only be used in order of their fixed sequence. They have no cooldowns otherwise.
Word of Power is not replaced, and can still be used as a separate ability. Heart of Isis' new abilities do not trigger Word of Power tactical mods.
! and Word of Power, which resemble each other, offer the same bonuses to damage role and these do not stack with each other (only the one activated first would be active).
Only !, the seventh ability, triggers Eye of Gemini.
Only Wisdom of Solomon and ! trigger Scrap of the Soul Cloak's 7% refund. The other supercharge abilities do not trigger refund, nor do they trigger Scrap's internal cooldown.

sections.title: Notes
items: Avatar of Fear and Avatar of Will are not exclusionary. Both can be active at once as the Avatar is maintained upon switching roles, and both would trigger the on-damage effect as normal until they expire after the usual duration.
Avatar of Fear can be powered up even if you are not in a group, but you must be in combat.
Avatar of Fear's explosion cannot be triggered on a hit that KO'es the target, even if there are nearby valid targets to affect.

Robot Sidekick giving itself power can power up Avatar of Fear. Normally this is of no practical relevance, as in the Control role, using any ability can power up Avatar of Fear. However, it can be useful for AFK filling up Supercharge to max, such as after logging in (which sets Supercharge to zero), on Sparring Targets.
